  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/break-glass:
    get:
      tags:
      - Workspaces
      operationId: listActiveBreakGlassGrants
      summary: List active break-glass grants for the selected Personal Workspace
      description: Only the workspace owner and active Community Administrators of the same community may view
        grant metadata. The response never contains the encrypted justification. This route is scoped to one 
        workspace and is not a community-wide personal-workspace directory.
      parameters:
      - *id001
      - *id002
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Active break-glass grants for the selected Personal Workspace
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassGrantListDto'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
    post:
      tags:
      - Workspaces
      operationId: invokePersonalWorkspaceBreakGlass
      summary: Grant time-limited, audited Community Admin access to a Personal Workspace
      description: Only an active Community Administrator of the same community may invoke this for another 
        user's PERSONAL workspace (the owner cannot invoke break-glass against their own workspace). Fresh 
        credential re-authentication within the previous five minutes is required. The grant is read-only and 
        scoped to this one workspace; it does not enable impersonation, mutation, export, download, global 
        search, or access to another workspace. The requester chooses an initial duration of 15, 30, or 60 
        minutes (15 minutes is the recommended UI default). One 30-minute extension may be requested before 
        expiry, but it takes approval from a different active Community Administrator; total access may never 
        exceed 90 minutes from initial grant commit. The grant is created only after the immutable 
        `BREAK_GLASS_GRANTED` event, persistent owner in-app notification, Community Admin alert and email 
        outbox records commit. If any required durable insert fails, no access is granted. Each protected 
        resource read emits `BREAK_GLASS_RESOURCE_ACCESSED` before content is returned. The owner, grantor, or
        any peer Community Administrator in the same community may revoke immediately. Grantor 
        privilege/session loss, owner revocation, and expiry also revoke it. The free-text justification is 
        stored only in a separate restricted encrypted grant record, never in audit metadata. Email is 
        attempted immediately and retried at 1, 5, 15, 30 and 60 minutes; persistent in-app notification 
        remains available even if email delivery fails. Final email failure alerts all Community 
        Administrators and security operations and writes `BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_FAILED`.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Grant time-limited, audited Community Admin access to a Personal Workspace
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassGrantDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/break-glass/{grantId}/renewal-request:
    post:
      tags:
      - Workspaces
      operationId: requestBreakGlassRenewal
      summary: Request the single permitted 30-minute break-glass extension
      description: Only the active grantor may request one extension before the current grant expires. A fresh
        reason and explicit confirmation are required. The existing expiry is unchanged until a different 
        active Community Administrator approves. The extension cannot make total access exceed 90 minutes from
        the initial grant commit. An expired or revoked grant cannot be renewed.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001

      - name: grantId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassRenewalRequest'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Renewal request recorded; no extension is active until independent approval
          content:

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassRenewalRequestDto'
          headers:
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':

        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':

        '422':

      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:

        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS

          headers:

        '400':

          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':

      x-mutation-idempotency:

  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/break-glass/{grantId}/revoke:
    post:

      operationId: revokeBreakGlassGrant

      description: The Personal Workspace owner, grantor, or any other active Community Administrator in the

        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':

        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY

              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        '400':

        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-task-permission-enforcement:
        required: task:create; additionally task:assign when assigneeIds is non-empty; additionally 
          task:manage_subtasks and canCreateSubtask on the parent when parentTaskId is supplied.
        assignees: Every assigneeId must be a distinct ACTIVE member of the same workspace; assignedByUserId 
          is server-derived from the authenticated actor.
        parent: Parent must be readable and manageable, active, in the target workspace and within 
          maxSubtaskDepth.
        assigneeFieldGrants: If assigneeEditableFieldGroups is omitted, initialize it from the current 
          Workspace default. If supplied, validate it as a unique subset of the current Workspace allowed 
          ceiling. The authenticated creator is the task creator and may choose only within that ceiling. The 
          same set applies to every active assignee on this task; per-assignee differences are not supported.
        personalWorkspace: A Personal Workspace must keep Workspace allowed/default grant arrays empty and 
          reject non-empty task assigneeEditableFieldGroups; no other member can be an active assignee in a 
          Personal Workspace.
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - ASSIGNEE_FIELD_GRANT_EXCEEDS_WORKSPACE_CEILING
        - PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_ASSIGNEE_GRANTS_NOT_SUPPORTED
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/by-key/{taskKey}:
    get:
      tags:
      - Tasks
      operationId: resolveTaskKey
      summary: Resolve a current task key or immutable historical alias
      parameters:
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - name: taskKey
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[A-Z0-9]+$
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authorized resolution to the current task record. Includes canonical current 
            workspace/key and ACTIVE or ARCHIVED lifecycle metadata.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskKeyResolutionDto'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Actor-specific permission DTOs must not be stored in shared or cross-user caches.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          description: Indistinguishable RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND response for an unknown key, unknown namespace, 
            wrong-community namespace, missing community membership, missing lineage, or failure of 
            current-workspace task:read authorization. The body shape and code are identical across these 
            cases.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Do not cache authorization-dependent negative lookups.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
        '410':
          description: TASK_PERMANENTLY_PURGED is returned only after current-workspace task:read 
            authorization against the retained, content-free lineage tombstone. The response contains no task 
            ID, current key, source/destination identifiers, or task content.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Do not cache authorization-dependent purge status.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      description: Resolve a key in the community and historical workspace key namespace identified by the 
        path. The workspaceId path parameter identifies the key namespace/origin context only; it is not an 
        authorization grant. The caller must be an active community member, and the namespace workspace must 
        belong to the community, but membership in that historical workspace is not required before alias 
        lookup. Resolve the key to an immutable taskLineageId, then follow the lineage’s current 
        task/workspace pointer. Before returning any task identifier, current key, workspace, workspace, 
        archive state, or redirect information, authorize the caller for task:read against the lineage’s 
        current workspace and its retained task authorization context. This permits a caller with access to 
        the destination workspace—but not the source workspace—to follow an old source-workspace link. A 
        caller with only source-workspace access must receive the same generic 404 as an unknown key. Archived
        tasks that still exist resolve with lifecycleState=ARCHIVED and archivedAt metadata. An expired 
        recoverableUntil does not itself mean the task was permanently purged. Return 410 
        TASK_PERMANENTLY_PURGED only when a retained current-workspace lineage tombstone exists and the caller
        passes current-workspace task:read authorization against that tombstone. No alias or task existence 
        information may be returned before authorization. Do not issue an HTTP 3xx redirect; return the 
        canonical resolution DTO and let the client replace its route only after a successful authorized 200 
        response. All responses are private and non-cacheable.
      x-error-codes:
        '404':
        - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
        '410':
        - TASK_PERMANENTLY_PURGED
      x-key-resolution-policy-ref: '#/x-task-key-resolution-policy'

        '400':

      x-task-permission-enforcement:

          trust client flags or a cached result.
        fieldMapping: Authorize every supplied UpdateTaskRequest property against 
          x-task-permission-policy.fieldCapabilities before applying any write.
        atomicity: This is all-or-nothing. If one supplied field/action is forbidden, reject the complete 
          patch with 403 TASK_FIELD_FORBIDDEN; no field is changed and no permitted subset is partially 
          applied.
        errorDetails: restrictedFields contains only canonical field names in the already-readable task; do 
          not reveal inaccessible task existence or other task IDs.
        membership: Each assigneeId must be a distinct ACTIVE member of this same workspace at commit time.
        assigneeFieldGrants: assigneeEditableFieldGroups is permission metadata and is not authorized through 
          the ordinary fieldCapabilities map. It may be changed only by the active Task Creator or an active 
          Workspace Owner (also exposed as canManageAssigneeFieldGrants). The submitted set must be a subset 
          of the current Workspace allowed ceiling. The value is versioned through 
          baseFieldRevisions.assigneeEditableFieldGroups and participates in the same all-or-nothing patch 
          transaction.

          per-task grants are rejected because no other member can be an active assignee.

        '410':

        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/{taskId}/move:
    post:
      tags:
      - Tasks
      operationId: moveTask
      summary: Move a task within a workspace or transfer a task tree to another workspace in the same 
        community
      description: 'The source is bound to the path workspaceId. targetWorkspaceId must identify an active destination
        Workspace inside the same communityId. Cross-community transfer is unsupported. The operation acts on the
        selected task and its full descendant subtree as one atomic unit. For a same-Workspace move, preserve task
        IDs, all task content, relationships, assignees and activity; the selected root may be placed under targetParentTaskId
        (null means top-level), and descendant parentage is preserved. For a cross-Workspace transfer, apply NAMES_ONLY:
        create fresh destination task UUIDs and workspace-scoped keys for the full subtree; carry only task/subtask
        titles, parent-child structure and sibling order. Do not carry itemType, descriptions, status/progress,
        assignees, creator/assigner identity, dates, estimates, priority, labels, milestones, custom-field values,
        comments, watchers, task links or activity history. Recreate the transferred root at the top level of the
        destination Workspace; targetParentTaskId must be null for cross-Workspace transfer. Source rows become
        content-free transfer tombstones with no destination identifiers. Immutable key aliases map to stable taskLineageId
        values; the lineage current pointer contains only currentTaskId and currentWorkspaceId. Historical-key resolution
        must authorize task:read against the lineage current Workspace before returning canonical identity; otherwise
        return the same generic 404 as an unknown key. Do not emit counterpart Workspace identifiers in either Workspace
        realtime event. The move is all-or-nothing: lock source/target Workspace rows in ascending UUID order, validate
        both scopes and capabilities, lock the destination Workspace key allocator, validate the destination depth,
        allocate keys, write destination tasks and source tombstones/aliases, and append both Workspace outbox events
        in one transaction. Each Workspace receives its own monotonic workspaceSeq event with the same transferId
        and side=SOURCE or TARGET. Any validation, authorization, key allocation, alias uniqueness or outbox failure
        rolls back the entire transfer. Personal-to-Shared additionally requires a fresh move preview and explicit
        confirmedPersonalToSharedTransfer=true; the server rechecks live authorization and invariants at commit.
        OWNER CONFIRMED DEC-OPEN-10: when targetWorkspaceId differs from the path workspaceId, targetParentTaskId
        MUST be null. A non-null destination parent is rejected; no cross-Workspace transfer can attach a root under
        an existing destination task.'
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - *id003
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/MoveTaskRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Atomic move/transfer completed; source and target sequence values are returned in the 
            body and headers.
          headers:
            X-Source-Workspace-Seq:
              description: Sequence committed in the source workspace stream.
              schema:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1
            X-Target-Workspace-Seq:
              description: Sequence committed in the target workspace stream.
              schema:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
              description: Set only when source and target are the same workspace.
            Cache-Control:
              description: Actor-specific permission DTOs must not be stored in shared or cross-user caches.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskMoveResultDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          description: Stale preview, alias/key conflict, or idempotency payload mismatch; no partial transfer
            is committed.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
          headers:
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
            Retry-After:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter'
        '422':
          description: Validation error. TRANSFER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED includes transferPreview; other 
            validation errors do not require a preview object. No mutation occurs.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskMoveProblem'
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - TRANSFER_PREVIEW_STALE
        - TASK_KEY_ALIAS_CONFLICT
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - TARGET_WORKSPACE_INVALID
        - TARGET_PARENT_INVALID
        - MAX_SUBTASK_DEPTH_EXCEEDED
        - TRANSFER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
        - TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED
        - TARGET_PARENT_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CROSS_WORKSPACE_TRANSFER
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY

      description: Requires task:read. Returns sanitized CommentDto.bodyAst only; deleted comment bodies and

    post:

          description: Watch state updated
          headers:

              schema:

            X-Workspace-Seq:

            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Only the authenticated actor may change their own explicit watch preference. watching=false
        mutes ordinary watched-task update alerts; direct mention notifications still apply. watching=true 
        explicitly resumes ordinary updates. Creator/assignee/mention-derived watcher relationships are 
        maintained separately.
      x-comment-watcher-policy: Self-only; client cannot assign or remove another user as watcher. Explicit 
        mute suppresses non-mention updates but never a direct mention.
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'

        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/saved-views:
    get:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: listSavedViews
      summary: List personal and shared saved views visible to the caller
      parameters:
      - *id001
      - *id002
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List personal and shared saved views visible to the caller
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewListDto'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private/no-store; saved view definitions are principal-scoped.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires ACTIVE workspace membership and task:read. Returns only caller-owned PERSONAL 
        views and SHARED views in this workspace. Never return another member PERSONAL view, even to Owner, 
        Community Admin, Platform Operator or break-glass reader. Search uses the same visibility predicate. 
        Saved-view querySpec never grants task access; execution re-runs CR-04 authorization.
      x-saved-view-authorization: ACTIVE membership and task:read; return createdById=actor PERSONAL plus 
        workspace SHARED only.
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
    post:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: createSavedView
      summary: Create a personal or shared saved view
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SaveViewRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Create a personal or shared saved view
          headers:
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
              description: Present only when the created view has scope SHARED; absent for PERSONAL view 
                creation.
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private/no-store response. X-Workspace-Seq is present only for SHARED scope.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires ACTIVE membership and task:read. PERSONAL may be created by any such member. 
        SHARED requires saved_view:manage_shared. Scope and createdById are server-controlled/immutable after 
        creation. Name is trimmed and Unicode NFKC-normalized; apply case-insensitive uniqueness within 
        (workspaceId, createdById) for PERSONAL and workspaceId for SHARED. Validate 
        viewType/querySpec/displayOptions with CR-04 projection rules. Only SHARED create emits 
        saved_view.created and returns X-Workspace-Seq.
      x-saved-view-authorization: 'PERSONAL: ACTIVE member + task:read. SHARED: ACTIVE member + task:read + saved_view:manage_shared.
        No contextual task creator/assigner/assignee grant and no break-glass override.'
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
        '409':
        - SAVED_VIEW_NAME_CONFLICT
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - SAVED_VIEW_PROJECTION_INVALID
        - SAVED_VIEW_DISPLAY_OPTIONS_INVALID
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/saved-views/{viewId}:
    get:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: getSavedView
      summary: Get one saved view
      parameters:
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - name: viewId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Get one saved view
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDto'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private/no-store.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires ACTIVE workspace membership and task:read. PERSONAL is returned only to 
        createdById; SHARED is returned to active workspace members. Unknown and non-visible views return the 
        same generic 404. Cache-Control is private, no-store.
      x-saved-view-authorization: Do not elevate visibility for Owner, Community Admin, Platform Operator or 
        break-glass.
      x-error-codes:
        '404':
        - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
    patch:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: updateSavedView
      summary: Update a saved view using optimistic version control
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - name: viewId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateSavedViewRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Update a saved view using optimistic version control
          headers:
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
              description: Present only when the updated view has scope SHARED; absent for PERSONAL view 
                updates.
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private/no-store response. X-Workspace-Seq is present only for SHARED scope.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          description: Saved-view name conflict or optimistic version conflict. A stale version performs no 
            write.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                anyOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewVersionConflictProblem'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
          headers:
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
            Retry-After:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires ACTIVE membership and task:read. PERSONAL may be updated by createdById only. 
        SHARED may be updated by saved_view:manage_shared or by its original creator while still ACTIVE and 
        retaining task:read; creator exception applies only to that single view and does not grant 
        create/delete or other view management. scope and createdById are immutable. Request version must 
        equal current version; stale version returns 409 SAVED_VIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT with no write. Only 
        SHARED update emits saved_view.updated and returns X-Workspace-Seq. If the effective viewType after 
        PATCH is not BOARD, the request must explicitly send displayOptions:{} when clearing an existing Board
        configuration; the server never silently carries Board settings into another projection or silently 
        drops them.
      x-saved-view-authorization: 'PERSONAL: createdById. SHARED: saved_view:manage_shared or original creator for
        this view, provided actor is still ACTIVE and has task:read.'
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
        '404':
        - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
        '409':
        - SAVED_VIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT
        - SAVED_VIEW_NAME_CONFLICT
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - SAVED_VIEW_PROJECTION_INVALID
        - SAVED_VIEW_DISPLAY_OPTIONS_INVALID
        - SAVED_VIEW_DISPLAY_OPTIONS_INVALID
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
    delete:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: deleteSavedView
      summary: Delete a saved view
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - *id001
      - *id002
      - name: viewId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Saved view deleted
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private/no-store.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
              description: Present only for SHARED view deletion; absent for PERSONAL view deletion.
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires ACTIVE membership and task:read. PERSONAL may be deleted by createdById only. 
        SHARED deletion requires saved_view:manage_shared; original-creator update exception does not grant 
        deletion. Keep a minimal audit tombstone. Only SHARED delete emits saved_view.deleted and returns 
        X-Workspace-Seq.
      x-saved-view-authorization: 'PERSONAL: createdById. SHARED: saved_view:manage_shared only.'
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
        '404':
        - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY

  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/events:

      summary: Catch up authorized workspace events by workspace sequence
      description: sinceSeq is exclusive. Returns a complete ascending replay of at most 500 events and the 
        observed latestSeq. A cursor outside retained history returns 410 EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION; a cursor
        ahead of latestSeq returns 409 EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD. The response is private/no-store.

      - *id001
      - *id002
      - name: sinceSeq
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Catch up authorized workspace events by workspace sequence
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceEventPageDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          description: EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD; includes latestSeq for safe cursor correction.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventCursorAheadProblem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '410':
          description: EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION; includes latestSeq. Refetch canonical projections, then 
            catch up from latestSeq; partial replay is never returned.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventSeqOutOfRetentionProblem'
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD
        '410':
        - EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION

        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          description: EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD; includes latestSeq for safe cursor correction.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:

          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EventCursorAheadProblem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '410':
          description: EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION; includes latestSeq. Refetch canonical projections, then

      tags:
      - Realtime
      operationId: createRealtimeTicket
      summary: Issue a short-lived single-use realtime connection ticket
      description: Issue a 60-second, single-use, user- and community-bound credential for the WebSocket 
        handshake. Requires active CommunityMembership and CSRF protection. The ticket is redeemed atomically,
        stored only as a one-way hash, never logged or placed in a URL, and does not replace per-subscription 
        or per-event authorization. Credential issuance is deliberately excluded from X-Mutation-Id replay so 
        a retry cannot return the same raw ticket.
      parameters:
      - *id001
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RealtimeTicketRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Issue a short-lived single-use realtime connection ticket
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                const: no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RealtimeTicketDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: false
        reason: Single-use credential issuance; each attempt must mint a new ticket, and credential replay is 
          prohibited.

      parameters:

      - &id009

      - &id010

        name: eventTypes
        in: query

        schema:

          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 30
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventType'
        description: Repeat parameter for multiple event types.
        style: form
        explode: true
      - &id012
        name: categories
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 9
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventCategory'
        description: Repeat parameter for multiple categories.
        style: form
        explode: true
      - &id013
        name: severities
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: array

          maxItems: 4
          items:

            - WARNING
            - HIGH
            - CRITICAL
        description: Repeat parameter for multiple severities.
        style: form
        explode: true
      - &id014
        name: targetType
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditTargetType'
      - &id015
        name: targetId
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - name: cursor
        in: query
        required: false

      - name: limit
        in: query
        required: false

          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 100
          default: 50

          description: Search community audit events

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventPageDto'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store

        '401':

        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Community Administrators may search governance and security audit events for this community
        only. Results are ordered by occurredAt DESC then communitySequence DESC. Structured filters are 
        supported; free-text searches over user content are not. All reads are no-store and the successful 
        search is itself audited. The response includes snapshotSequence; the read-access audit event is 
        appended after that snapshot and is not part of the current cursor traversal.

  /auth/csrf:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: getCsrfToken
      summary: Bootstrap a pre-authentication CSRF token or return the current session token
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current CSRF token
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CsrfTokenDto'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets the short-lived pre-authentication CSRF cookie when no session exists; never 
                contains the session credential.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-auth-csrf=<opaque-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=600
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security: []
      description: Returns a short-lived CSRF token for login/registration/recovery when no session exists, 
        and sets a short-lived __Host-auth-csrf cookie; for an authenticated session it returns the 
        session-bound synchronizer token. Response is private/no-store. The CSRF cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, 
        SameSite=Lax, Path=/, with no Domain attribute.

        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-community-membership-policy: ACTIVE Community Admin only. membershipStatus ACTIVE/SUSPENDED; 
        isCommunityAdmin and isDefaultCoordinator are community-scoped. Setting isDefaultCoordinator affects 
        only the pool used for future Shared Workspace creation; it does not add/remove/demote the user in

      x-error-codes:

        '422':
        - COMMUNITY_ADMIN_FLAG_INVALID
      x-mutation-idempotency:

        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
    delete:
      tags:
      - Administration
      operationId: removeCommunityMember
      summary: Suspend community membership and revoke access across this community
      parameters:
      - *id005
      - *id006
      - *id004
      - name: userId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Community membership suspended; community-admin/default-coordinator flags cleared; all 
            Shared Workspace memberships suspended and pending workspace invitations revoked; community-scoped
            sessions, caches and realtime subscriptions invalidated.
          headers:
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-community-membership-policy: Soft-suspends rather than hard-deletes. If the user is the only ACTIVE 
        Owner of any Shared Workspace, return 409 COMMUNITY_MEMBER_IS_LAST_WORKSPACE_OWNER until ownership is 
        transferred/recovered. Workspace memberships retain role and task data but become SUSPENDED. Pending 
        workspace invitations addressed to the user are revoked. Reactivation of community membership does not
        auto-reactivate workspace memberships. Preserve access in other communities; do not globally log out 
        the user. Also revoke pending workspace invitations created by this user because inviter authority is 
        no longer active.
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_COMMUNITY_ADMIN
        '409':
        - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_IS_LAST_WORKSPACE_OWNER
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY

        invitation email after canonical normalization, or the exact targetUserId. Token is high-entropy, 
        single-use and looked up only by SHA-256 hash. Acceptance checks server time < expiresAt, PENDING 
        status, current community membership/tenant rules, invitation authority, active workspace/role and no 
        conflicting membership. Community acceptance creates ACTIVE CommunityMembership with 
        isCommunityAdmin=false and the invitation isDefaultCoordinator value. Workspace acceptance converts 
        the INVITED WorkspaceMembership to ACTIVE with the invited roleId. The transaction consumes the token,
        changes membership and writes audit/outbox events atomically. Unknown, consumed, revoked or 
        identity-mismatched tokens return the same generic 404; never reveal whether another user/email has an
        invitation. A valid target may receive an explicit terminal-state 409 after identity verification.
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
        '404':
        - INVITATION_NOT_FOUND
        '409':
        - INVITATION_EXPIRED
        - INVITATION_AUTHORITY_REVOKED
        - COMMUNITY_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED
        - MEMBERSHIP_ALREADY_EXISTS
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - INVITATION_NOT_ACCEPTABLE
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/{taskId}/mention-candidates:
    get:
      tags:
      - Collaboration
      operationId: listTaskMentionCandidates
      summary: Find eligible workspace members for a task mention
      description: Search only ACTIVE workspace members who currently have task:read access to this task. Does
        not search the community directory or other workspaces. Returns display name, avatar and userId only; 
        never email or membership metadata.
      parameters:

        schema:
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 80
      - name: limit
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 20
          default: 10
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Eligible task mention candidates
          headers:
            Cache-Control:

                type: string
                const: private, no-store

        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-comment-mention-policy: Require task:read and ACTIVE membership. Search is workspace-local. Exclude

        reparses and revalidates every mention token.

  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{sourceWorkspaceId}/saved-views/{viewId}/copy:
    post:
      tags:
      - Views
      operationId: copySavedView
      summary: Copy a saved view into another workspace in the same community
      description: Creates a new destination record; the source is untouched. Requires active membership and 
        task:read in both source and destination. Source PERSONAL is copyable only by its creator; source 
        SHARED is copyable by an active reader. Destination SHARED additionally requires 
        saved_view:manage_shared. Destination references/operators are revalidated atomically. A destination 
        outside the path community is indistinguishable from an inaccessible/unknown destination and returns 
        generic 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CommunityId'
      - name: sourceWorkspaceId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - name: viewId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CopySavedViewRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: New saved view created in destination workspace. X-Workspace-Seq is the TARGET 
            workspace sequence and is present only for SHARED destination scope.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private, non-cacheable response.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          description: Source/destination compatibility or projection validation failed.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewCopyIncompatibleProblem'
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      x-saved-view-authorization: Authorize source and destination independently within the path community. 
        Both require ACTIVE WorkspaceMembership and task:read. The source view must be visible to caller; 
        PERSONAL is creator-only. Destination SHARED requires saved_view:manage_shared. Community Admin or 
        break-glass does not override PERSONAL privacy.
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
        '404':
        - RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
        '409':
        - SAVED_VIEW_NAME_CONFLICT
        - SAVED_VIEW_COPY_SAME_WORKSPACE
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - SAVED_VIEW_COPY_INCOMPATIBLE
        - SAVED_VIEW_PROJECTION_INVALID
        - SAVED_VIEW_DISPLAY_OPTIONS_INVALID
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY

  /auth/email-verification/request:
    post:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: requestEmailVerification
      summary: Send or resend an email verification link
      description: Returns the same generic 202 response whether the address is unknown, already verified, 
        pending, or throttled by a hidden account-specific rule. Tokens are single-use and expire after 30 
        minutes.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        description: Address to verify; never echoed in response.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthEmailRequest'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Generic anti-enumeration response
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthActionAcceptedDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security: []
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
  /auth/email-verification/confirm:
    post:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: confirmEmailVerification
      summary: Verify an email address and establish a session
      description: Consumes one single-use 256-bit verification token, marks the address verified, and 
        establishes a fresh session. Token is stored hashed and is excluded from logs.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        description: One-time email verification token.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmailVerificationConfirmRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Email verified; a fresh session is established.
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a host-only opaque session cookie. The actual value is server-generated and 
                never appears in JSON.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-session=<opaque-random-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=1209600
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security: []
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        - AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE
      x-credential-replay-policy: Never persist or replay Set-Cookie, session identifiers or step-up grants. A
        matching duplicate returns 409 AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE; restart the auth/step-up flow with a fresh 
        X-Mutation-Id.

  /auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      summary: Consume a password-reset token and rotate credentials
      description: Consumes a single-use reset token, replaces the password hash, revokes all prior sessions, 
        and issues one new session to the recovering user. Does not reveal whether an address exists.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        description: Reset token and new password.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PasswordResetConfirmRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password reset completed; all earlier sessions are revoked.
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a host-only opaque session cookie. The actual value is server-generated and 
                never appears in JSON.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-session=<opaque-random-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=1209600
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      security: []
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        - AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE
      x-credential-replay-policy: Never persist or replay Set-Cookie, session identifiers or step-up grants. A
        matching duplicate returns 409 AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE; restart the auth/step-up flow with a fresh 
        X-Mutation-Id.
  /me/auth-identities:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: listMyAuthIdentities
      summary: List login methods linked to the current account
      description: Self-only. Returns provider type and link timestamp; never returns provider tokens, 
        password material, recovery tokens or other users’ identities.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Current account login methods
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthIdentityListDto'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
  /me/auth-identities/google/authorize:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: startGoogleIdentityLink
      summary: Begin linking a Google identity to the signed-in account
      description: Requires an authenticated session and recent step-up authentication (within 5 minutes). 
        Starts a separate PKCE/state/nonce flow bound to the current user and session. Never links by email 
        address alone.
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to Google authorization endpoint
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Never cache OAuth transactions.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a five-minute host-only OAuth browser-binding cookie; callback must clear it 
                after validating state.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-oauth-state=<opaque-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=300
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
  /me/auth-identities/google/callback:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: completeGoogleIdentityLink
      summary: Complete linking a verified Google identity
      description: Requires the same active session that initiated the link. Validates one-time state, PKCE, 
        nonce, issuer, audience and provider subject. A provider subject already linked to another account is 
        rejected; matching email never triggers automatic merging. Rotates the current session after success.
      parameters:
      - name: code
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          maxLength: 4096
      - name: state
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          minLength: 32
          maxLength: 512
      responses:
        '302':
          description: 'Redirect to validated same-origin application path The callback expires the __Host-oauth-state
            cookie and sends Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. The callback expires the __Host-oauth-state cookie and
            sends Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.'
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a host-only opaque session cookie. The actual value is server-generated and 
                never appears in JSON.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-session=<opaque-random-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=1209600
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            Referrer-Policy:
              description: Prevents OAuth callback code/state from being sent as a Referer.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-referrer
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
  /me/auth-identities/password:
    put:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: setOrChangePassword
      summary: Add or change the password login method
      description: Self-only, CSRF- and mutation-protected, and requires recent step-up authentication. If a 
        password is already linked, currentPassword is mandatory. For an account without a password, the 
        recent reauthentication challenge must be satisfied by its existing provider. Rotates the current 
        session and revokes other sessions.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        description: New password and current password when one already exists.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SetPasswordRequest'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Password updated; current session rotated and other sessions revoked.
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a host-only opaque session cookie. The actual value is server-generated and 
                never appears in JSON.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-session=<opaque-random-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=1209600
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        - AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE
      x-credential-replay-policy: Never persist or replay Set-Cookie, session identifiers or step-up grants. A
        matching duplicate returns 409 AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE; restart the auth/step-up flow with a fresh 
        X-Mutation-Id.
  /me/auth-identities/{provider}:
    delete:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: unlinkAuthIdentity
      summary: Unlink a login provider from the current account
      description: Self-only, CSRF- and mutation-protected, with recent step-up authentication. Rejected with 
        LAST_AUTH_PROVIDER when it would leave the account without a verified login method. Rotates current 
        session and revokes other sessions.
      parameters:
      - name: provider
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthProviderPath'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Identity unlinked; current session rotated.
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a host-only opaque session cookie. The actual value is server-generated and 
                never appears in JSON.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-session=<opaque-random-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=1209600
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
  /me/sessions:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: listMySessions
      summary: List the current user’s active sessions
      description: Self-only. Returns metadata only; never returns session cookies, tokens, full IP addresses 
        or secrets.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Active sessions for the current account
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionListDto'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
  /me/sessions/{sessionId}:
    delete:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: revokeMySession
      summary: Revoke one of the current user’s sessions
      description: Self-only. Revocation immediately invalidates the session, outstanding CSRF tokens and 
        realtime tickets and closes sockets across instances.
      parameters:
      - name: sessionId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: &id025
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session revoked.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Private response; must not be stored by browser, proxy, or shared cache.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
  /auth/reauthenticate:
    post:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: reauthenticateWithPassword
      summary: Reconfirm the current password for a sensitive account action
      description: Requires the active session and CSRF token. On success, records a five-minute server-side 
        step-up grant bound to this exact session. A password is never returned or logged; password-only 
        accounts use this route. Google-only accounts must use the Google reauthentication redirect flow.
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReauthenticateRequest'
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Step-up authentication succeeded for five minutes.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Never cache reauthentication results.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        '401': &id016
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403': *id016
        '429': *id016
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
      x-error-codes:
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        - AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE
      x-credential-replay-policy: Never persist or replay Set-Cookie, session identifiers or step-up grants. A
        matching duplicate returns 409 AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE; restart the auth/step-up flow with a fresh 
        X-Mutation-Id.
  /auth/oauth/google/reauth/start:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: startGoogleReauthentication
      summary: Start Google step-up reauthentication for an existing linked identity
      description: Requires the active session. Starts a new five-minute one-time PKCE/state/nonce transaction
        with prompt=login and max_age=0. This flow must authenticate the same Google provider subject already 
        linked to the current account; it does not link a new identity.
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to Google reauthentication
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Never cache OAuth transactions.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            Set-Cookie:
              description: Sets a five-minute host-only OAuth browser-binding cookie; callback must clear it 
                after validating state.
              schema:
                type: string
                example: __Host-oauth-state=<opaque-value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; 
                  Max-Age=300
        '401': *id016
        '409': *id016
  /auth/oauth/google/reauth/callback:
    get:
      tags:
      - Auth
      operationId: completeGoogleReauthentication
      summary: Complete Google step-up for the current session
      description: Requires the same active session that initiated the flow. Validates state, nonce, PKCE and 
        provider subject equality with the current account’s already-linked Google identity. Records a 
        five-minute step-up grant on success; rejects a different or unlinked Google identity.
      parameters:
      - name: code
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          maxLength: 4096
      - name: state
        in: query
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          minLength: 32
          maxLength: 512
      responses:
        '302':
          description: 'Redirect to validated same-origin application path The callback expires the __Host-oauth-state
            cookie and sends Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.'
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              description: Never cache OAuth callback material.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: private, no-store
            Referrer-Policy:
              description: Prevents OAuth callback code/state from being sent as a Referer.
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-referrer
        '400': *id016
        '401': *id016
        '409': *id016
  /health/live:
    get:
      tags:
      - Operations
      operationId: getHealthLive
      summary: Check process liveness
      description: 'Unauthenticated, tenant-neutral liveness probe. Return 200 {status: UP} when the process event
        loop is responsive. Do not query PostgreSQL or external dependencies here; orchestration may restart the
        process when this probe fails. Response contains no secrets or internal diagnostics.'
      security: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Process is live.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthLiveResponse'
      x-operations-probe: LIVENESS
  /health/ready:
    get:
      tags:
      - Operations
      operationId: getHealthReady
      summary: Check service readiness
      description: 'Unauthenticated, tenant-neutral readiness probe for the load balancer and external synthetic
        monitor. Execute SELECT 1 against PostgreSQL with a 2-second timeout and require a healthy outbox worker
        heartbeat no older than 30 seconds. Return 200 {status: UP} only when both checks pass; otherwise return
        generic 503 Problem Details with Retry-After. Do not disclose which dependency failed, hostnames, query
        text, credentials or tenant data. This probe does not replace deeper private metrics/diagnostics.'
      security: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Critical readiness dependencies are available.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthReadyResponse'
        '503':
          description: Service is not ready. Body is generic and contains no dependency details.
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema:
                type: string
                const: no-store
            Retry-After:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter'
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      x-operations-probe: READINESS
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/summary:
    get:
      tags:
      - Workspaces
      operationId: getWorkspaceSummary
      summary: Get workspace completion, overdue and assignee workload summary
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CommunityId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/WorkspaceId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Get workspace completion, overdue and assignee workload summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceSummaryDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
