        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
  /communities/{communityId}/workspace-templates:
    get:
      tags:
      - Workspaces
      operationId: listWorkspaceTemplates
      summary: List the three built-in Workspace setup templates
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CommunityId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Built-in setup templates; catalog is read-only.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateListDto'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Requires an active member of the requested Community. The returned catalog is immutable and
        contains GENERAL_PURPOSE, EVENT_PLANNING and TEAM_OPERATIONS. No custom template builder or 
        user-authored template API is included in this release.
      security:
      - sessionCookie: []
  /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/trash/tasks/{taskId}/purge:
    post:
      tags:
      - Trash
      operationId: purgeTrashedTaskTree
      summary: Permanently purge an eligible archived task tree
      parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/MutationId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CommunityId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/WorkspaceId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/TaskId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CsrfToken'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PurgeTaskRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Archived task subtree was permanently purged after explicit confirmation.
          headers:
            X-Workspace-Seq:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/WorkspaceSeq'
            X-Idempotent-Replayed:
              $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PurgeTaskResultDto'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
        '422':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'
      description: Owner-only, explicit, audited permanent purge of a fully archived task tree after its 
        30-day restorable window. All descendants are purged atomically; key aliases and minimal content-free 
        lineage tombstones remain. The route is DISABLED until DEC-OPEN-03 audit retention/legal-hold 
        authority and retention operation are approved; no automatic hard purge is permitted.
      x-authorization-policy: Requires active Workspace Owner and task:delete_permanent. This capability is 
        non-delegable to custom roles unless a future explicit security decision changes it.
      x-purge-policy: Purge the archived root and all archived descendants as one transaction. Require 
        recoverableUntil <= now, exact confirmationPhrase=PURGE and expectedTaskKey match. Retain immutable 
        key aliases and minimal content-free lineage tombstone. Reject while a legal/retention hold applies. 
        This endpoint remains feature-disabled until DEC-OPEN-03 is closed.
      x-error-codes:
        '403':
        - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
        - PURGE_POLICY_NOT_ENABLED
        '409':
        - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
        - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
        '422':
        - TASK_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PURGE
        - PURGE_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH
        - LEGAL_HOLD_ACTIVE
      x-mutation-idempotency:
        applies: true
        policy: '#/x-mutation-and-pagination-policy/idempotency'
        replayScope: GLOBAL_AUTHENTICATED_USER_OR_PREAUTH_CSRF_CONTEXT
        fingerprint: HTTP_METHOD_ROUTE_AND_CANONICAL_REQUEST_BODY
components:
  securitySchemes:
    sessionCookie:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: __Host-session
  parameters:
    CommunityId:
      name: communityId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    WorkspaceId:
      name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    TaskId:
      name: taskId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    MutationId:
      name: X-Mutation-Id
      in: header
      required: true
      description: Required UUIDv7 idempotency key for state-changing POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE operations. 
        Namespace is account-global for authenticated users and pre-auth-CSRF-context scoped for 
        unauthenticated flows. Read-only POST operations and the single-use realtime ticket issuance operation
        are explicitly exempt by the contract policy.
      schema:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    CsrfToken:
      name: X-CSRF-Token
      in: header
      required: true
      description: Session-bound synchronizer token for cookie-authenticated mutations, or short-lived 
        pre-authentication token for login, registration, email verification, and password recovery. Send only
        in this header; never in a URL.
      schema:
        type: string
        minLength: 16
        maxLength: 512
    MutationCreatedAt:
      name: X-Mutation-Created-At
      in: header
      required: false
      description: RFC 3339 timestamp written when the client queued an offline task-field mutation. Required 
        only when replaying an offline-queued PATCH task-field edit; omitted for normal online mutations. A 
        future timestamp more than five minutes ahead is rejected. Not used for authorization or 
        field-conflict decisions.
      schema:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  headers:
    WorkspaceSeq:
      description: Monotonic sequence for this workspace stream.
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
    IdempotentReplayed:
      description: Present only when this response is a replay of a completed X-Mutation-Id result.
      schema:
        type: string
        const: 'true'
    RetryAfter:
      description: Retry delay in seconds. Present on IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS responses; absent on 
        other conflicts.
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[0-9]+$
  responses:
    Problem:
      description: RFC 9457 Problem Details
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      headers:
        X-Idempotent-Replayed:
          $ref: '#/components/headers/IdempotentReplayed'
        Retry-After:
          $ref: '#/components/headers/RetryAfter'
  schemas:
    Uuid:
      type: string
      format: uuid
      pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$
    NullableUuid:
      oneOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - type: 'null'
    Problem:
      type: object
      required:
      - type
      - title
      - status
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri-reference
        code:
          type: string
        traceId:
          type: string
        conflictingFields:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        failedTasks:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - taskId
            - code
            properties:
              taskId:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              code:
                type: string
              detail:
                type: string
        retryable:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether the same exact request may be retried without changing its X-Mutation-Id.
        retryAfterMs:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Suggested retry delay in milliseconds when retryable is true.
      additionalProperties: true
    ConflictProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - conflictingFields
        properties:
          conflictingFields:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
            minItems: 1
          currentFieldRevisions:
            type: object
            additionalProperties:
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
          conflictDetails:
            type: array
            description: Structured conflict values for fields the caller is currently authorized to 
              edit/read. Each entry corresponds to a field path listed in conflictingFields.
            items:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - fieldPath
              - clientValue
              - serverValue
              - baseRevision
              - currentRevision
              properties:
                fieldPath:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 1
                clientValue:
                  description: Submitted value for this field; JSON value of the field’s declared type.
                serverValue:
                  description: Current server value for this field; JSON value of the field’s declared type.
                baseRevision:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
                currentRevision:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
    PageInfo:
      type: object
      required:
      - nextCursor
      properties:
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    RegisterRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - email
      - password
      - displayName
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 254
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 12
          maxLength: 1024
        displayName:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - email
      - password
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 1024
    SessionDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - userId
      - expiresAt
      - csrfToken
      properties:
        userId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        csrfToken:
          type: string
          minLength: 16
          maxLength: 512
    UserSummary:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - displayName
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        displayName:
          type: string
        avatarUrl:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: uri
    CommunityMembershipDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - communityId
      - name
      - membershipStatus
      - isCommunityAdmin
      - isDefaultCoordinator
      properties:
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
        membershipStatus:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ACTIVE
          - SUSPENDED
          description: Real community membership state. Pending email invitations are represented by 
            CommunityInvitationDto.
        isCommunityAdmin:
          type: boolean
          description: Community-scoped administrator flag. It is false whenever membershipStatus=SUSPENDED 
            and is never a workspace role.
        isDefaultCoordinator:
          type: boolean
          description: Community Default Coordinator pool flag. It is false whenever 
            membershipStatus=SUSPENDED and affects only future Shared Workspace creation.
    MeContextDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - user
      - communities
      properties:
        user:
          allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'
          - type: object
            required:
            - email
            properties:
              email:
                type: string
                format: email
        communities:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommunityMembershipDto'
    ActiveCommunityDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - activeCommunityId
      properties:
        activeCommunityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    SetActiveCommunityRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - communityId
      properties:
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    WorkspaceKind:
      type: string
      enum:
      - PERSONAL
      - SHARED
    TaskEditPolicy:
      type: string
      enum:
      - CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT
      - COLLABORATIVE_MEMBER
    WorkspaceDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - communityId
      - name
      - kind
      - ownerIds
      - taskEditPolicy
      - personalWorkspaceAdminPolicy
      - createdAt
      - updatedAt
      - coordinatorCanInviteMembers
      - keyPrefix
      - maxSubtaskDepth
      - assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed
      - assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
        kind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceKind'
        ownerIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          minItems: 1
        taskEditPolicy:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskEditPolicy'
          default: CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT
        personalWorkspaceAdminPolicy:
          type: string
          enum:
          - AUDITED_BREAK_GLASS
        coordinatorCanInviteMembers:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: Owner-controlled. When true, the built-in Coordinator role may invite/add only built-in
            MEMBER or VIEWER roles. It does not grant member removal, arbitrary role assignment, Owner 
            promotion or role-definition management.
        myRole:
          type: string
          enum:
          - OWNER
          - COORDINATOR
          - MEMBER
          - CUSTOM
          - VIEWER
          description: Built-in role category or CUSTOM; use roleId/systemKey for stable workspace-role 
            identity where supplied by membership DTOs.
        effectiveCapabilities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        archivedAt:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date-time
        keyPrefix:
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 10
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$
          description: Canonical uppercase Workspace task-key prefix. Prefixes are unique across all current 
            and historical namespaces within one Community and are never reassigned. The sequence is atomic, 
            Workspace-local, monotonically increasing, never reset and never reused. An active Workspace Owner
            may rename the prefix; rename atomically re-keys current display keys while retaining each task 
            numeric sequence and inserting immutable aliases for all old keys.
        maxSubtaskDepth:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 2
          default: 1
          description: Owner-confirmed Workspace-level maximum parent-child depth. Default 1 (a task may have 
            one subtask level); maximum 2 (one additional nested level). Reducing the value is rejected 
            atomically when an existing tree exceeds it.
        assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Workspace Owner-controlled delegation ceiling. Only these additional task-definition 
            field groups may be granted to active assignees on individual tasks. Default is empty.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
          default: []
        assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Workspace Owner-controlled initial grant set for newly created tasks. Must be a subset 
            of assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed. Existing tasks are not changed when this default changes.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
          default: []
        appliedTemplateKey:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateKey'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Built-in template used at initial Workspace creation, or null for a Workspace created 
            without a template.
        appliedTemplateVersion:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
          minimum: 1
          description: Immutable template catalog version applied at creation; later edits do not rewrite this
            provenance.
    WorkspaceListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      - nextCursor
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    CreateWorkspaceRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      - kind
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        kind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceKind'
        coordinatorUserIds:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Optional selected subset of the current active Community Default Coordinator pool for 
            SHARED workspace creation. Omitted means all defaults; empty means none. PERSONAL workspaces must 
            omit or send an empty array.
        keyPrefix:
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 10
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$
          description: Optional Workspace task-key prefix. If omitted, the backend proposes and atomically 
            reserves a Community-unique canonical prefix. Current and historical prefixes are never reassigned
            within that Community.
        maxSubtaskDepth:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 2
          default: 1
          description: Optional maximum parent-child depth for tasks in this Workspace. Defaults to 1; the 
            Owner may later raise it to 2.
        templateKey:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateKey'
          default: GENERAL_PURPOSE
          description: Optional built-in Workspace setup template. Omission applies GENERAL_PURPOSE. Template 
            application seeds configuration only, never tasks, members, invitations, assignments or elevated 
            permissions.
    UpdateWorkspaceSettingsRequest:
      type: object
      minProperties: 1
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        taskEditPolicy:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskEditPolicy'
          description: Workspace Owner only. CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT is the default; COLLABORATIVE_MEMBER 
            is the explicit broader editing mode.
        coordinatorCanInviteMembers:
          type: boolean
          description: Workspace Owner only. Defaults true. Controls the built-in Coordinator invitation 
            exception; when true Coordinators can invite/add only built-in MEMBER or VIEWER roles.
        maxSubtaskDepth:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 2
          description: Workspace Owner only. Allowed range 1–2. A reduction is rejected atomically with 
            MAX_SUBTASK_DEPTH_BELOW_CURRENT_TREE if any existing task tree would exceed the requested limit; 
            no task is silently reparented or deleted.
        assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Workspace Owner only. Sets the maximum additional task-definition field groups that 
            Task Creators may delegate to active assignees on individual tasks. Removing a group immediately 
            removes its effective grant from every task; the stored task selection is retained and becomes 
            effective again only while the group remains allowed.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
        assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Workspace Owner only. Default additional assignee field groups for newly created tasks;
            must be a subset of assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed. Changes do not rewrite existing tasks.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
        keyPrefix:
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 10
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$
          description: Workspace Owner only. Renames the Workspace prefix atomically. The new prefix must be 
            unused in the Community across current and historical prefix reservations. Every active task 
            receives the new display key using its existing numeric sequence; each old key is retained as an 
            immutable alias. Sequence values are not reset. Prefix reservation, current-key rewrite, alias 
            insertions, audit record and workspace event commit together.
    WorkspaceMemberDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - user
      - roleId
      - roleName
      - roleSystemKey
      - membershipStatus
      - isDefaultCoordinator
      properties:
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'
        roleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        roleName:
          type: string
        roleSystemKey:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          enum:
          - OWNER
          - COORDINATOR
          - MEMBER
          - VIEWER
          - 
          description: Stable built-in role key; null when roleId references a custom workspace role. Display 
            name is presentation-only.
        membershipStatus:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ACTIVE
          - INVITED
          - SUSPENDED
          description: ACTIVE has workspace access; INVITED has no access until the matching invitation is 
            accepted; SUSPENDED has no access until an authorized Owner/member-manager restores it.
        isDefaultCoordinator:
          type: boolean
          description: Snapshot metadata indicating this membership was pre-included from the community 
            Default Coordinator pool at workspace creation. It is not a capability or live role source; 
            current roleId/systemKey controls workspace authority.
        effectiveCapabilities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'
    WorkspaceMemberListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceMemberDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    UpdateWorkspaceMemberRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      minProperties: 1
      properties:
        roleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        membershipStatus:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ACTIVE
          - SUSPENDED
    TransferWorkspaceOwnershipRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - newOwnerId
      properties:
        newOwnerId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        callerDisposition:
          type: string
          enum:
          - KEEP_OWNER
          - DEMOTE
          - LEAVE
          default: KEEP_OWNER
          description: Optional disposition for the caller after newOwnerId is promoted; defaults to 
            KEEP_OWNER.
        callerNewRoleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Required when callerDisposition=DEMOTE; must resolve to a delegable non-OWNER role.
      description: Promote an ACTIVE or SUSPENDED existing workspace member whose CommunityMembership is 
        ACTIVE and optionally demote or suspend the caller in one transaction. A SUSPENDED target is 
        reactivated atomically as OWNER. The new owner must not be an INVITED membership. callerNewRoleId is 
        required only for DEMOTE.
    ArchiveRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        reason:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
    RestoreRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        reason:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
    BreakGlassReasonCategory:
      type: string
      description: Closed set of permitted reasons for reading another user's Personal Workspace.
      enum:
      - ACTIVE_SECURITY_INCIDENT
      - SAFETY_OR_ABUSE_REPORT
    BreakGlassRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - reasonCategory
      - reason
      - requestedDurationMinutes
      - confirmation
      properties:
        requestedDurationMinutes:
          type: integer
          enum:
          - 15
          - 30
          - 60
          default: 15
          description: Shortest sufficient duration; the UI should default to 15 minutes.
        reasonCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassReasonCategory'
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 15
          maxLength: 2000
          description: Backend trims input and requires at least 15 non-whitespace characters. This encrypted 
            justification is not copied into audit metadata.
        caseReference:
          type: string
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 100
          description: Optional incident or ticket reference, stored in the restricted grant record and never 
            in audit metadata; it is not a legal authorization.
        confirmation:
          const: true
    BreakGlassRenewalRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - reasonCategory
      - reason
      - confirmation
      properties:
        reasonCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassReasonCategory'
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 15
          maxLength: 2000
          description: Fresh justification; must explain why the originally requested duration was 
            insufficient.
        caseReference:
          type: string
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 100
        confirmation:
          const: true
    BreakGlassRenewalDecisionRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - decision
      properties:
        decision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - APPROVE
          - REJECT
    BreakGlassGrantDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - grantId
      - workspaceId
      - grantedByUserId
      - grantedAt
      - expiresAt
      - durationMinutes
      - accessMode
      - scope
      - renewalAllowed
      - auditEventId
      - ownerNotificationQueued
      - communityAdminNotificationQueued
      properties:
        grantId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantedByUserId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        durationMinutes:
          type: integer
          enum:
          - 15
          - 30
          - 60
        accessMode:
          const: READ_ONLY
        scope:
          const: SINGLE_PERSONAL_WORKSPACE
        renewalAllowed:
          const: true
          description: Only one 30-minute extension may be requested and requires another Community Admin's 
            approval.
        auditEventId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        ownerNotificationQueued:
          const: true
        communityAdminNotificationQueued:
          const: true
    BreakGlassGrantSummaryDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - grantId
      - grantedByUserId
      - grantedAt
      - expiresAt
      - status
      - accessMode
      properties:
        grantId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantedByUserId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          const: ACTIVE
        accessMode:
          const: READ_ONLY
    BreakGlassGrantListDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          maxItems: 1
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassGrantSummaryDto'
    BreakGlassRenewalRequestDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - grantId
      - status
      - extensionMinutes
      - approvalRequired
      properties:
        grantId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        status:
          const: PENDING_APPROVAL
        extensionMinutes:
          const: 30
        approvalRequired:
          const: true
    BreakGlassRenewalDecisionDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - grantId
      - decision
      - expiresAt
      - auditEventId
      properties:
        grantId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        decision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - APPROVED
          - REJECTED
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Unchanged on rejection; extended by 30 minutes on approval, never beyond 90 minutes 
            from initial grant.
        auditEventId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    MilestoneDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - workspaceId
      - name
      - targetDate
      - createdAt
      - updatedAt
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        targetDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    MilestoneListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/MilestoneDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    CreateMilestoneRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        description:
          type: string
          maxLength: 5000
        targetDate:
          type: string
          format: date
    UpdateMilestoneRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      minProperties: 1
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 5000
        targetDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
    TaskType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - TASK
      - DELIVERABLE
      - BUG
      - DECISION
    TaskStatusCategory:
      type: string
      enum:
      - BACKLOG
      - TODO
      - IN_PROGRESS
      - DONE
      - CANCELED
    TaskPriority:
      type: string
      enum:
      - LOW
      - MEDIUM
      - HIGH
      - URGENT
      - NONE
    TaskPermissions:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - canEditTitleDescription
      - canEditDatesPriority
      - canEditCustomFieldsLinks
      - canEditEstimate
      - canUpdateStatus
      - canRequestSignoff
      - canApproveSignoff
      - canAssign
      - canManageSubtasks
      - canCreateSubtask
      - canMove
      - canComment
      - canWatch
      - canArchive
      - canRestore
      - canDeletePermanent
      - restrictedActions
      - canManageAssigneeFieldGrants
      properties:
        canEditTitleDescription:
          type: boolean
          description: Edit title, description and itemType.
        canEditDatesPriority:
          type: boolean
          description: Edit startDate, dueDate and priority.
        canEditCustomFieldsLinks:
          type: boolean
          description: Edit customFieldValues, labelIds, milestoneId and task links. Applies to task value 
            changes; custom-field definition/option administration separately requires 
            workspace:manage_custom_fields.
        canEditEstimate:
          type: boolean
          description: Edit estimatePoints.
        canUpdateStatus:
          type: boolean
          description: Transition statusCategory, subject to any enabled sign-off gate.
        canRequestSignoff:
          type: boolean
          description: Request a transition sign-off where a Phase 3 gated status is enabled.
        canApproveSignoff:
          type: boolean
          description: Approve/reject a requested Phase 3 status sign-off.
        canAssign:
          type: boolean
          description: Add or remove task assignees.
        canManageSubtasks:
          type: boolean
          description: Edit, reorder or complete existing descendants within hierarchy rules.
        canCreateSubtask:
          type: boolean
          description: Create a child under this task; also requires remaining workspace depth and active 
            workspace state.
        canMove:
          type: boolean
          description: Move/reorder this task within the current authorized workspace. Cross-workspace moves 
            additionally require target task:create.
        canComment:
          type: boolean
        canWatch:
          type: boolean
        canArchive:
          type: boolean
        canRestore:
          type: boolean
        canDeletePermanent:
          type: boolean
          description: Owner-only permanent purge; never delegated through a custom role.
        restrictedActions:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPermissionRestrictionDto'
          description: Optional actor-facing reason for actions whose boolean is false. Absence does not imply
            future authorization.
        canManageAssigneeFieldGrants:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this actor may configure assigneeEditableFieldGroups on this task. True for the
            active Task Creator and active Workspace Owners only. This controls permission metadata, not 
            ordinary task-field editing.
      description: Required actor-specific permission projection. Every boolean is computed by the backend 
        from live membership, role capabilities, workspace policy and task relationships. It is never accepted
        from a client and must not be shared across users.
    TaskDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - workspaceId
      - taskKey
      - title
      - itemType
      - statusCategory
      - priority
      - creatorId
      - assigneeIds
      - version
      - fieldRevisions
      - effectivePermissions
      - createdAt
      - updatedAt
      - assigneeAssignments
      - assigneeEditableFieldGroups
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        parentTaskId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Parent identifier is returned only when the caller is authorized to read the parent 
            task; otherwise the response uses null to avoid disclosing an inaccessible ancestor.
        taskKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[1-9][0-9]*$
        title:
          type: string
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        itemType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskType'
        statusCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
        priority:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPriority'
        assigneeIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          uniqueItems: true
          description: Convenience projection of assigneeAssignments.userId; unique within this task.
        creatorId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Task creator identity; a contextual task-definition grant applies only while the actor 
            retains active access to this workspace.
        startDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
        dueDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
        estimatePoints:
          type:
          - number
          - 'null'
          minimum: 0
        labelIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        milestoneId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        rankKey:
          type: string
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        fieldRevisions:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
          description: Map of canonical field paths to monotonically increasing per-field revision counters. 
            Custom field value keys use customFieldValues.{definitionId}; task-level assignee delegation 
            changes use assigneeEditableFieldGroups.
        effectivePermissions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPermissions'
          description: Computed for the authenticated actor and current task context. Never trust 
            client-submitted flags or cache across users.
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        archivedAt:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date-time
        customFieldValues:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskCustomFieldValuesDto'
        assigneeAssignments:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskAssigneeAssignmentList'
        assigneeEditableFieldGroups:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Task-specific additional field groups delegated to all active assignees by the Task 
            Creator or a Workspace Owner. Effective rights are always intersected with the current Workspace 
            ceiling and recomputed by the server.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
      description: Canonical task response. effectivePermissions and assignment provenance are 
        actor/context-sensitive. statusCategory is the active API status dimension.
    CreateTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - title
      properties:
        parentTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
        description:
          type: string
          maxLength: 20000
        itemType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskType'
        statusCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
        priority:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPriority'
        assigneeIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          uniqueItems: true
          description: Distinct active workspace member UUIDs. The server creates/removes assignment relations
            and records assignedByUserId from the authenticated actor; clients cannot set assignment 
            provenance.
        startDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        dueDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        estimatePoints:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
        labelIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        milestoneId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        customFieldValues:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskCustomFieldValuesCreate'
        assigneeEditableFieldGroups:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Optional per-task assignee field grants. If omitted, the Workspace default is applied. 
            If supplied, the values must be a subset of the Workspace allowed ceiling. The authenticated 
            creator configures this task-specific subset.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
      description: Task creation. Every assignee must be an active member of the selected workspace. Each 
        assignment relation records the authenticated creator as assignedByUserId. Initial customFieldValues 
        may be supplied under task:create; the server validates workspace definition IDs, scalar types, active
        option IDs and all active required definitions.
    UpdateTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - baseFieldRevisions
      minProperties: 2
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 20000
        itemType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskType'
        statusCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
        priority:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPriority'
        startDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
        dueDate:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date
        estimatePoints:
          type:
          - number
          - 'null'
          minimum: 0
        assigneeIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          uniqueItems: true
          description: Distinct active workspace member UUIDs. The server creates/removes assignment relations
            and records assignedByUserId from the authenticated actor; clients cannot set assignment 
            provenance.
        labelIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        milestoneId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        baseFieldRevisions:
          type: object
          minProperties: 1
          additionalProperties:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
          description: Include the current revision for every changed field. Custom-field paths use 
            customFieldValues.{definitionId}; assignee grant changes use assigneeEditableFieldGroups. Only 
            supplied values change. A conflict rejects the full patch.
        rankPlacement:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/RankPlacement'
        customFieldValues:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskCustomFieldValuesPatch'
        assigneeEditableFieldGroups:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Optional per-task assignee field grant update. Only the Task Creator or an active 
            Workspace Owner may change it. Values must be a subset of the current Workspace allowed ceiling. 
            Include baseFieldRevisions.assigneeEditableFieldGroups for optimistic concurrency.
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 3
      description: Atomic field patch. Every supplied field is separately authorized using the matching 
        TaskPermissions action; if any field is unauthorized, the entire request is rejected with 403 and no 
        field is changed. assigneeIds replacement maintains per-assignee provenance server-side. 
        customFieldValues is a partial map keyed by definition ID; null clears one field, omission preserves 
        it. Each changed custom field requires its own baseFieldRevisions entry 
        customFieldValues.{definitionId}; server validates active definition/type/option and required 
        constraints.
    RankPlacement:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        afterTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        beforeTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    ViewQuerySpec:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - filter
      properties:
        filter:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterGroup'
        groupBy:
          type: string
          enum:
          - statusCategory
          - priority
          - assigneeId
          - milestoneId
          - none
          default: statusCategory
        subGroupBy:
          type: string
          enum:
          - none
          - assigneeId
          - priority
          default: none
        sortBy:
          type: array
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/QuerySortTerm'
          description: Up to three user sort terms. The server always appends id ASC as a deterministic 
            tie-breaker; id is not a caller-sortable field.
        subtaskMode:
          type: string
          enum:
          - NESTED
          - TOP_LEVEL_ONLY
          - FLATTENED
          default: NESTED
        includeBacklog:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: False places BACKLOG tasks in a separately paged tray; true includes them in primary 
            results.
        includeCompleted:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: False excludes DONE and CANCELED tasks from every projection.
        dateWindow:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryDateWindow'
      description: Canonical projection-independent query AST stored in saved views. A projection is supplied 
        separately to the query endpoint.
    TaskQueryResult:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - projection
      - pageScope
      - querySnapshotId
      - snapshotSequence
      - snapshotAt
      - snapshotExpiresAt
      - items
      - total
      - primaryCount
      - backlogCount
      - backlogPreview
      - backlogNextCursor
      - unscheduledCount
      - unscheduledPreview
      - unscheduledNextCursor
      - nextCursor
      - groups
      - dependencyEdges
      properties:
        projection:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
        pageScope:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PRIMARY
          - GROUP
          - BACKLOG
          - UNSCHEDULED
        groupKey:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        querySnapshotId:
          type: string
          minLength: 16
          maxLength: 128
          description: Opaque snapshot handle bound to principal, community, workspace and canonical query; 
            expires at snapshotExpiresAt and is never an authorization token.
        snapshotSequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Workspace event sequence watermark captured at snapshot creation; newer events trigger 
            client invalidation/refetch.
        snapshotAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        snapshotExpiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Fixed absolute expiry timestamp exactly 900 seconds after snapshot creation; page 
            fetches and projection switches do not extend it.
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
          maxItems: 200
          description: 'Selected page rows: primary records for LIST/CALENDAR/TIMELINE, selected group/tray rows
            for GROUP/BACKLOG/UNSCHEDULED; BOARD PRIMARY uses groups.'
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Distinct canonical task IDs across primary, backlog and unscheduled partitions in the 
            snapshot. Do not sum group totals when assignee grouping overlaps.
        primaryCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Distinct task IDs in the primary partition after backlog and unscheduled separation.
        backlogCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Distinct task IDs in the backlog tray; zero when includeBacklog=true.
        backlogPreview:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
          maxItems: 20
        backlogNextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        unscheduledCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Distinct unscheduled task IDs in the unscheduled tray; zero when no dateWindow or 
            includeUnscheduled=false.
        unscheduledPreview:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
          maxItems: 20
        unscheduledNextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        groups:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskQueryBucketDto'
        dependencyEdges:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskQueryDependencyEdgeDto'
      description: Task rows are live at page-fetch time; membership, order, bucket assignment and counts are 
        snapshot-stable. Realtime changes after snapshotSequence invalidate the client query. Workspace 
        milestone markers are obtained from the milestones resource and are excluded from task totals.
    TaskKeyResolutionDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - taskId
      - workspaceId
      - requestedKey
      - currentKey
      - resolvedFromAlias
      - lifecycleState
      - archivedAt
      - recoverableUntil
      properties:
        taskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Current workspace after following the immutable lineage pointer.
        requestedKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[A-Z0-9]+$
          description: The key from the request path.
        currentKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[1-9][0-9]*$
          description: The canonical current key; returned only after current-workspace authorization.
        resolvedFromAlias:
          type: boolean
        lifecycleState:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ACTIVE
          - ARCHIVED
        archivedAt:
          oneOf:
          - type: string
            format: date-time
          - type: 'null'
        recoverableUntil:
          oneOf:
          - type: string
            format: date-time
          - type: 'null'
          description: Null while active or when no recovery deadline applies. Expiry alone is not proof of 
            permanent purge.
      description: Returned only after task:read authorization against the task lineage current workspace. The
        internal taskLineageId and historical origin workspace are never exposed.
    MoveTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - targetWorkspaceId
      - targetParentTaskId
      properties:
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetParentTaskId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: 'For same-Workspace reparenting, the destination parent may be another authorized task in
            the same Workspace or null. For cross-Workspace NAMES_ONLY transfer, this MUST be null: the transferred
            root is always created at the destination Workspace top level. Descendant structure/order is retained.'
        previewId:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          minLength: 20
          maxLength: 512
          description: Required for cross-workspace transfer and Personal-to-Shared; short-lived, actor- and 
            subtree-bound preview handle.
        confirmedPersonalToSharedTransfer:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: Must be true only after the caller reviewed the preview for a Personal-to-Shared 
            transfer.
    TaskMoveResultDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - transferId
      - mode
      - rootTask
      - movedTaskCount
      - sourceWorkspaceId
      - targetWorkspaceId
      - sourceWorkspaceSeq
      - targetWorkspaceSeq
      - previousRootKey
      - currentRootKey
      - aliasesCreated
      properties:
        transferId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        mode:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PRESERVE_IN_PLACE
          - NAMES_ONLY
        rootTask:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
        movedTaskCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        sourceWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        sourceWorkspaceSeq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        targetWorkspaceSeq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        previousRootKey:
          type: string
        currentRootKey:
          type: string
        aliasesCreated:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        idMapping:
          type: array
          description: Returned only to the initiating actor after authorization; maps source IDs to fresh 
            destination IDs for NAMES_ONLY transfer.
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required:
            - sourceTaskId
            - targetTaskId
            - previousKey
            - currentKey
            properties:
              sourceTaskId:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              targetTaskId:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              previousKey:
                type: string
              currentKey:
                type: string
    CloneTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        includeSubtasks:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        titleSuffix:
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
    ArchiveTaskResultDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - taskId
      - undoToken
      - undoExpiresAt
      - trashExpiresAt
      properties:
        taskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        undoToken:
          type: string
          minLength: 32
        undoExpiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        trashExpiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Timestamp exactly 30 days after archive, when the normal restore window ends. Expiry 
            does not trigger automatic hard purge.
    RestoreTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        undoToken:
          type: string
          minLength: 32
    TrashedTaskDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - task
      - archivedAt
      - recoverableUntil
      properties:
        task:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
        archivedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        recoverableUntil:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Exactly 30 days after archivedAt. After this time restore is no longer guaranteed; the 
            item remains archived until an explicit, audited Owner purge after DEC-OPEN-03 is approved.
        archivedByUserId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    TrashedTaskListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      - nextCursor
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrashedTaskDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    BulkTaskMutationRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - taskIds
      - action
      properties:
        taskIds:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 100
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        action:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ARCHIVE
          - SET_STATUS
          - SET_PRIORITY
          - ASSIGN
          - UNASSIGN
        statusCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
        priority:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskPriority'
        assigneeId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    BulkTaskResultDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - updatedTaskIds
      - workspaceSeq
      properties:
        updatedTaskIds:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceSeq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    TaskLinkDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - sourceTaskId
      - targetTaskId
      - type
      - createdAt
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        sourceTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - BLOCKS
          - IS_BLOCKED_BY
          - RELATES_TO
          - DUPLICATES
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        targetAccessible:
          type: boolean
        targetKey:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        targetTitle:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        targetStatusCategory:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
          - type: 'null'
    TaskLinkListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskLinkDto'
    CreateTaskLinkRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - targetTaskId
      - type
      properties:
        targetTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - BLOCKS
          - IS_BLOCKED_BY
          - RELATES_TO
          - DUPLICATES
    CreateCommentRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - body
      properties:
        body:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20000
          description: Raw Markdown source. Mention references use the editor token @[label](user:<uuid>); 
            client labels/IDs are untrusted and server-resolved. No separate mentionedUserIds field is 
            accepted.
        parentCommentId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Optional parent comment. Must be an undeleted comment on the same task; thread depth is
            bounded by CR-08.
    CommentDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - id
      - taskId
      - authorId
      - author
      - parentCommentId
      - body
      - bodyAst
      - mentions
      - createdAt
      - editedAt
      - deletedAt
      - isDeleted
      - version
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        taskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        authorId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        author:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentActorDto'
        parentCommentId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        body:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          description: Original Markdown source while active; null after soft deletion.
        bodyAst:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentMarkdownAst'
          - type: 'null'
        mentions:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentMentionDto'
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        editedAt:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date-time
        deletedAt:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date-time
        isDeleted:
          type: boolean
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    TaskActivityDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - comments
      - activity
      properties:
        comments:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentDto'
        activity:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ActivityEntryDto'
    ActivityEntryDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - eventType
      - occurredAt
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        eventType:
          type: string
        actor:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'
          - type: 'null'
        occurredAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        summary:
          type: string
        fieldChanges:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - field
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              before: {}
              after: {}
    SetWatchStatusRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - watching
      properties:
        watching:
          type: boolean
    SavedViewDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - workspaceId
      - name
      - scope
      - viewType
      - querySpec
      - version
      - createdAt
      - updatedAt
      - createdById
      - displayOptions
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
          description: Trimmed and Unicode NFKC-normalized; uniqueness is case-insensitive within the 
            scope-specific namespace.
        scope:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PERSONAL
          - SHARED
        viewType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
          description: Saved projection selection; not embedded in the shared querySpec AST.
        querySpec:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ViewQuerySpec'
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        createdById:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Immutable original creator identity; used for PERSONAL visibility and the narrow 
            original-creator SHARED update exception.
        displayOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDisplayOptions'
      additionalProperties: false
      description: Saved view metadata and canonical query snapshot. PERSONAL view fields are returned only to
        createdById; SHARED views are returned only to active workspace members with task:read.
    SavedViewListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDto'
    SaveViewRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      - scope
      - viewType
      - querySpec
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        scope:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PERSONAL
          - SHARED
        viewType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
          description: Saved projection selection; not embedded in the shared querySpec AST.
        querySpec:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ViewQuerySpec'
        displayOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDisplayOptions'
          default: {}
          description: Optional presentation-only preferences; Board options are valid only for viewType 
            BOARD.
      description: Create a PERSONAL or SHARED view. The server Unicode NFKC-normalizes name, enforces 
        scope-specific uniqueness and validates viewType/querySpec/displayOptions together.
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            viewType:
              not:
                const: BOARD
          required:
          - viewType
        then:
          properties:
            displayOptions:
              not:
                required:
                - board
    UpdateSavedViewRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - version
      minProperties: 2
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        querySpec:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ViewQuerySpec'
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        viewType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
          description: Optional saved projection update; querySpec remains projection-independent.
        displayOptions:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/SavedViewDisplayOptions'
          description: Optional presentation-only settings; validated against the effective stored viewType 
            after applying this PATCH.
      description: Partial update with required optimistic version. scope and createdById are immutable. The 
        server validates the effective viewType/querySpec/displayOptions combination before writing.
    RolePreviewRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - roleId
      properties:
        roleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    RolePreviewDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - roleId
      - roleName
      - capabilities
      - previewOnly
      properties:
        roleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        roleName:
          type: string
        capabilities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'
        previewOnly:
          const: true
    WorkspaceStreamEvent:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - schemaVersion
      - stream
      - communityId
      - workspaceId
      - workspaceSeq
      - eventId
      - eventType
      - occurredAt
      - actorId
      - entityId
      - mutationId
      - payload
      properties:
        schemaVersion:
          const: 1
        stream:
          const: workspace
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        workspaceSeq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        eventId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        eventType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - workspace.restored
          - task.created
          - task.updated
          - task.archived
          - task.restored
          - task.moved
          - task.linked
          - task.unlinked
          - comment.created
          - comment.updated
          - comment.deleted
          - watcher.changed
          - workspace.created
          - workspace.updated
          - workspace.archived
          - workspace.settings_updated
          - saved_view.created
          - saved_view.updated
          - saved_view.deleted
          - member.added
          - member.updated
          - member.removed
          - milestone.created
          - milestone.updated
          - milestone.deleted
          - task.bulk_updated
          - member.invitation_created
          - member.invitation_revoked
          - member.invitation_expired
          - custom_field.schema_changed
          - task.custom_fields_updated
        occurredAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        actorId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        mutationId:
          description: Originating X-Mutation-Id; null for system work without a client-originated mutation.
          anyOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        entityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        payload:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          description: Permission-filtered delta. Custom-field schema/value events are closed, ID/version-only
            invalidation payloads; never include option labels or task custom-field values.
          properties:
            transferId:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
            side:
              type: string
              enum:
              - SOURCE
              - TARGET
            movedTaskCount:
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
            rootTaskId:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: task.moved
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              required:
              - transferId
              - side
              - movedTaskCount
              - rootTaskId
              additionalProperties: false
              properties:
                transferId:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
                side:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                  - SOURCE
                  - TARGET
                movedTaskCount:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 1
                rootTaskId:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              enum:
              - saved_view.created
              - saved_view.updated
              - saved_view.deleted
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - viewId
              - version
              - scope
              properties:
                viewId:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
                version:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 1
                scope:
                  const: SHARED
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: custom_field.schema_changed
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - fieldId
              - version
              - changeType
              properties:
                fieldId: *id017
                version:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 1
                changeType:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                  - FIELD_CREATED
                  - FIELD_UPDATED
                  - FIELD_ARCHIVED
                  - FIELD_RESTORED
                  - OPTION_CREATED
                  - OPTION_UPDATED
                  - OPTION_ARCHIVED
                  - OPTION_RESTORED
                  - OPTIONS_REORDERED
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: task.custom_fields_updated
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - taskId
              - taskVersion
              - fieldDefinitionIds
              properties:
                taskId: *id017
                taskVersion:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 1
                fieldDefinitionIds:
                  type: array
                  minItems: 1
                  maxItems: 100
                  uniqueItems: true
                  items: *id017
    UserCommunityStreamEvent:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - schemaVersion
      - stream
      - communityId
      - userNotificationSeq
      - eventId
      - eventType
      - occurredAt
      - payload
      properties:
        schemaVersion:
          const: 1
        stream:
          const: user-community
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        userNotificationSeq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        eventId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        eventType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - workspace.restored
          - workspace.archived
          - workspace.created
          - notification.created
          - notification.read
          - notification.read_all
          - membership.changed
          - workspace.invitation.created
          - workspace.invitation.revoked
          - security.break_glass_invoked
          - community.invitation.created
          - community.invitation.revoked
          - community.invitation.expired
          - workspace.invitation.accepted
          - workspace.invitation.expired
          - community.invitation.accepted
        occurredAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        payload:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          description: Recipient-only payload. notification.created/read/read_all use the closed CR-10 payload
            shapes; no userId, email, comment body, mention target list or inaccessible resource identifier is
            included.
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: notification.created
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - notificationId
              - category
              - reason
              - unreadCount
              properties:
                notificationId:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
                category:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationCategory'
                reason:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationReason'
                unreadCount:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: notification.read
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - notificationId
              - unreadCount
              properties:
                notificationId:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
                unreadCount:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
      - if:
          properties:
            eventType:
              const: notification.read_all
          required:
          - eventType
        then:
          properties:
            payload:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - unreadCount
              properties:
                unreadCount:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
    WorkspaceEventPageDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - events
      - latestSeq
      properties:
        events:
          type: array
          maxItems: 500
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceStreamEvent'
          description: Complete events after the exclusive sinceSeq cursor, in ascending workspaceSeq order.
        latestSeq:

    UserCommunityEventPageDto:
      type: object

            order.
        latestSeq:

    RealtimeTicketRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        workspaceIds:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          description: Optional restriction for this ticket's workspace subscriptions; each ID is reauthorized
            at subscribe time.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
    RealtimeTicketDto:
      type: object
      required:
