      - expiresAt
      - singleUse
      properties:
        ticket:
          type: string
          minLength: 43
          maxLength: 128
          pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$
          description: Opaque high-entropy one-time credential; raw value is returned once and must not be 
            logged or placed in a URL.
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Expiry is exactly 60 seconds after issuance.
        singleUse:
          const: true
    NotificationDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - eventType
      - title
      - createdAt
      - isRead
      - category
      - reason
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        eventType:
          type: string
          maxLength: 64
          description: Stable source domain event family; not a client-provided value.
        title:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        body:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          description: Optional safe summary; never raw comment Markdown/AST or hidden resource content.
          maxLength: 1000
        resourceType:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          description: Nullable resource kind. Returned only when the recipient can still read that resource.
        resourceId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Null when the linked resource is not currently readable by the recipient.
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        isRead:
          type: boolean
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationCategory'
        reason:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationReason'
      additionalProperties: false
      description: Private recipient-only inbox record. The server derives the recipient from the session.
    NotificationListDto:
      type: object

      - unreadCount
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationDto'
          description: Filtered page in newest-first order; inaccessible resource pointers are null.
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        unreadCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Unread count for the authenticated user across the full community inbox, independent of
            category/unreadOnly filters.
      additionalProperties: false
    AdminWorkspaceDirectoryDto:

            - taskCount

            properties:

              ownerIds:

              taskCount:
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
              createdAt:
                type: string
                format: date-time
              lastActivityAt:
                type:
                - string
                - 'null'
                format: date-time
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    AuditEventDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - id
      - communityId
      - communitySequence
      - eventType
      - category
      - occurredAt
      - severity
      - actorId
      - targetType
      - targetId
      - metadata
      - previousEntryHash
      - entryHash
      - hashAlgorithm
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        communityId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        communitySequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        workspaceId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        eventType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventType'
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventCategory'
        occurredAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        severity:
          type: string
          enum:
          - INFO
          - WARNING
          - HIGH
          - CRITICAL
        actorId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          description: Stable subject UUID; never a raw name or email.
        targetType:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditTargetType'
          - type: 'null'
        targetId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
        metadata:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventMetadataDto'
        previousEntryHash:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          pattern: ^[a-f0-9]{64}$
        entryHash:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[a-f0-9]{64}$
        hashAlgorithm:
          const: SHA-256
      description: Immutable community-scoped audit event. The hash chain is ordered by communitySequence.
    AuditEventPageDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      - nextCursor
      - snapshotSequence
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        snapshotSequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Community sequence head captured before recording the read-access event; every page 
            cursor is bound to this snapshot.
    TaskMovePreviewDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:

      - sourceWorkspaceId
      - targetWorkspaceId
      - sourceKind
      - targetKind
      - crossWorkspaceTransfer
      - requiresPersonalToSharedConfirmation
      - transferMode
      - affectedTaskCount
      - affectedSubtaskCount
      - newTaskKey
      - audienceChangeSummary
      - preservedFields
      - resetFields
      - excludedRelatedData
      properties:
        previewId:
          type: string
          minLength: 20
          maxLength: 512
        previewExpiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        sourceWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        sourceKind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceKind'
        targetKind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceKind'
        crossWorkspaceTransfer:
          type: boolean
        requiresPersonalToSharedConfirmation:
          type: boolean
        transferMode:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PRESERVE_IN_PLACE
          - NAMES_ONLY
        affectedTaskCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        affectedSubtaskCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        newTaskKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[1-9][0-9]*$
        audienceChangeSummary:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
        sourceWorkspaceName:
          type: string
          maxLength: 120
        targetWorkspaceName:
          type: string
          maxLength: 120
        targetParentTaskId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Null for all cross-Workspace transfers; same-Workspace preview may contain an 
            authorized parent ID.
        preservedFields:

            - customFieldValues
            - rankKey
        excludedRelatedData:
          type: array
          items:

            enum:

            - watchers
            - taskLinks
            - activityHistory
    CsrfTokenDto:
      type: object

    CommunitySettingsDto:

    UpdateCommunitySettingsRequest:

      properties:

          type: array
          uniqueItems: true

    CommunityMemberDto:

      properties:
        user:

            and is never a workspace role.
        isDefaultCoordinator:

    CommunityMemberListDto:

    UpdateCommunityMemberRequest:

      properties:

          enum:
          - ACTIVE

        isCommunityAdmin:
          type: boolean
        isDefaultCoordinator:
          type: boolean
    WorkspaceRoleDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - systemKey
      - name

      - isBuiltIn
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'

          type:
          - string
          - 'null'

          - OWNER
          - COORDINATOR
          - MEMBER
          - VIEWER
          - 
          description: Stable system identity for immutable built-in roles; null for a custom role. Display 
            names are never used as policy keys.
        name:
          type: string
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'

          type: array

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'

    WorkspaceRoleListDto:
      type: object

      - items

        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceRoleDto'
    CreateWorkspaceRoleRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      - capabilities
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        description:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
        capabilities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 64
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'
    UpdateWorkspaceRoleRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      minProperties: 1
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 500
        capabilities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 64
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/RoleCapability'
    CustomFieldType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - TEXT
      - NUMBER
      - DATE
      - BOOLEAN
      - SINGLE_SELECT
      description: Phase 1 field types queryable with type-safe filter/sort behavior, including SINGLE_SELECT.
    CustomFieldDefinitionDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - fieldType
      - isRequired
      - isArchived
      - fieldKey
      - version
      - displayOrder
      - options
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
        fieldType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldType'
        isRequired:
          type: boolean
        isArchived:
          type: boolean
        options:
          type: array
          maxItems: 100
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldOptionDto'
          description: All options, including archived historical options. Empty for every type other than 
            SINGLE_SELECT.
        fieldKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$
          description: Server-generated immutable workspace-unique query key used as cf.<fieldKey> in 
            ViewQuerySpec; not editable and not a value identifier.
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Optimistic schema version; every definition or option mutation increments it.
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 500
        displayOrder:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
      description: Workspace-scoped custom field schema. fieldType, id and fieldKey are immutable. Display 
        name, description, required flag and display order are mutable under baseVersion.
    CustomFieldDefinitionListDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldDefinitionDto'
    CreateCustomFieldDefinitionRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      - fieldType
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
        fieldType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldType'
        isRequired:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        options:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 100
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldOptionCreateInput'
          description: Required for SINGLE_SELECT; forbidden/empty for other types. IDs and sortOrder are 
            server-generated.
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 500
        displayOrder:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          default: 0
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            fieldType:
              const: SINGLE_SELECT
          required:
          - fieldType
        then:
          required:
          - options
          properties:
            options:
              minItems: 1
              maxItems: 100
      - if:
          properties:
            fieldType:
              enum:
              - TEXT
              - NUMBER
              - DATE
              - BOOLEAN
          required:
          - fieldType
        then:
          properties:
            options:
              maxItems: 0
      description: fieldType is immutable after creation. The server generates id, fieldKey, option IDs and 
        option order. Names are NFKC-normalized and unique case-insensitively within the workspace.
    UpdateCustomFieldDefinitionRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      minProperties: 2
      properties:
        baseVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
        description:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          maxLength: 500
        isRequired:
          type: boolean
        displayOrder:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        isArchived:
          type: boolean
          description: Restore an archived definition with the same immutable ID/fieldKey when false.
      required:
      - baseVersion
      description: Atomic version-checked definition update. fieldType, id, fieldKey and options are not 
        accepted; options use their dedicated endpoints. Enabling isRequired requires a valid value on every 
        active task or returns CUSTOM_FIELD_REQUIRED_BACKFILL_NEEDED.
    MyWorkQuerySpec:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ViewQuerySpec'
      - type: object
        properties:
          includePersonalWorkspace:
            type: boolean
            default: true
          includeSharedWorkspaces:
            type: boolean
            default: true
          workspaceIds:
            type: array
            uniqueItems: true
            items:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      description: Because custom-field definitions/fieldKeys are workspace-scoped, custom-field filter and 
        sort terms (cf.*) are not supported by this cross-workspace endpoint; use the workspace-scoped task 
        query.
    MyWorkQueryResult:
      type: object
      required:
      - items
      - total
      - nextCursor
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
    SearchResultDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - tasks
      - workspaces
      - nextCursor
      - savedViews
      properties:
        tasks:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        savedViews:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required:
            - id
            - workspaceId
            - name
            - scope
            - viewType
            properties:
              id:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              workspaceId:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              name:
                type: string
              scope:
                type: string
                enum:
                - PERSONAL
                - SHARED
              viewType:
                type: string
                enum:
                - LIST
                - BOARD
                - CALENDAR
                - TIMELINE
          description: Only caller-owned PERSONAL and visible SHARED views across currently accessible 
            workspaces. QuerySpec and displayOptions are not returned in search summaries.
        workspaces:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceSearchSummaryDto'
          description: Permission-filtered workspace summaries only; detailed workspace access must be fetched
            from its canonical endpoint.
    UpdateCommentRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - body
      - version
      properties:
        body:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20000
          description: Replacement raw Markdown source. Mentions are reparsed and revalidated atomically.
        version:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Optimistic concurrency version returned by CommentDto.
    ReminderSettingsDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - enabled
      - reminders
      properties:
        enabled:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: When false, no upcoming or overdue task reminders are generated.
        reminders:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReminderOffsetDto'
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 5
          uniqueItems: true
          default:
          - offsetMinutes: 60
          - offsetMinutes: 1440
          description: Unique ascending offsets, in minutes, before each recipient-local due-date boundary. 
            New workspaces default to 24 hours and 1 hour. Delivery channels are controlled by each recipient 
            own notification preferences.
      additionalProperties: false
    UpdateReminderSettingsRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - enabled
      - reminders
      properties:
        enabled:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: When false, no upcoming or overdue task reminders are generated.
        reminders:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReminderOffsetDto'
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 5
          uniqueItems: true
          default:
          - offsetMinutes: 60
          - offsetMinutes: 1440
          description: Unique ascending offsets, in minutes, before each recipient-local due-date boundary. 
            New workspaces default to 24 hours and 1 hour. Delivery channels are controlled by each recipient 
            own notification preferences.
    TransferConfirmationProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - transferPreview
        properties:
          transferPreview:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskMovePreviewDto'
    AuditEventCategory:
      type: string
      enum:
      - COMMUNITY_MEMBERSHIP
      - WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP
      - ROLE_AND_PERMISSION
      - WORKSPACE_GOVERNANCE
      - DATA_LIFECYCLE
      - ACCESS_EXCEPTION
      - SECURITY
      - AUDIT_ACCESS
      - AUDIT_INTEGRITY
    AuditEventType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_INVITED
      - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_JOINED
      - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_REMOVED
      - COMMUNITY_ADMIN_CHANGED
      - WORKSPACE_CREATED
      - WORKSPACE_ARCHIVED
      - WORKSPACE_RESTORED
      - WORKSPACE_DELETED
      - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ADDED
      - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_REMOVED
      - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ROLE_CHANGED
      - WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_CHANGED
      - CUSTOM_ROLE_CREATED
      - CUSTOM_ROLE_UPDATED
      - CUSTOM_ROLE_DELETED
      - CUSTOM_ROLE_ASSIGNED
      - PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_CHANGED
      - TASK_ASSIGNEE_FIELD_GRANTS_CHANGED
      - TASK_TRANSFERRED
      - BREAK_GLASS_GRANTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RESOURCE_ACCESSED
      - BREAK_GLASS_REVOKED
      - BREAK_GLASS_EXPIRED
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_EMAIL_RETRY
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_EMAIL_ACCEPTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_FAILED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_REQUESTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_APPROVED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_REJECTED
      - AUDIT_LOG_SEARCHED
      - AUDIT_LOG_EXPORTED
      - AUDIT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE
      - AUDIT_RETENTION_POLICY_CHANGED
      - LEGAL_HOLD_APPLIED
      - LEGAL_HOLD_RELEASED
    AuditTargetType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - COMMUNITY
      - WORKSPACE
      - MEMBERSHIP
      - ROLE
      - TASK
      - SAVED_VIEW
      - CUSTOM_FIELD
      - BREAK_GLASS_GRANT
      - AUDIT_EXPORT
      - ACCOUNT
      - AUTH_SESSION
    AuditEventMetadataDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      description: Allow-listed identifiers and non-content facts only. Never place names, emails, IP 
        addresses, session/token material, task titles/descriptions, comment bodies, file names, raw field 
        values, free-text justifications or other user-authored content in audit metadata.
      properties:
        membershipId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        roleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        previousRoleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        newRoleId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        grantExpiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        grantRevokedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        breakGlassReasonCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/BreakGlassReasonCategory'
        breakGlassAccessMode:
          const: READ_ONLY
        breakGlassRenewalSequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
        approverUserId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        notificationChannel:
          type: string
          enum:
          - IN_APP
          - EMAIL
        notificationAttempt:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 6
        sourceWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        reasonCode:
          type: string
          enum:
          - INCIDENT_RESPONSE
          - SAFETY_ESCALATION
          - LEGAL_REQUEST
          - ACCOUNT_RECOVERY
          - OTHER
        changedFields:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - membershipRole
            - workspacePolicy
            - taskEditPolicy
            - customRoleCapabilities
            - workspaceLifecycle
            - taskTransfer
            - ownerAssignment
            - coordinatorInclusion
            - retentionPolicy
            - legalHold
            - assigneeFieldGrantCeiling
            - assigneeFieldGrantDefault
            - assigneeEditableFieldGroups
        affectedCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        exportId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        exportedRowCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        exportFilterFingerprint:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[a-f0-9]{64}$
        notificationOutcome:
          type: string
          enum:
          - QUEUED
          - SENT
          - FAILED
          - RETRYING
        integrityCheckpointId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        retentionPolicyVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        legalHoldId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        previousAssigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Previous Workspace Owner-controlled maximum delegation ceiling. Contains allow-listed 
            permission-group codes only; no task content.
        newAssigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: New Workspace Owner-controlled maximum delegation ceiling. Contains allow-listed 
            permission-group codes only; no task content.
        previousAssigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Previous Workspace Owner-controlled default applied to newly created tasks. Contains 
            allow-listed permission-group codes only; no task content.
        newAssigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: New Workspace Owner-controlled default applied to newly created tasks. Contains 
            allow-listed permission-group codes only; no task content.
        previousTaskAssigneeEditableFieldGroups:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: Previous task-level additional assignee field grants. Contains allow-listed 
            permission-group codes only; no task content.
        newTaskAssigneeEditableFieldGroups:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AssigneeEditableFieldGroup'
          description: New task-level additional assignee field grants. Contains allow-listed permission-group
            codes only; no task content.
    AuditEventFilterRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        from:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        to:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        actorId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        eventTypes:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 30
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventType'
        categories:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 9
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventCategory'
        severities:
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 4
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - INFO
            - WARNING
            - HIGH
            - CRITICAL
        targetType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditTargetType'
        targetId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      description: Structured filters only; free-text search over audit payloads is not supported.
    AuditEventExportRequest:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEventFilterRequest'
      - anyOf:
        - required:
          - from
        - required:
          - to
      description: CSV export requires at least one time boundary. The backend streams matching authorized 
        events and applies deployment-configured resource limits.
    AuditIntegrityStatusDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - status
      - currentHeadSequence
      - verifiedThroughSequence
      - lastVerifiedAt
      - externalCheckpointSequence
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
          - HEALTHY
          - VERIFYING
          - DEGRADED
          - FAILED
          - UNKNOWN
        currentHeadSequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        verifiedThroughSequence:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        lastVerifiedAt:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: date-time
        externalCheckpointSequence:
          type:
          - integer
          - 'null'
          minimum: 0
      description: Integrity status only; it does not expose external sink credentials or provider details.
    TaskMoveProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        properties:
          transferPreview:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskMovePreviewDto'
      - if:
          properties:
            code:
              const: TRANSFER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
          required:
          - code
        then:
          required:
          - transferPreview
    TaskMovePreviewRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - targetWorkspaceId
      - targetParentTaskId
      properties:
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        targetParentTaskId:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
          - type: 'null'
          description: For same-Workspace reparenting, a same-Workspace parent or null. For cross-Workspace 
            transfer, this MUST be null; a destination parent cannot be selected.
    QueryFilterOperator:
      type: string
      enum:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - IN
      - NOT_IN
      - CONTAINS
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      - GT
      - GTE
      - LT
      - LTE
      - BETWEEN
    QueryFilterField:
      type: string
      pattern: 
        ^(statusCategory|priority|itemType|assigneeId|createdById|watcherId|labelId|milestoneId|cycleId|startDate|dueDate|createdAt|updatedAt|estimatePoints|hasBlocker|isOverdue|q|cf\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47})$
      description: The active API exposes statusCategory; task queries are scoped directly to a Workspace and 
        do not support intermediate container fields.
    QueryFilterValue:
      oneOf:
      - type: string
        maxLength: 500
      - type: number
      - type: boolean
      - type: array
        minItems: 1
        maxItems: 50
        items:
          oneOf:
          - type: string
            maxLength: 500
          - type: number
          - type: boolean
    QueryFilterCondition:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - field
      - operator
      properties:
        field:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterField'
        operator:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterOperator'
        value:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterValue'
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            operator:
              enum:
              - IS_EMPTY
              - IS_NOT_EMPTY
          required:
          - operator
        then:
          not:
            required:
            - value
        else:
          required:
          - value
      - if:
          properties:
            operator:
              enum:
              - IN
              - NOT_IN
          required:
          - operator
        then:
          properties:
            value:
              type: array
              minItems: 1
              maxItems: 50
      - if:
          properties:
            operator:
              const: BETWEEN
          required:
          - operator
        then:
          properties:
            value:
              type: array
              minItems: 2
              maxItems: 2
      - if:
          properties:
            operator:
              const: CONTAINS
          required:
          - operator
        then:
          properties:
            value:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
              maxLength: 500
      description: Field/operator/value compatibility is checked against the canonical field registry and 
        active custom-field definitions.
    QueryFilterSubgroup:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - conjunction
      - conditions
      properties:
        conjunction:
          type: string
          enum:
          - AND
          - OR
        conditions:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 50
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterCondition'
      description: One nested level only; nested subgroups are not accepted.
    QueryFilterGroup:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - conjunction
      - conditions
      properties:
        conjunction:
          type: string
          enum:
          - AND
          - OR
        conditions:
          type: array
          maxItems: 50
          items:
            oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterCondition'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/QueryFilterSubgroup'
      description: Root group. Empty AND matches all otherwise-authorized active tasks; empty OR matches none.
        Total leaf conditions across the AST may not exceed 50.
    QuerySortField:
      type: string
      pattern: ^(rankKey|priority|dueDate|startDate|createdAt|currentKey|cf\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47})$
      description: Allowlisted caller-sortable task fields. id is a server-only deterministic tie-breaker and 
        cannot be supplied by clients.
    QuerySortTerm:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - field
      - direction
      properties:
        field:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/QuerySortField'
        direction:
          type: string
          enum:
          - ASC
          - DESC
    QueryDateWindow:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - dateField
      - from
      - to
      - includeUnscheduled
      properties:
        dateField:
          type: string
          enum:
          - DUE_DATE
          - START_TO_DUE_SPAN
        from:
          type: string
          format: date
        to:
          type: string
          format: date
        includeUnscheduled:
          type: boolean
          default: false
      description: Inclusive workspace-local date interval; from must not be after to and the inclusive range 
        may not exceed 366 calendar days.
    TaskViewQueryRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - projection
      - querySpec
      properties:
        projection:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
        querySpec:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ViewQuerySpec'
        limit:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 200
          description: 'Defaults: 50 per Board bucket; 200 for List, Calendar and Timeline.'
        cursor:
          type: string
          minLength: 16
          maxLength: 4096
          description: Opaque continuation token returned by the server.
        pageScope:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PRIMARY
          - GROUP
          - BACKLOG
          - UNSCHEDULED
          default: PRIMARY
        groupKey:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 256
          description: Opaque bucket key returned in a Board group; required only for pageScope GROUP.
        querySnapshotId:
          type: string
          minLength: 16
          maxLength: 128
          description: Optional snapshot handle returned by a prior response. Reuse with the same querySpec to
            request another projection from the identical canonical task-ID snapshot; it is not authorization.
      allOf:
      - if:
          properties:
            projection:
              enum:
              - CALENDAR
              - TIMELINE
          required:
          - projection
        then:
          properties:
            querySpec:
              type: object
              required:
              - dateWindow
      - if:
          properties:
            projection:
              const: TIMELINE
          required:
          - projection
        then:
          properties:
            querySpec:
              properties:
                dateWindow:
                  properties:
                    dateField:
                      const: START_TO_DUE_SPAN
      - if:
          properties:
            projection:
              const: BOARD
          required:
          - projection
        then:
          properties:
            limit:
              maximum: 50
      - if:
          properties:
            pageScope:
              const: GROUP
          required:
          - pageScope
        then:
          required:
          - groupKey
          - cursor
          properties:
            projection:
              const: BOARD
        else:
          not:
            required:
            - groupKey
      - if:
          properties:
            pageScope:
              enum:
              - BACKLOG
              - UNSCHEDULED
          required:
          - pageScope
        then:
          required:
          - cursor
      - if:
          properties:
            pageScope:
              const: UNSCHEDULED
          required:
          - pageScope
        then:
          required:
          - cursor
          properties:
            projection:
              enum:
              - CALENDAR
              - TIMELINE
            querySpec:
              required:
              - dateWindow
              properties:
                dateWindow:
                  required:
                  - includeUnscheduled
                  properties:
                    includeUnscheduled:
                      const: true
      - if:
          properties:
            pageScope:
              const: BACKLOG
          required:
          - pageScope
        then:
          required:
          - cursor
          properties:
            querySpec:
              required:
              - includeBacklog
              properties:
                includeBacklog:
                  const: false
      description: One endpoint, one filter/sort/authorization pipeline. Cursors are opaque, snapshot-bound 
        and never authorization tokens. A first request omits querySnapshotId; a re-projection request 
        supplies the prior querySnapshotId and the same querySpec. A continuation request supplies the 
        returned cursor (which carries its snapshot binding).
    TaskQueryBucketDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - key
      - label
      - total
      - items
      - nextCursor
      - children
      properties:
        key:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Distinct task count in this bucket; may overlap other buckets only when grouping by 
            assigneeId.
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskDto'
          maxItems: 50
        nextCursor:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
        children:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskQueryBucketDto'
      description: A Board bucket with independently paged rows; assignee grouping can intentionally duplicate
        a multi-assignee task across buckets while the canonical union remains distinct.
    TaskQueryVisibleEndpointDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - access
      - taskId
      - taskKey
      - title
      - statusCategory
      properties:
        access:
          const: VISIBLE
        taskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        taskKey:
          type: string
        title:
          type: string
        statusCategory:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
    TaskQueryRestrictedEndpointDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - access
      - label
      properties:
        access:
          const: RESTRICTED
        label:
          const: Restricted Task
    TaskQueryDependencyEdgeDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - linkId
      - visibleTaskId
      - direction
      - type
      - otherEndpoint
      properties:
        linkId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        visibleTaskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        direction:
          type: string
          enum:
          - OUTGOING
          - INCOMING
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - BLOCKS
          - IS_BLOCKED_BY
          - RELATES_TO
          - DUPLICATES
        otherEndpoint:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskQueryVisibleEndpointDto'
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskQueryRestrictedEndpointDto'
      description: Timeline-only dependency edge. An inaccessible opposite endpoint is represented without its
        ID, key, title or status.
    RoleCapability:
      type: string
      enum:
      - task:read
      - task:create
      - task:edit_definition
      - task:edit_title_description
      - task:edit_dates_priority
      - task:edit_custom_fields_links
      - task:edit_estimate
      - task:update_status
      - task:assign
      - task:manage_subtasks
      - task:move
      - task:comment
      - task:watch
      - task:archive
      - task:restore
      - task:delete_permanent
      - task:request_signoff
      - task:approve_signoff
      - workspace:read_metadata
      - workspace:invite_members
      - workspace:manage_members
      - workspace:administer_roles
      - workspace:update_settings
      - workspace:transfer_ownership
      - workspace:archive
      - workspace:restore
      - workspace:configure_workflow
      - saved_view:manage_shared
      - audit:read
      - audit:export
      - workspace:manage_custom_fields
      description: Canonical workspace-scoped capability vocabulary used by WorkspaceRoleDto, 
        WorkspaceDto.effectiveCapabilities and role preview. Community-scoped authority such as 
        community:global_admin and Platform Operator authority are intentionally outside this catalog. The 
        task:delete_permanent capability is reserved to the built-in OWNER role by default and is not 
        grantable to custom roles while the purge policy is disabled.
    TaskCapability:
      type: string
      enum:
      - task:read
      - task:create
      - task:edit_definition
      - task:edit_title_description
      - task:edit_dates_priority
      - task:edit_custom_fields_links
      - task:edit_estimate
      - task:update_status
      - task:assign

    CommentActorDto:

        avatarUrl:
          type:
          - string
          - 'null'
          format: uri
        isFormerMember:
          type: boolean
    CommentMentionDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - userId
      - displayName
      - isFormerMember
      properties:
        userId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        displayName:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        isFormerMember:
          type: boolean
    CommentMarkdownNode:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - type
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - text
          - paragraph
          - heading
          - blockquote
          - ordered_list
          - unordered_list
          - list_item
          - strong
          - emphasis
          - strikethrough
          - code_inline
          - code_block
          - link
          - mention
          - task_key
        text:
          type: string
          maxLength: 20000
        level:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 3
        href:
          type: string
          format: uri
          pattern: ^(https?://|mailto:)
        userId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        displayName:
          type: string
          maxLength: 120
        taskKey:

          maxLength: 80
        taskId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'

          type: array
          maxItems: 2000
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentMarkdownNode'
      description: Closed server-generated Markdown AST node. No HTML, style, arbitrary attributes, 
        image/embed nodes or client-supplied AST are accepted.
    CommentMarkdownAst:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - schemaVersion
      - nodes
      properties:
        schemaVersion:
          type: integer
          const: 1
        nodes:
          type: array
          maxItems: 2000
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CommentMarkdownNode'
      description: Sanitized server-generated AST. Clients render this structure only; they never inject raw 
        Markdown or HTML into the DOM.

      type: object

    MentionCandidateListDto:

        items:
          type: array
          maxItems: 20
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/MentionCandidateDto'
    EventCursorAheadProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - latestSeq
        properties:
          status:
            const: 409
          code:
            const: EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD
          latestSeq:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            description: Latest committed sequence observed when the cursor error was produced.
      description: Cursor exceeds the latest committed sequence; latestSeq allows safe client correction.
    EventSeqOutOfRetentionProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - latestSeq
        properties:
          status:
            const: 410
          code:
            const: EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION
          latestSeq:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            description: Latest committed sequence observed when the cursor error was produced.
      description: Requested cursor predates retained history; refetch canonical projections, then catch up 
        from latestSeq.
    NotificationCategory:
      type: string
      enum:
      - ACTION_REQUIRED
      - UPDATES
    NotificationReason:
      type: string
      enum:
      - MENTION
      - TASK_ASSIGNED
      - TASK_DUE_REMINDER
      - TASK_OVERDUE
      - COMMENT_UPDATE
      - GOVERNANCE_ALERT
      - BREAK_GLASS_ALERT
    NotificationQuietHoursDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - enabled
      - startTimeLocal
      - endTimeLocal
      - daysOfWeek
      properties:
        enabled:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        startTimeLocal:
          type: string
          pattern: ^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$
          default: 1320
        endTimeLocal:
          type: string
          pattern: ^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$
          default: 08:00
        daysOfWeek:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - MONDAY
            - TUESDAY
            - WEDNESDAY
            - THURSDAY
            - FRIDAY
            - SATURDAY
            - SUNDAY
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 7
          default: []
          description: Local start days for the quiet interval; empty means every day.
      description: Equal start/end times are invalid. Intervals crossing midnight are supported.
    NotificationPreferencesDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - timeZone
      - actionRequiredEmailMode
      - updatesEmailMode
      - quietHours
      - dailyDigestTimeLocal
      - weeklyDigestDayOfWeek
      properties:
        timeZone: &id018
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 64
          default: UTC
          description: Validated IANA time zone identifier, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.
        actionRequiredEmailMode: &id019
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ActionRequiredEmailMode'
          default: IMMEDIATE
          description: ACTION_REQUIRED alerts cannot be digested.
        updatesEmailMode: &id020
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdatesEmailMode'
          default: OFF
          description: UPDATES may be delivered immediately, daily, weekly or not by email.
        quietHours: &id021
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationQuietHoursDto'
        dailyDigestTimeLocal: &id022
          type: string
          pattern: ^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$
          default: 09:00
        weeklyDigestDayOfWeek: &id023
          type: string
          enum:
          - MONDAY
          - TUESDAY
          - WEDNESDAY
          - THURSDAY
          - FRIDAY
          - SATURDAY
          - SUNDAY
          default: MONDAY
    UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - timeZone
      - actionRequiredEmailMode
      - updatesEmailMode
      - quietHours
      - dailyDigestTimeLocal
      - weeklyDigestDayOfWeek
      properties:
        timeZone: *id018
        actionRequiredEmailMode: *id019
        updatesEmailMode: *id020
        quietHours: *id021
        dailyDigestTimeLocal: *id022
        weeklyDigestDayOfWeek: *id023
    ReminderOffsetDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - offsetMinutes
      properties:
        offsetMinutes:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 10080
      description: Unique reminder offset before the recipient-local due-date boundary.
    ActionRequiredEmailMode:
      type: string
      enum:
      - IMMEDIATE
      - false
    UpdatesEmailMode:
      type: string
      enum:
      - IMMEDIATE
      - DAILY_DIGEST
      - WEEKLY_DIGEST
      - false
    BoardSavedViewDisplayOptions:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        visibleCardBadges:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - DUE_DATE
            - LABELS
            - SUBTASK_COUNT
            - ESTIMATE
          uniqueItems: true
          minItems: 0
          maxItems: 4
          default:
          - DUE_DATE
          - LABELS
          description: Optional metadata badges shown on Board cards. Defaults to due date and labels.
        showEmptyColumns:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: Keep empty status columns visible on the Board.
      description: Board-only presentation settings. These never alter filtering, sorting, grouping, 
        membership or authorization.
    SavedViewDisplayOptions:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        board:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/BoardSavedViewDisplayOptions'
      description: Presentation-only settings. The board property is allowed only when the effective viewType 
        is BOARD. Non-Board views use an empty object.
    CopySavedViewRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - targetWorkspaceId
      - name
      - scope
      properties:
        targetWorkspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        scope:
          type: string
          enum:
          - PERSONAL
          - SHARED
      description: Create a new copy in a different workspace in the same community. querySpec, viewType and 
        displayOptions are copied from the source; destination name and scope are supplied here.
    SavedViewCopyIncompatibleProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - issues
        properties:
          status:
            const: 422
          code:
            const: SAVED_VIEW_COPY_INCOMPATIBLE
          issues:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            maxItems: 100
            items:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
              - path
              - code
              properties:
                path:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 1
                  maxLength: 512
                  description: Safe JSON Pointer relative to querySpec/displayOptions; contains no source-only
                    raw identifier.
                code:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                  - REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND
                  - REFERENCE_NOT_VISIBLE
                  - REFERENCE_TYPE_MISMATCH
                  - OPERATOR_NOT_ALLOWED
                  - OPTION_NOT_AVAILABLE
      description: Destination mapping validation failed. Includes safe paths and issue codes only; no partial
        saved view is created and no source-only identifier values are disclosed.
    SavedViewVersionConflictProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - currentVersion
        - submittedVersion
        properties:
          status:
            const: 409
          code:
            const: SAVED_VIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT
          currentVersion:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          submittedVersion:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      description: Optimistic concurrency conflict. No write occurs; reload the saved view and reconcile the 
        draft.
    CustomFieldOptionDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - id
      - label
      - sortOrder
      - isArchived
      properties:
        id: *id017
        label:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        sortOrder:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 99
        isArchived:
          type: boolean

    CustomFieldOptionCreateInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - label

        label:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
    CreateCustomFieldOptionRequest:

      - baseVersion
      - label

        baseVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        label:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
    UpdateCustomFieldOptionRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - baseVersion
      minProperties: 2
      properties:
        baseVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        label:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        isArchived:
          type: boolean
          description: Archive/hide or restore the same stable option ID.
    ReorderCustomFieldOptionsRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - baseVersion
      - orderedOptionIds
      properties:
        baseVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        orderedOptionIds:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 100
          uniqueItems: true
          items: *id017
          description: Complete permutation of all currently active option IDs; no omitted, archived or 
            foreign IDs.
    TaskCustomFieldValuesDto:
      type: object
      propertyNames:
        pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$
      additionalProperties:
        anyOf:
        - type: string
          maxLength: 5000
        - type: number
          minimum: -1000000000000
          maximum: 1000000000000
          description: Finite decimal; at most six fractional digits are enforced by the server.
        - type: boolean
      description: Map keyed by custom-field definition UUIDv7. Values are non-null JSON scalars; 
        interpretation is resolved from the active workspace definition. Empty values are omitted.
    TaskCustomFieldValuesCreate:
      type: object
      propertyNames:
        pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$
      additionalProperties:
        anyOf:
        - type: string
          maxLength: 5000
        - type: number
          minimum: -1000000000000
          maximum: 1000000000000
          description: Finite decimal; at most six fractional digits are enforced by the server.
        - type: boolean
      description: Create-time values keyed by definition UUIDv7. No null values; the server validates every 
        definition, active option and required constraint in the path workspace.
    TaskCustomFieldValuesPatch:
      type: object
      propertyNames:
        pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$
      additionalProperties:
        anyOf:
        - type: string
          maxLength: 5000
        - type: number
          minimum: -1000000000000
          maximum: 1000000000000
          description: Finite decimal; at most six fractional digits are enforced by the server.
        - type: boolean
        - type: 'null'
      description: Partial patch keyed by definition UUIDv7. Omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears only 
        that field. Server applies per-field revision checks and the active definition type.
    CustomFieldVersionConflictProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - currentVersion
        - submittedVersion
        properties:
          status:
            const: 409
          code:
            const: CUSTOM_FIELD_VERSION_CONFLICT
          currentVersion:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          submittedVersion:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      description: A stale custom-field schema mutation is rejected without a write; refetch the definition 
        and retry deliberately.
    CustomFieldRequiredBackfillProblem:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
      - type: object
        required:
        - status
        - code
        - missingTaskCount
        properties:
          status:
            const: 422
          code:
            const: CUSTOM_FIELD_REQUIRED_BACKFILL_NEEDED
          missingTaskCount:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
      description: Required cannot be enabled until all active tasks have a valid value; no task IDs or titles
        are returned.

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionSummaryDto'
      additionalProperties: false
    AuthProviderPath:
      type: string
      enum:
      - PASSWORD
      - GOOGLE
    ReauthenticateRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - currentPassword
      properties:
        currentPassword:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 1024
    HealthLiveResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - status
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          const: UP
      description: Minimal liveness response. Confirms the process/event loop responds; does not depend on 
        PostgreSQL, the outbox worker or external providers.
    HealthReadyResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - status
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          const: UP
      description: Minimal readiness response. The route returns this only when readiness dependencies pass. 
        It deliberately omits dependency names, connection details and internal health diagnostics.
    WorkspaceSearchSummaryDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - id
      - name
      - kind
      properties:
        id:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
        name:
          type: string
        kind:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceKind'
      description: Minimal permission-filtered workspace search summary; do not include member lists, private 
        task content or actor-specific permissions.
    WorkspaceSummaryDto:
      type: object
      required:
      - workspaceId
      - totalTasks
      - completedTasks
      - overdueTasks
      - completionRatio
      properties:
        totalTasks:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        completedTasks:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        overdueTasks:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        completionRatio:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
        assigneeWorkload:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required:
            - userId
            - openTaskCount
            properties:
              userId:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
              openTaskCount:
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
        workspaceId:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Uuid'
      description: Aggregate task completion, overdue and assignee workload summary for one authorized 
        Workspace.
    AssigneeEditableFieldGroup:
      type: string
      enum:
      - TITLE_DESCRIPTION
      - DATES_PRIORITY
      - CUSTOM_FIELDS_LINKS
      description: Task-definition field group that a Workspace Owner may permit and a Task Creator may grant 
        to active assignees on one task. Estimate editing remains part of the existing assignee execution 
        rights.
    WorkspaceTemplateKey:
      type: string
      enum:
      - GENERAL_PURPOSE
      - EVENT_PLANNING
      - TEAM_OPERATIONS
    WorkspaceTemplateStatusDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - key
      - name
      - category
      - position
      properties:
        key:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,39}$
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusCategory'
        position:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
    WorkspaceTemplateCustomFieldDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - key
      - name
      - fieldType
      - required
      properties:
        key:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,39}$
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
        fieldType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomFieldType'
        required:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        options:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            maxLength: 80
          uniqueItems: true
          maxItems: 30
    WorkspaceTemplateSavedViewDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - name
      - viewType
      - scope
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 120
        viewType:
          type: string
          enum:
          - LIST
          - BOARD
          - CALENDAR
          - TIMELINE
        scope:
          type: string
          const: SHARED
    WorkspaceTemplateDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - key
      - name
      - description
      - templateVersion
      - workflowStatuses
      - customFieldDefinitions
      - defaultSavedViews
      properties:
        key:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateKey'
        name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
        description:
          type: string
          maxLength: 500
        templateVersion:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        workflowStatuses:
          type: array
          minItems: 3
          maxItems: 12
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateStatusDto'
        customFieldDefinitions:
          type: array
          maxItems: 8
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateCustomFieldDto'
        defaultSavedViews:
          type: array
          maxItems: 8
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateSavedViewDto'
      description: Read-only built-in Workspace setup preset. Applying a template seeds configuration only; it
        never creates work items or grants access.
    WorkspaceTemplateListDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - items
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          minItems: 3
          maxItems: 3
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkspaceTemplateDto'
    PurgeTaskRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - confirmationPhrase
      - expectedTaskKey
      properties:
        confirmationPhrase:
          type: string
          const: PURGE
        expectedTaskKey:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-[1-9][0-9]*$
          description: Must match the current authorized task key shown in the Trash confirmation.
      description: Explicit destructive confirmation for a permanently archived task tree. Endpoint remains 
        disabled until DEC-OPEN-03 retention/legal-hold approval.
    PurgeTaskResultDto:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
      - purgedAt
      - purgedTaskCount
      - aliasesRetained
      properties:
        purgedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        purgedTaskCount:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        aliasesRetained:
          type: boolean
          const: true
          description: Historical keys remain in the immutable alias ledger and do not get reassigned.
x-audit-policy:
  status: ENGINEERING_POLICY_SPECIFIED_FOR_0.3.15_DRAFT_AND_UPDATED_FOR_0.3.19_DRAFT; 
    NUMERIC_RETENTION_ARCHIVE_TIER_AND_LEGAL_HOLD_APPROVAL_REMAIN_UNRESOLVED
  scope: COMMUNITY_SCOPED_MULTI_TENANT
  recordClasses:
    taskActivity:
      purpose: User-facing task timeline and collaboration context.
      notTheSecurityAuditLog: true
      lifecycle: Follows task/workspace lifecycle and the separately approved task-history policy; comments 
        remain in their own content store.
      contentPolicy: May render task activity but does not copy comment bodies, task descriptions or 
        attachments into governance audit metadata.
    governanceSecurityAudit:
      purpose: Membership, role/permission, workspace administration, data lifecycle, security and 
        audit-access evidence.
      sourceOfTruth: Dedicated append-only audit ledger; domain_events/outbox is delivery infrastructure, not 
        the audit record.
      transactionality: Insert the audit event in the same transaction as the governed mutation; audit failure
        aborts the governed mutation.
    breakGlass:
      classification: HIGH_OR_CRITICAL_SECURITY_SUBSET_OF_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT
      requiredEvents:
      - BREAK_GLASS_GRANTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RESOURCE_ACCESSED
      - BREAK_GLASS_REVOKED
      - BREAK_GLASS_EXPIRED
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_EMAIL_RETRY
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_EMAIL_ACCEPTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_FAILED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_REQUESTED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_APPROVED
      - BREAK_GLASS_RENEWAL_REJECTED
      grantRequiresSynchronousAuditCommit: true
      freeTextJustification: Encrypted restricted grant record; never copied into audit metadata.
      allowedReasonCategories:
      - ACTIVE_SECURITY_INCIDENT
      - SAFETY_OR_ABUSE_REPORT
      allowedInitialGrantMinutes:
      - 15
      - 30
      - 60
      recommendedDefaultInitialGrantMinutes: 15
      maximumInitialGrantMinutes: 60
      renewal:
        allowed: true
        maximumRenewals: 1
        extensionMinutes: 30
        requiresDifferentCommunityAdministrator: true
        requestBeforeExpiry: true
        totalLifetimeMaximumMinutes: 90
      access:
        mode: READ_ONLY
        principal: GRANTOR_ONLY
        renewalApproverReceivesContentAccess: false
        scope: ONE_PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_IN_CALLER_COMMUNITY
        allowedActions: STANDARD_RESOURCE_READS_WITH_PER_RESOURCE_AUDIT
        prohibitedActions:
        - MUTATIONS
        - IMPERSONATION
        - EXPORT
        - DOWNLOAD
        - GLOBAL_OR_CROSS_WORKSPACE_SEARCH
        - CROSS_COMMUNITY_ACCESS
      actor:
        requiredRole: ACTIVE_COMMUNITY_ADMIN_IN_SAME_COMMUNITY
        freshReauthenticationMinutes: 5
        platformOperatorAllowed: false
      revocation:
        allowedActors:
        - TARGET_PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_OWNER
        - GRANTOR
        - PEER_COMMUNITY_ADMIN_IN_SAME_COMMUNITY
        automaticOnGrantorPrivilegeOrSessionRevocation: true
        immediateAuthorizationAndRealtimeInvalidation: true
      ownerNotification:
        persistentInAppRecordInGrantTransaction: REQUIRED
        communityAdminAlertInGrantTransaction: REQUIRED
        emailOutboxInGrantTransaction: REQUIRED
        firstAttempt: IMMEDIATE
        retryMinutesAfterInitialAttempt:
        - 1
        - 5
        - 15
        - 30
        - 60
        finalFailureEvent: BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_FAILED
        failureEscalation: ALL_SAME_COMMUNITY_ADMINS_AND_SECURITY_OPERATIONS
        inAppPersistenceFailure: ABORT_GRANT
        emailAcceptedEvent: BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_EMAIL_ACCEPTED
      emailDeliveryFailureAfterDurableQueue: KEEP_GRANT_ACTIVE_AND_ESCALATE
  retention:
    searchableOnlineDays:
    archiveAfterDays:
    purgeAfterDays:
    archiveTier: UNRESOLVED_PENDING_HOSTING_VALIDATION
    legalHoldPolicy: UNRESOLVED_PENDING_LEGAL_REVIEW
    automaticPurge: DISABLED_PENDING_EXPLICIT_POLICY_APPROVAL
    status: NO_NUMERIC_RETENTION_COMMITMENT
    historical365DayProposal: NOT_APPROVED_AND_MUST_NOT_BE_USED_AS_A_DEFAULT
  accessControl:
    communityAdministrator: READ_AND_EXPORT_COMMUNITY_SCOPED_AUDIT_EVENTS_ONLY
    workspaceOwner: READ_AND_EXPORT_ONLY_THEIR_WORKSPACE_AUDIT_EVENTS
    customRoleCapabilities:
    - audit:read
    - audit:export
    coordinatorDefault: NO_AUDIT_ACCESS_UNLESS_EXPLICITLY_GRANTED
    ordinaryMember: NO_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_ACCESS
    platformOperator: NO_SILENT_TENANT_AUDIT_READ; EMERGENCY_ACCESS_MUST_USE_A_SEPARATELY_AUDITED_SUPPORT_PATH
    allReadsAndExports: TENANT_SCOPED_SERVER_AUTHORIZATION_AND_NO_STORE_RESPONSES
  integrity:
    appendOnly: true
    sequence: MONOTONIC_PER_COMMUNITY
    hashAlgorithm: SHA-256
    hashFields:
    - canonicalEventEnvelope
    - previousEntryHash
    - communitySequence
    applicationDatabasePrivileges: SELECT_INSERT_ONLY_ON_AUDIT_LOGS; NO_UPDATE_DELETE_OR_TRUNCATE
    chainHead: LOCK_AND_ADVANCE_PER_COMMUNITY_IN_THE_GOVERNED_TRANSACTION
    externalSink: SEPARATE_CREDENTIALS_AND_ACCOUNT; APPEND_ONLY_WRITE_ONLY_FROM_APPLICATION
    verification: PERIODIC_CHAIN_VERIFICATION_AND_EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_COMPARISON
    failureHandling: PRESERVE_EVIDENCE; ALERT_SECURITY_OPERATIONS; MARK_CHAIN_DEGRADED_OR_FAILED; 
      DO_NOT_ATTEMPT_SILENT_REPAIR
  personalWorkspaceAccess:
    policy: AUDITED_BREAK_GLASS
    defaultAccess: OWNER_ONLY
    breakGlass: 
      READ_ONLY_SINGLE_WORKSPACE_15_30_OR_60_MINUTES_WITH_ONE_PEER_APPROVED_30_MINUTE_EXTENSION_AND_90_MINUTE_ABSOLUTE_CAP
    communityAdminScope: SAME_COMMUNITY_ONLY
    platformOperatorAccess: DENIED
  privacy:
    identityReference: Stable user UUIDs only in audit rows; resolve current display from identity service at 
      read time.
    excludedFromMetadata:
    - names
    - emails
    - phone numbers
    - IP addresses
    - session cookies
    - tokens
    - passwords
    - raw task titles
    - descriptions
    - comment bodies
    - file names
    - raw custom-field values
    - free-text justifications
    accountErasure: Anonymize identity attributes; retain stable actor UUID reference and render Deleted user.
      Do not rewrite or delete historical audit rows.
    workspaceOrCommunityDeletion: No cascading deletion of audit rows. Preserve scoped tombstone identifiers; 
      eventual archive/purge follows approved retention and legal-hold policy.
  exports:
    format: CSV_UTF8_RFC4180
    spreadsheetFormulaInjection: NEUTRALIZE_FORMULA_PREFIXES
    content: Authorized metadata-only audit events plus community sequence/hash fields; no raw PII or 
      user-authored content.
    exportIsAudited: true
    exportEventSelfInclusion: EXCLUDED_FROM_THE_EXPORT_SNAPSHOT
    cache: NO_STORE
    limits: DEPLOYMENT_CONFIGURED_AFTER_HOSTING_VALIDATION; NO_PRODUCT_NUMERIC_LIMIT_LOCKED
  legalHold:
    status: POLICY_AND_APPROVER_ROLES_UNRESOLVED
    requiredInvariant: A legal hold blocks all archive expiry and purge for its covered scope.
    selfServiceApi: NOT_INCLUDED_UNTIL_AUTHORITY_AND_PROCESS_ARE_APPROVED
  contractVersion: 0.3.19-draft
  implementationBoundary: This contract defines audit semantics and controls; it does not prove database 
    privileges, hash-chain enforcement, external sink durability, verifier execution, export streaming or 
    legal compliance are implemented.
  governedMutationExamples:
  - Workspace assignee-field ceiling/default changes and task assignee-field grant changes are audited 
    atomically with their governed mutation.
  permissionGrantEvents:
    workspaceCeilingAndDefault: Use WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_CHANGED (category WORKSPACE_GOVERNANCE, targetType 
      WORKSPACE) with changedFields assigneeFieldGrantCeiling and/or assigneeFieldGrantDefault. Record 
      allow-listed previous/new group arrays when present.
    taskGrant: Use TASK_ASSIGNEE_FIELD_GRANTS_CHANGED (category ROLE_AND_PERMISSION, targetType TASK). Record 
      previousTaskAssigneeEditableFieldGroups and newTaskAssigneeEditableFieldGroups as allow-listed enum 
      arrays.
    transaction: Insert the audit record in the same transaction as the corresponding Workspace settings or 
      task mutation. A failed audit insert aborts the governed mutation.
    privacy: Only actor/resource UUIDs, event category/type, timestamp, and approved group codes are allowed; 
      never include task content or free text.
    transport: These are governance audit ledger entries, not new WebSocket domain event payloads.
x-task-transfer-policy:
  communityBoundary: Same community only; cross-community transfer is rejected with 404 for inaccessible 
    destination or 422 for an explicitly visible but unsupported cross-community destination, without 
    disclosing its existence.
  sameWorkspaceMove: 'PRESERVE_IN_PLACE: stable task IDs; full content, comments, watchers, links, assignees and
    activity remain attached; entire descendant subtree moves atomically.'
  crossWorkspaceTransfer: 'NAMES_ONLY: create fresh destination task UUIDs and workspace-scoped keys; carry only
    task/subtask titles and the parent-child structure/sibling order required to recreate the selected tree. Do
    not carry itemType, descriptions, assignees, creator/assigner identity, status/progress, dates, estimates, priority,
    labels, milestones, custom-field values, comments, watchers, dependencies/links or activity history; all other
    destination fields use destination defaults.'
  sourceDisposition: Source task rows become content-free transfer tombstones containing no destination 
    task/workspace pointer. All current and historical keys remain immutable community-scoped aliases, 
    namespaced by the workspace whose key space issued the key, and map to the task’s stable internal 
    taskLineageId. The lineage current pointer is updated atomically to the fresh destination task 
    UUID/workspace. Never reuse aliases or keys.
  parentBehavior: 'OWNER CONFIRMED DEC-OPEN-10: descendants retain their parent-child structure and sibling order.
    The transferred root is recreated at the top level of the destination Workspace. Cross-Workspace transfer requires
    targetParentTaskId=null and cannot choose an existing destination parent. Same-Workspace moves may reparent
    within the Workspace.'
  authorization: Require task:move in source and task:create in target; require task:manage_subtasks for 
    moving a subtree containing descendants; verify both scopes and all current memberships at commit. No 
    client-supplied IDs or preview token bypass authorization.
  atomicity: One transaction; lock source/target Workspace rows in ascending UUID order, then the destination 
    Workspace key allocator and affected task rows in deterministic order; write task rows, tombstones, 
    aliases, lineage current pointers and both outbox events before commit. Any failure rolls back all 
    changes.
  sequences: Emit one task.moved event in each workspace stream, sharing transferId and carrying side=SOURCE 
    or TARGET. Each workspace event receives that workspace’s own monotonic workspaceSeq. Return both sequence
    values; same-workspace moves emit one event and one sequence.
  personalToShared: Requires a fresh preview and explicit confirmation after review of the audience change and
    NAMES_ONLY effects. Preview token expires in five minutes and is bound to actor, community, source 
    Workspace, target Workspace and subtree revision. The transferred root is top-level.
  idempotency: State-changing move uses X-Mutation-Id. Replaying the same mutation returns the original 
    committed result; reusing the key with a different payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.
  identityLineage: Each task/subtask has a stable opaque taskLineageId that survives same-community 
    cross-Workspace transfers. Each transfer creates fresh destination task UUIDs and keys, but updates 
    lineage currentTaskId/currentWorkspaceId atomically. Alias rows are insert-only and map to taskLineageId.
  workspaceValidation: Target Workspace must be active and belong to targetWorkspaceId and communityId. All 
    transferred source nodes must belong to the source Workspace. The recreated task tree must satisfy 
    destination maxSubtaskDepth; no intermediate container exists.
x-task-key-resolution-policy:
  status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_POLICY; ENGINEERING_IMPLEMENTATION_PENDING
  namespace:
    scope: COMMUNITY_SCOPED_WITH_ORIGIN_WORKSPACE_KEY_NAMESPACE
    lookupTuple:
    - communityId
    - namespaceWorkspaceId
    - normalizedKey
    normalizedKey: Uppercase canonical key form; key comparisons are case-normalized before lookup.
    namespaceMeaning: The workspace path parameter identifies the workspace key namespace that originally 
      issued the key; it is not proof of membership or access.
    uniqueness: Workspace key prefixes are unique across current and historical prefixes within a Community. 
      Each Workspace sequence is local, atomic, strictly increasing, never reset and never reused. The full 
      current key and historical alias namespace is therefore unique within the Community.
  identity:
    stableIdentifier: taskLineageId
