    visibility: Internal opaque identifier; never returned in public API DTOs or realtime events.
    perTask: Every root task and every subtask has its own lineage identity.
    mutableCurrentPointer:
    - currentTaskId
    - currentWorkspaceId
    crossWorkspaceTransfer: Create a fresh destination task UUID and update the lineage current pointer 
      atomically with aliases, tombstones and outbox records.
    sameWorkspaceMove: Preserve task UUID and lineage identity.
    crossCommunityClone: Create a new lineage identity; do not carry source aliases.
  aliasLedger:
    rowMapping: communityId + namespaceWorkspaceId + normalizedKey -> taskLineageId
    mutability: INSERT_ONLY; no UPDATE or DELETE by application roles.
    immutability: Alias namespace, normalized key and taskLineageId never change after insert.
    creation: Register every issued current key as an alias row. When a key changes, retain the old row and 
      insert the new key row.
    repeatedTransfers: All old namespace/key rows continue to point to the same stable lineage identity; the 
      lineage current pointer identifies the latest destination record.
    collision: A key collision in its community/workspace namespace aborts the move transaction with 
      TASK_KEY_ALIAS_CONFLICT.
    reuse: Never reuse a current or historical key for a different task lineage.
  lookup:
    route: GET /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/by-key/{taskKey}
    order:
    - Require an authenticated active community member; validate that the namespace workspace belongs to the 
      requested community, without requiring membership in that historical namespace workspace.
    - Resolve the exact key in the immutable community + namespace-workspace alias ledger to taskLineageId.
    - Read the lineage current state and current workspace; do not traverse redirects or follow task IDs 
      stored in aliases.
    - Authorize task:read using the caller’s current access and the current workspace/task authorization 
      context. Historical source-workspace membership is not sufficient.
    - Only after authorization may the service return current taskId, current workspaceId,, currentKey or 
      lifecycle metadata.
    - For ACTIVE or ARCHIVED lineage with a task record, return 200 TaskKeyResolutionDto. ARCHIVED includes 
      archivedAt and recoverableUntil.
    - Only after authorization may the service return current taskId, current workspaceId, currentKey or 
      lifecycle metadata.
    redirect: No HTTP 3xx response. Return a canonical DTO after authorization; the frontend may replace the 
      browser route after the successful 200.
    cache: 'Cache-Control: private, no-store on 200, 404 and 410 responses; do not use shared caches or reusable
      conditional responses.'
  nonDisclosure:
    generic404Cases:
    - unknown key
    - unknown or wrong-community namespace
    - missing community membership
    - missing lineage
    - current workspace inaccessible
    - caller lacks current task:read
    statusAndBody: All generic not-found cases return the same 404 status, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND code, Problem 
      shape and non-target-specific headers.
    forbiddenStatus: Do not return 403 for an existing alias whose current workspace is inaccessible.
    forbiddenDisclosure: Before authorization do not reveal taskId, currentKey, target workspace/workspace IDs
      or names, archive state, purge state, transfer history, alias existence, or whether a key was once 
      valid.
    timing: Use the same indexed lookup and response path where practical; do not claim mathematically 
      constant-time HTTP behavior.
    realtime: 'task.moved is strict in both workspace streams: transferId, side, movedTaskCount and local rootTaskId
      only. No counterpart/destination workspace ID, destination task ID, origin identifier or arbitrary extension
      property.'
  lifecycle:
    active: Return 200 after current-workspace task:read authorization.
    archived: Return 200 after current-workspace task:read authorization with lifecycleState=ARCHIVED, 
      archivedAt and recoverableUntil. A deadline passing does not itself change the lineage to PURGED.
    restored: Return 200 with lifecycleState=ACTIVE and null archive timestamps after successful restore.
    permanentlyPurged: Retain a minimal content-free lineage tombstone with currentWorkspaceId and sufficient 
      authorization context. Return 410 TASK_PERMANENTLY_PURGED only after current-workspace task:read 
      authorization. Do not return task IDs or keys in the 410 body.
    automaticPurge: Disabled pending CR-14 retention/legal policy approval. No 30-day automatic purge is 
      implied by the recoverableUntil field.
  transferTombstones: Source-workspace tombstones retain only the old local identity, stable lineage 
    reference, transfer/audit correlation and minimal lifecycle metadata; they must not contain a destination 
    taskId or destination workspaceId.
  migration: Backfill one lineage per live task, attach all task_key_aliases rows to that lineage, and 
    preserve each alias issuing workspace namespace. Ambiguous legacy aliases or collisions stop migration for
    manual reconciliation; never guess or reassign.
  prefixPolicy: 'OWNER CONFIRMED DEC-OPEN-06: Workspace-scoped sequence; Workspace prefixes are Community-unique,
    case-insensitive, canonical uppercase and permanently reserved. A prefix rename is Workspace Owner-only and
    atomic: reserve the new prefix in the Community registry; re-key every active task to NEWPREFIX-existingSequence;
    insert each old current key as an immutable alias; never reset or reuse sequence values; preserve all earlier
    aliases; audit and emit Workspace update in the same transaction. If the new prefix is already current or historically
    reserved, reject with WORKSPACE_KEY_PREFIX_ALREADY_IN_USE and make no changes. Prefix reservations are not released
    on Workspace archive, deletion or rename.'
  prefixRegistry:
    uniquenessScope: Community, case-insensitive normalized prefix
    reservation: INSERT_ONLY; current and retired prefixes remain reserved permanently within the Community
    rename: Atomic with current display-key re-key, immutable alias insertions, governance audit and outbox 
      event
    sequence: Workspace-local atomic BIGINT-like monotonic allocator; never reset, decrement or reuse after 
      archive, deletion, transfer or prefix rename
x-view-query-policy:
  canonicalQuery:
    singleEndpoint: POST /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/query
    querySpecIsProjectionIndependent: true
    projectionValues:
    - LIST
    - BOARD
    - CALENDAR
    - TIMELINE
    savedView: SavedView.viewType stores projection; SavedView.querySpec stores only the canonical AST.
    apiNames: camelCase field identifiers are canonical; legacy snake_case examples are non-normative.
  fieldWireMappings:
    createdById: Task creator relation; public DTO property TaskDto.creatorId.
    assigneeId: Task-assignee relation set; public DTO property TaskDto.assigneeIds.
    watcherId: Workspace-scoped task-watcher relation; do not infer from summary counts.
    labelId: Task-label relation set; public DTO property TaskDto.labelIds.
    currentKey: Canonical Task.current_key; public DTO property TaskDto.taskKey.
    customField: Resolve cf.{fieldKey} only inside the single path workspace to the immutable definition ID; 
      TaskDto.customFieldValues and baseFieldRevisions use definition IDs as map/path keys; SINGLE_SELECT 
      filter values use stable option UUIDs, never labels.
    noClientStoragePaths: Client-supplied storage column names, definition IDs, JSON paths and SQL expressions
      are not canonical query fields.
  authorizationAndMembership:
    securityFirst: true
    scope: Community/workspace path scope is enforced server-side; the client cannot broaden it via AST.
    requiredCapability: task:read
    personalWorkspace: Apply CR-01 privacy and active audited break-glass rules before query evaluation.
    archivedTasks: Excluded from normal views; Trash is a separate query surface.
    implicitFilters:
    - communityId
    - workspaceId
    - active workspace membership
    - effective task:read
    - archivedAt IS NULL
    applyOrder:
    - authorization scope
    - active-task baseline
    - user filter AST
    - includeCompleted
    - date window
    - backlog/unscheduled presentation buckets
  filterAst:
    rootConjunction:
    - AND
    - OR
    nestedGroups: Root plus at most one nested subgroup; subgroup contains leaves only.
    maxConditions: 50
    emptyRoot:
      AND: Matches all otherwise-authorized active tasks.
      OR: Matches no tasks.
    emptySubgroup: Invalid.
    operators:
    - EQ
    - NEQ
    - IN
    - NOT_IN
    - CONTAINS
    - IS_EMPTY
    - IS_NOT_EMPTY
    - GT
    - GTE
    - LT
    - LTE
    - BETWEEN
    operatorCompatibility:
      uuidRelations:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - IN
      - NOT_IN
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      multiValueRelations: 'assigneeId, watcherId and labelId: EQ/IN means at least one match; NEQ/NOT_IN means
        no related value matches.'
      enums:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - IN
      - NOT_IN
      dates:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - GT
      - GTE
      - LT
      - LTE
      - BETWEEN
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      timestamps:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - GT
      - GTE
      - LT
      - LTE
      - BETWEEN
      numbers:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - GT
      - GTE
      - LT
      - LTE
      - BETWEEN
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      booleans:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      fullText: q supports CONTAINS only and searches authorized task title and description fields.
      textCustomField:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - CONTAINS
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      numberOrDateCustomField:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - GT
      - GTE
      - LT
      - LTE
      - BETWEEN
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      booleanCustomField:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      singleSelectCustomField:
      - EQ
      - NEQ
      - IN
      - NOT_IN
      - IS_EMPTY
      - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      invalidOperator: 422 FILTER_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED; do not coerce or silently ignore.
    fieldValues:
      currentUserToken: $CURRENT_USER
      dateTokens:
      - $TODAY
      - $NEXT_7_DAYS
      dateTokenResolution: Workspace-local calendar dates captured at snapshot creation; NEXT_7_DAYS is today 
        plus the next six local dates.
      dateOnly: YYYY-MM-DD
      timestamp: RFC 3339 instant; normalized/compared in UTC.
      between: Inclusive lower and upper bounds; exactly two values.
      inArrays: One or more values; empty arrays are invalid.
      emptyOperators: IS_EMPTY and IS_NOT_EMPTY take no value property.
      typeCheck: Validate each field/operator/value against the canonical field registry and, for cf.*, the 
        active CustomFieldDefinition type; unknown or archived custom field is 422 FILTER_FIELD_INVALID.
    builtInFields:
    - statusCategory
    - priority
    - itemType
    - assigneeId
    - createdById
    - watcherId
    - labelId
    - milestoneId
    - cycleId
    - startDate
    - dueDate
    - createdAt
    - updatedAt
    - estimatePoints
    - hasBlocker
    - isOverdue
    - q
    customFieldSyntax: cf.<fieldKey>; fieldKey is a stable workspace custom-field key, never a user-supplied 
      SQL/JSON path.
    fieldRegistry:
      statusCategory:
        valueType: TaskStatusCategory
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
      priority:
        valueType: TaskPriority
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
      itemType:
        valueType: TaskType
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
      assigneeId:
        valueType: UUID_RELATION_SET
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
        multiValueSemantics: true
      createdById:
        valueType: UUID
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
      watcherId:
        valueType: UUID_RELATION_SET
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
        multiValueSemantics: true
      labelId:
        valueType: UUID_RELATION_SET
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
        multiValueSemantics: true
      milestoneId:
        valueType: UUID_OR_NULL
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      cycleId:
        valueType: UUID_OR_NULL
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - IN
        - NOT_IN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
        featureGate: CYCLES_OPT_IN
      startDate:
        valueType: DATE_OR_NULL
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - GT
        - GTE
        - LT
        - LTE
        - BETWEEN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      dueDate:
        valueType: DATE_OR_NULL
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - GT
        - GTE
        - LT
        - LTE
        - BETWEEN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      createdAt:
        valueType: RFC3339_TIMESTAMP
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - GT
        - GTE
        - LT
        - LTE
        - BETWEEN
      updatedAt:
        valueType: RFC3339_TIMESTAMP
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - GT
        - GTE
        - LT
        - LTE
        - BETWEEN
      estimatePoints:
        valueType: NUMBER_OR_NULL
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
        - GT
        - GTE
        - LT
        - LTE
        - BETWEEN
        - IS_EMPTY
        - IS_NOT_EMPTY
      hasBlocker:
        valueType: BOOLEAN
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
      isOverdue:
        valueType: BOOLEAN
        operators:
        - EQ
        - NEQ
      q:
        valueType: TEXT
        operators:
        - CONTAINS
    fieldSemantics:
      currentUserToken: $CURRENT_USER is accepted only for assigneeId, watcherId and createdById; it resolves 
        to the authenticated user UUID on the server.
      dateTokens: $TODAY and $NEXT_7_DAYS are accepted only for startDate and dueDate. $TODAY is a scalar date
        bound; $NEXT_7_DAYS is allowed only as the second/upper value of BETWEEN and resolves to today plus 
        six local dates. Resolution uses the workspace IANA timezone and snapshot-local date.
      nullOperators: For nullable scalar fields NEQ/NOT_IN exclude missing/null; use IS_EMPTY/IS_NOT_EMPTY 
        explicitly. For relation sets NEQ/NOT_IN means no related row matches, including an empty relation 
        set.
      hasBlocker: True when at least one active incoming BLOCKS predecessor is not in DONE or CANCELED. The 
        filter may reveal existence of a blocker but never identifies an inaccessible endpoint.
      isOverdue: True when dueDate is before workspace-local today and status is neither DONE nor CANCELED; a 
        missing dueDate is false.
      statusAndCompletion: DONE and CANCELED are closed categories for includeCompleted=false; BACKLOG is 
        partitioned separately by includeBacklog.
    legacyFields:
      statusId: 'Not supported by the active API contract: only TaskStatusCategory is exposed and there is no WorkflowStatus
        resource or statusId field. Use statusCategory until workflow-status lifecycle APIs are added.'
  customFieldCompatibility:
    phase1Types:
    - TEXT
    - NUMBER
    - DATE
    - BOOLEAN
    - SINGLE_SELECT
    filterAndSort: Typed according to the field definition; archived definitions are not queryable in new 
      filters/sorts.
    text: Unicode-normalized, case-insensitive comparison; CONTAINS is substring matching.
    number: Numeric comparison, not lexical string comparison.
    date: Workspace-local date comparison.
    boolean: Boolean comparison.
    singleSelect: Stable option UUIDs are comparison values; option labels are presentation only. CR-12 owns 
      option lifecycle and immutability. The active option DTO/request wire shape is still label-string based 
      and must be aligned to stable option IDs by CR-12 before generated client types or contract freeze.
    fieldKey: CustomFieldDefinitionDto.fieldKey is generated once, immutable, unique within its workspace, and
      used in cf.<fieldKey>.
  sort:
    maxUserSortTerms: 3
    stableTieBreaker: The server always appends task id ascending after all requested sort terms. id is not a 
      permitted user sort field; it cannot be supplied or overridden.
    nulls: Always LAST regardless of ASC/DESC.
    rankKey: Fractional rank is meaningful within the Workspace/status/parent ordering context; deterministic 
      status/container order is resolved first, then rankKey ASC, then task id ASC.
    priorityOrder:
    - URGENT
    - HIGH
    - MEDIUM
    - LOW
    - NONE
    customField: 'Use the declared native type: numeric, date, boolean, text collation, or single-select option
      order.'
    currentKeyMapping: Canonical Task.current_key; exposed on TaskDto as taskKey.
    default: rankKey ASC, with deterministic container ordering and server-appended task id ASC tie-breaker.
    allowedUserFields:
    - rankKey
    - priority
    - dueDate
    - startDate
    - createdAt
    - currentKey
    - cf.<fieldKey>
  grouping:
    groupBy:
    - statusCategory
    - priority
    - assigneeId
    - milestoneId
    - none
    subGroupBy:
    - none
    - assigneeId
    - priority
    presentationOnly: true
    boardDefault: statusCategory; no swimlane; first page is 50 tasks per visible group.
    boardGroupCursors: Each group/child group owns an opaque cursor; pageScope=GROUP and groupKey request its 
      next page.
    multiAssignee: When groupBy or subGroupBy is assigneeId, a multi-assignee task appears once in each 
      corresponding assignee bucket; the union of bucket IDs equals canonical membership, while per-bucket 
      totals may overlap and are non-additive.
    nullBuckets: Nullable milestoneId and assigneeId values use explicit Unassigned buckets. Priority NONE is 
      a separate bucket; Workspace identity is supplied by the route and is not a grouping field.
    order: Status categories use BACKLOG, TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELED order; priority uses URGENT, HIGH,
      MEDIUM, LOW, NONE; assignee buckets sort by normalized display name then user UUID; Unassigned is last. 
      Workspace grouping is not part of a single-Workspace view query.
  subtasks:
    modes:
    - NESTED
    - TOP_LEVEL_ONLY
    - FLATTENED
    default: NESTED
    membership: The selected mode is part of ViewQuerySpec and applies identically to all projections.
    nestedContext: Non-matching ancestor rows are never returned. parentTaskId is included only if the caller 
      is authorized to read the parent; otherwise it is null. No ancestor title, key or identifier is 
      disclosed through breadcrumb context.
    contextRows: NONE; only canonical filter matches are task rows and task-count members.
  statusBuckets:
    includeCompleted: Default true; false excludes DONE and CANCELED in every projection.
    includeBacklog: Default false; BACKLOG tasks are placed in the separate backlog tray. True places them in 
      the primary grouped results. It never silently destroys or hides the ability to page through backlog 
      tasks.
    backlogTray: When includeBacklog=false, backlogPreview is capped at 20 and backlogNextCursor pages the 
      rest.
  dateWindow:
    requiredFor:
    - CALENDAR
    - TIMELINE
    fields:
    - dateField
    - from
    - to
    - includeUnscheduled
    dateField:
    - DUE_DATE
    - START_TO_DUE_SPAN
    bounds: from/to are inclusive workspace-local YYYY-MM-DD dates; from must be <= to; max window 366 
      calendar days inclusive.
    dueDateMode: Match dueDate within the inclusive window; a missing dueDate is unscheduled even when 
      startDate exists.
    spanMode: Use startDate ?? dueDate as inclusive start and dueDate ?? startDate as inclusive end; match if 
      the task span overlaps the date window. Both dates null means unscheduled.
    timezone: Use the workspace IANA timezone captured at query snapshot creation; clients cannot override it 
      with a browser timezone.
    invalid: 422 DATE_WINDOW_INVALID; dateField/projection mismatch or missing range for Calendar/Timeline is 
      422 DATE_WINDOW_REQUIRED.
  unscheduled:
    rule: With a dateWindow and includeUnscheduled=true, tasks without the selected date/duration are paged in
      a separate unscheduled tray; they are not inserted into the dated items page.
    preview: unscheduledPreview contains at most 20 entries; unscheduledCount and unscheduledNextCursor cover 
      the entire unscheduled set.
    noDateWindow: Unscheduled bucketing is not applied.
  projections:
    LIST: Flat canonical TaskDto pages; client constructs the expandable tree using parentTaskId and the 
      selected subtaskMode.
    BOARD: Grouped buckets (normally statusCategory) with per-bucket totals and independently paged cards; 
      top-level cards are the default surface while subtaskMode controls canonical membership.
    CALENDAR: Dated tasks matching dateWindow plus separate unscheduled tray; workspace-level milestones 
      remain optional WorkspaceMilestone markers, not task rows. They are fetched through the Workspace 
      milestones resource and are not TaskQueryResult rows or task counts.
    TIMELINE: Hierarchical task rows and dependency edges touching the query set; inaccessible opposite 
      endpoints are represented only as Restricted Task, without key/title/UUID disclosure. Optional Workspace
      milestone markers are rendered separately from TaskQueryResult rows.
    projectionDoesNotChangeFilter: true
    sameQueryMembership: The projection must not add/remove task identities. Presentation buckets are a 
      lossless partition of the same matching set, except explicit subtaskMode, includeCompleted, and 
      dateWindow query semantics.
    projectedTaskFields:
      statusCategory: The active API status grouping/filter field. Custom status IDs are not queryable until 
        the WorkflowStatus resource contract is added.
      workspaceId: Required on TaskDto; the current route supplies the Workspace scope, not an intermediate 
        container.
  pagination:
    cursor: Opaque, integrity-protected and server-managed; never client-computed offset/page numbers.
    snapshot: First request materializes ordered task IDs, bucket assignments and counts as one query 
      snapshot; cursor pages use that immutable membership/order snapshot.
    snapshotSequence: Capture the workspace sequence watermark at snapshot creation.
    rowRead: Task DTO field values are read at page-fetch time; membership/order/counts remain anchored to the
      initial snapshot. Realtime events newer than snapshotSequence should invalidate/refetch the query.
    authorization: Re-evaluate current workspace membership, task:read, Personal Workspace privacy and 
      break-glass scope on every page and re-projection. A cursor or querySnapshotId is not an authorization 
      token. Omit individual rows that are no longer visible; if workspace access is revoked, deny the request
      using the workspace authorization response contract.
    binding:
    - communityId
    - workspaceId
    - principalId
    - canonical query hash
    - pageScope/groupKey
    - snapshot ID
    expiry: Return 409 QUERY_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED after a fixed, absolute, non-sliding 900-second TTL from 
      snapshot creation.
    defaultLimit:
      LIST: 200
      BOARD: 50
      CALENDAR: 200
      TIMELINE: 200
    maxLimit: 200
    boardLimit: 50
    projectionBinding: Projection is excluded from the canonical query hash and snapshot membership. The same 
      querySnapshotId can be re-projected as LIST, BOARD, CALENDAR or TIMELINE with an unchanged querySpec. 
      Page scope/groupKey may differ for supported tray/group continuation pages.
    querySnapshotId: A first request omits querySnapshotId and creates the snapshot. A later request may 
      supply querySnapshotId without a cursor to retrieve the first page in a different projection from the 
      exact same canonical task ID set, using the identical querySpec. A continuation supplies the returned 
      cursor; if querySnapshotId is also present it must identify the same snapshot embedded in the cursor. 
      The handle never grants access.
    snapshotTtlSeconds: 900
    snapshotTtlMode: FIXED_ABSOLUTE_NON_SLIDING
    cursorReplay: Cursors are replayable within the snapshot TTL; a repeated cursor does not consume it and 
      returns the same continuation page.
    cursorExpiry: All cursors and querySnapshotId handles expire with the same snapshotExpiresAt timestamp.
    pageLimitValidation: limit must be 1..200; reject invalid limits with 422 PAGINATION_LIMIT_INVALID and 
      never silently clamp. BOARD remains limited to 50 per group.
    snapshotAtomicity: Ordered task IDs, membership, bucket assignments, counts and snapshotSequence are 
      captured from one consistent database query snapshot.
    revokedRows: Rows no longer visible at page-fetch time are omitted without backfilling from outside the 
      original snapshot; a page may be shorter than requested.
    liveAuthorization: Re-authorize the current session, community/workspace membership, task:read, Personal 
      Workspace privacy and break-glass scope on every continuation/re-projection. Deny revoked workspace 
      access with the normal non-enumerating response.
  savedViewAndUrl:
    savedView: Persist querySpec AST and viewType separately; SaveViewRequest and UpdateSavedViewRequest can 
      set the saved projection without embedding it in querySpec.
    transient: Filter/sort/group edits remain URL draft state until explicit Save; never auto-patch a shared 
      saved view.
    navigation: Calendar month and Timeline scroll/zoom are local presentation navigation state, not saved 
      shared query mutations.
  errorCodes:
  - FILTER_FIELD_INVALID
  - FILTER_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED
  - DATE_WINDOW_REQUIRED
  - DATE_WINDOW_INVALID
  - QUERY_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED
  - QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID
  pipeline:
    applyOrder:
    - current authorization scope
    - active-task baseline (archivedAt IS NULL)
    - user filter AST
    - includeCompleted status rule
    - backlog partition when includeBacklog=false
    - date window for primary tasks and for backlog tasks only when includeBacklog=true
    - unscheduled partition for non-backlog date-window tasks when includeUnscheduled=true
    backlogPartition: When includeBacklog=false, BACKLOG tasks matching the AST and includeCompleted rule 
      enter the independent backlog tray before date-window bucketing; they are not counted as 
      dated/unscheduled primary items. When includeBacklog=true, BACKLOG tasks remain in the primary set and 
      follow the same date-window and unscheduled rules as other tasks.
    commonMembership: Projection is applied after canonical membership, not as an additional task filter. Only
      explicit querySpec fields alter canonical membership.
  resultCounts:
    total: Distinct task IDs across primary, backlog and unscheduled partitions.
    primaryCount: Distinct IDs in primary page membership after backlog/unscheduled partitioning.
    backlogCount: Distinct IDs in backlog tray; zero when includeBacklog=true.
    unscheduledCount: Distinct IDs in unscheduled tray; zero without dateWindow or when 
      includeUnscheduled=false.
    groupTotals: May overlap only when grouping by assigneeId; never sum them to infer total.
  customFieldContract:
    definitionScope: Workspace-scoped, shared by every workspace/task in that workspace.
    fieldKey: Immutable, workspace-unique server-generated key used in the AST as cf.{fieldKey}.
    singleSelectFilterValue: Option UUIDv7; option label is never a filter value.
    singleSelectSort: Configured active option sortOrder, then stable optionId tie-breaker.
    archivedOptionFilter: An archived option UUID remains queryable on an active definition to find historical
      task values; it cannot be newly assigned.
    archivedDefinition: Archived field keys are invalid in newly executed filter/sort ASTs.
    myWork: Reject cf.* conditions and custom-field sorts on the cross-workspace 
      /communities/{communityId}/my-work/query endpoint. Custom-field keys are workspace-local; use 
      /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/query for one workspace.
    invalid: Unknown, archived or foreign-workspace field keys and type/operator/value mismatches return 422 
      FILTER_FIELD_INVALID or FILTER_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED. No coercion.
x-task-permission-policy:
  status: DEC_OPEN_02_PRODUCT_DECISION_APPROVED_PENDING_JOINT_REVIEW
  defaults:
    taskEditPolicy: CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT
    viewer: READ_ONLY_EXCEPT_WATCH
    permanentPurge: OWNER_ONLY_NON_DELEGABLE
    assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed: []
    assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault: []
  permissionEvaluation:
    securityFloor: 'Security floor is evaluated first: same-community/current-workspace isolation, active membership
      and suspension checks; Personal Workspace privacy and CR-01 break-glass rules are non-overridable.'
    baseGrants: Workspace Owner and Coordinator privileges, plus explicitly granted workspace-role 
      capabilities.
    contextualGrants: Task Creator, active Task Assigner and active Task Assignee relations grant only the 
      task-scoped rights listed below; relationship grants never bypass workspace membership or security 
      floor.
    workspacePolicy: taskEditPolicy applies after base/contextual grants. Assignee field grants are computed 
      separately as the intersection of task.assigneeEditableFieldGroups and 
      workspace.assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed.
    rolePreview: X-Preview-Role-Id is downward-only. Final permissions are intersected with the preview role 
      mask; it can never add a capability, including for an Owner.
    liveReevaluation: Re-evaluate membership, role, task relationships and settings on every mutation; role 
      removal or assignment removal takes effect on the next request.
    taskLevelAssigneeFieldGrants: In CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT, active assignees receive the baseline 
      execution rights plus the intersection of the task.assigneeEditableFieldGroups and the current Workspace
      assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed ceiling. The Task Creator chooses the per-task subset; Workspace 
      Owners set the ceiling/default and may override task grant metadata. These grants are additive only and 
      never reduce rights independently granted by role or creator/assigner context.
  workspaceSettings:
    taskEditPolicy:
      ownerOnly: true
      default: CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT
      strict: Owner/Coordinator and task Creator/active Assigner receive task-definition editing; task Creator
        and active Assignees receive execution rights. Ordinary MEMBER receives create/comment/watch, but not 
        task-definition or status/assignment/subtask editing by default.
      collaborative: All ACTIVE workspace members except the read-only VIEWER role receive task definition 
        editing, status update, assignment and subtask-management rights. It does not grant move, archive, 
        restore, permanent purge or role-administration rights.
      viewerExcluded: true
    assigneeFieldGrantPolicy:
      ownerOnly: true
      allowedFieldGroupsDefault: []
      defaultFieldGroupsDefault: []
      defaultMustBeSubsetOfAllowed: true
      allowedFieldGroups:
      - TITLE_DESCRIPTION
      - DATES_PRIORITY
      - CUSTOM_FIELDS_LINKS
      effect: The allowed list is the maximum delegation ceiling. The default list is applied only to newly 
        created tasks. Removing a group from the ceiling immediately removes its effective permission on all 
        tasks; task-level stored selections are retained and are effective only while allowed.
      existingTasks: Changing the Workspace default does not rewrite existing task grants. A ceiling reduction
        immediately affects existing tasks. Restoring a group to the ceiling may reactivate a task-level 
        selection that was previously configured by its creator.
      personalWorkspace: Personal Workspaces have no other workspace members to receive task assignments; 
        allowed/default arrays should remain empty unless the product later supports shared assignees in 
        Personal Workspaces.
      defaultsApplyTo: New tasks only. Explicit creator-supplied groups on task creation override the 
        Workspace default only when the supplied set is a subset of the allowed ceiling.
  contextualRoles:
    taskCreator: Task Creator identity is immutable provenance. In strict mode it grants 
      canEditTitleDescription, canEditDatesPriority, canEditCustomFieldsLinks, canEditEstimate, canAssign, 
      canUpdateStatus, canManageSubtasks, canCreateSubtask where depth allows, canComment and 
      canManageAssigneeFieldGrants while active in the Workspace.
    taskAssigner: A user is an active Task Assigner while at least one current active assignee relation on 
      this task has assignedByUserId equal to that user. It grants the four definition-edit flags and 
      canAssign; it does not by itself grant execution rights.
    taskAssignee: Any active assignee relation grants canUpdateStatus, canManageSubtasks, canComment and 
      canEditEstimate. In CREATOR_COORDINATOR_STRICT, it additionally grants canEditTitleDescription, 
      canEditDatesPriority, or canEditCustomFieldsLinks only when the corresponding 
      task.assigneeEditableFieldGroups value is present and also permitted by 
      Workspace.assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed. The same task-level group set applies to every active 
      assignee. Per-assignee grant differences are not supported. Removing the active assignment revokes these
      rights immediately.
    union: 'Multiple assignees are additive: the actor receives the union of applicable contextual grants. Creator/Assigner/Assignee
      overlaps are additive, subject to security floor and role-preview mask.'
    revocation: Removing an assignee relation removes the assignee grant and any assigner grant based solely 
      on that relation immediately. Historical assignment activity never grants permission.
    subtasks: An assignee may manage descendants under the assigned parent (or children of an assigned 
      subtask) while active, in the same workspace, and within maxSubtaskDepth. Depth limit blocks 
      canCreateSubtask but does not remove canManageSubtasks for existing descendants.
    workspaceOwnerAssigneeFieldGrantOverride: An active Workspace Owner may configure 
      assigneeEditableFieldGroups on any task for governance and continuity, even when not the task creator. A
      Coordinator or Task Assigner does not receive this permission solely from that role.
  capabilitySemantics:
    taskEditDefinition: Aggregate compatibility capability task:edit_definition expands to 
      task:edit_title_description, task:edit_dates_priority, task:edit_custom_fields_links and 
      task:edit_estimate. It does not imply task:assign.
    granularCapabilities: Granular field capabilities may be granted independently by a workspace role.
    assignment: task:assign is distinct from field-definition editing; contextual Creator/Assigner grants it 
      under the strict policy.
    permanentPurge: task:delete_permanent is non-delegable and is true only for an active Workspace Owner.
    ownerCoordinator: Owner/Coordinator receive the standard task-management action set; permanent purge 
      remains Owner-only.
    personalWorkspace: Personal Workspace owner has full owner-scoped permissions. An active CR-01 break-glass
      session is read-only and forces every mutation/action permission flag false.
  fieldCapabilities:
    title: canEditTitleDescription
    description: canEditTitleDescription
    itemType: canEditTitleDescription
    startDate: canEditDatesPriority
    dueDate: canEditDatesPriority
    priority: canEditDatesPriority
    estimatePoints: canEditEstimate
    customFieldValues: canEditCustomFieldsLinks
    labelIds: canEditCustomFieldsLinks
    milestoneId: canEditCustomFieldsLinks
    taskLinks: canEditCustomFieldsLinks
    statusCategory: canUpdateStatus
    assigneeIds: canAssign
    parentTaskId: canManageSubtasks; creating a child additionally requires canCreateSubtask
    rankPlacement: canMove
    commentCreate: canComment
    watchToggle: canWatch
    archive: canArchive
    restore: canRestore
    permanentPurge: canDeletePermanent
    statusSignoffRequest: canRequestSignoff
    statusSignoffDecision: canApproveSignoff
  assignmentModel:
    multipleAssignees: Allowed. assigneeIds must contain distinct UUIDs.
    membership: Every assignee must be an ACTIVE member of the same workspace at create/assignment commit.
    provenance: Each active task_assignees row stores taskId, userId, assignedByUserId and assignedAt. 
      assignedByUserId is server-derived from SecurityContext.
    dto: TaskDto.assigneeAssignments returns one TaskAssigneeAssignmentDto per active relation. The ambiguous 
      task-level assignedByUserId is not used.
    replacement: Unchanged assignee relations retain assignedByUserId/assignedAt; newly added relations use 
      the current actor; removed relations no longer confer contextual rights.
    uniqueness: At most one active relation per (taskId,userId).
  authorizationResponses:
    unreadableOrInaccessible: 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, same as unknown task; do not reveal task existence.
    readableButActionDenied: 403 INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY or TASK_FIELD_FORBIDDEN.
    fieldAtomicity: A multi-field patch is rejected in full if any field is unauthorized; no partial write.
    permissionDto: 'Returned only as an actor-specific projection after task:read authorization; Cache-Control:
      private, no-store.'
    reasons: restrictedActions is optional, contains action/reasonCode only, and is not an authorization 
      token.
    client: Frontend flags are UX affordances only; server is authoritative for every action.
  phase3Signoff: canRequestSignoff/canApproveSignoff are included for forward compatibility. They are false 
    unless a Phase 3 sign-off gate is configured; CR-05 does not activate the Phase 3 workflow feature.
  openDependencies:
  - CR-06 capability catalog, flat role model, grant ceiling, reserved capabilities, role lifecycle and 
    Coordinator invitation restrictions are specified in x-workspace-role-policy; joint review/runtime 
    verification remains required.
  - CR-08 finalizes comment edit/delete ownership semantics; CR-05 only defines comment creation and watch 
    affordances.
  roleCapabilityRestrictions:
    nonDelegable:
    - workspace:administer_roles
    - workspace:update_settings
    - workspace:transfer_ownership
    - workspace:archive
    - workspace:restore
    - task:delete_permanent
    validation: Reject attempts to create or update a custom workspace role containing any reserved Owner-only
      capability with 422 CAPABILITY_NOT_DELEGABLE. Only an active Workspace Owner receives these 
      capabilities; task:delete_permanent remains governed by CR-05 canDeletePermanent.
    ownerOnly: These restrictions cannot be bypassed by COLLABORATIVE_MEMBER, task Creator/Assigner/Assignee 
      contextual grants, Community Admin status, Platform Operator status or role preview.
  effectivePermissions:
    canManageAssigneeFieldGrants: true only for the active Task Creator or an active Workspace Owner; false 
      for a Coordinator or Assigner acting only under that role.
    fieldGrantComputation: For an actor relying on the active-assignee contextual grant, each additional field
      permission is enabled only when that actor is an active assignee and the relevant group appears in both 
      task.assigneeEditableFieldGroups and workspace.assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed. Independent Owner, 
      Coordinator, Creator, Assigner or COLLABORATIVE_MEMBER rights are computed separately and remain 
      additive; task-level assignee grants never reduce them.
    preview: The downward-only preview mask is applied after all computed permissions, including 
      canManageAssigneeFieldGrants.
  audit:
    workspacePolicyChanges: Changes to assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed or 
      assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault are recorded in the append-only governance audit ledger in the same 
      transaction as the Workspace settings mutation, using WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_CHANGED (category 
      WORKSPACE_GOVERNANCE, targetType WORKSPACE) and changedFields codes 
      assigneeFieldGrantCeiling/assigneeFieldGrantDefault. Metadata may include previous/new allow-listed 
      group codes only.
    taskGrantChanges: Changes to Task.assigneeEditableFieldGroups are recorded in the append-only governance 
      audit ledger in the same transaction as the task mutation, using TASK_ASSIGNEE_FIELD_GRANTS_CHANGED 
      (category ROLE_AND_PERMISSION, targetType TASK, targetId task UUID). Metadata contains actor UUID and 
      the previous/new task grant group codes; it never contains task title, description, comment or other 
      user content.
    failure: If the required audit write cannot be committed atomically, reject the governed mutation; never 
      persist the permission change without its audit record.
x-workspace-role-policy:
  status: ENGINEERING_POLICY_SPECIFIED_PENDING_JOINT_REVIEW
  model:
    scope: One WorkspaceRole definition per Workspace; each workspace membership references exactly one 
      roleId. Role definitions are workspace-scoped and never shared across communities or workspaces.
    inheritance: NONE. Roles are flat complete capability sets. There are no parent roles, role stacking or 
      transitive role inheritance. CR-05 task relationship grants are separate task-scoped overlays, not role 
      inheritance.
    policyKeys: Use stable systemKey values for built-in role identity and capability codes for authorization.
      Never branch authorization on the role display name. A built-in role has isBuiltIn=true and a non-null 
      systemKey; a custom role has isBuiltIn=false and systemKey=null.
    membershipDto: WorkspaceMemberDto.roleSystemKey exposes the stable built-in identity (null for custom 
      roles); effectiveCapabilities describes only workspace-role grants, not task Creator/Assigner/Assignee 
      contextual rights.
    builtInRoles:
      immutable: true
      identities:
      - OWNER
      - COORDINATOR
      - MEMBER
      - VIEWER
      seededCapabilitySets:
        OWNER:
          allRoleCapabilities: true
          note: Receives all RoleCapability values, including the owner-only and non-delegable capabilities. 
            Personal Workspace ownership is still single-user and does not create additional members.
        COORDINATOR:
          capabilities:
          - workspace:read_metadata
          - workspace:invite_members
          - task:read
          - task:create
          - task:edit_definition
          - task:update_status
          - task:assign
          - task:manage_subtasks
          - task:move
          - task:comment
          - task:watch
          - task:archive
          - task:restore
          - task:request_signoff
          - task:approve_signoff
          - workspace:configure_workflow
          - saved_view:manage_shared
        MEMBER:
          capabilities:
          - workspace:read_metadata
          - task:read
          - task:create
          - task:comment
          - task:watch
        VIEWER:
          capabilities:
          - workspace:read_metadata
          - task:read
          - task:watch
      owner: Full workspace authority, including all reserved owner-only capabilities. Multiple active Owners 
        are supported.
      coordinator: Standard task-management authority, workspace/workflow configuration, shared-view 
        management and conditional invitation of MEMBER/VIEWER only. No role administration, security-setting 
        changes, ownership transfer, audit access by default or permanent purge.
      member: Workspace metadata read, task read/create, comment and watch by default. CR-05 
        COLLABORATIVE_MEMBER overlays the defined broader task editing rights for every ACTIVE non-Viewer 
        workspace member.
      viewer: Workspace metadata read, task read and watch only; read-only for all other actions.
      personalWorkspace: Exactly one owner; no custom roles, additional membership, Coordinator auto-add or 
        workspace ownership transfer.
    customRoles:
      createUpdateDelete: Active Workspace Owner only, in SHARED Workspaces.
      name: Trim whitespace; 1-80 characters; unique case-insensitively per workspace; built-in role names are
        reserved.
      description: Optional, nullable on update, maximum 500 characters.
      capabilities: Complete replacement set, unique values; array length 1-64.
      updateSemantics: PATCH fields omitted by caller remain unchanged; when capabilities is supplied it 
        replaces, never merges with, the old set.
      deletion: Only an unused custom role may be deleted. Referenced by any ACTIVE, INVITED or SUSPENDED 
        membership means ROLE_IN_USE. No silent reassignment; preserve immutable audit references; never reuse
        UUIDs.
      mutation: Role definition write and audit/outbox record are atomic. Changes are re-evaluated on the next
        API request; invalidate derived role/capability caches and active realtime authorization state.
    coordinator: Standard task-management authority, Workspace workflow configuration, shared-view management 
      and conditional invitation of MEMBER/VIEWER only. No role administration, security-setting changes, 
      ownership transfer, audit access by default or permanent purge.
  grantCeiling:
    formula: granted_caps must be a subset of actor_workspace_role_caps AND the 
      delegable_capability_allowlist.
    actorScope: Use the actor's current workspace-role capabilities only. Do not count task Creator, active 
      Assigner or active Assignee contextual grants, break-glass status, Community Admin authority or Platform
      Operator authority toward this ceiling.
    enforcement: Validate server-side on custom-role create/update and every role assignment/invitation. Do 
      not trust client previews or builder UI.
    excess: 403 CAPABILITY_GRANT_EXCEEDS_ACTOR; record a security audit event with actor, workspace, target 
      capability code(s), operation and outcome.
    reserved: 422 CAPABILITY_NOT_DELEGABLE for a known capability that is reserved/non-delegable. Unknown 
      capability codes are rejected as CAPABILITY_CODE_INVALID (422).
    ownerOnlyCapabilities:
    - workspace:administer_roles
    - workspace:update_settings
    - workspace:transfer_ownership
    - workspace:archive
    - workspace:restore
    - task:delete_permanent
    communityOnlyNotInWorkspaceCatalog:
    - community:global_admin
    - community:create_shared_workspace
    - platform:operator
  prerequisites:
  - capability: workspace:invite_members
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:manage_members
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:administer_roles
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:update_settings
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:transfer_ownership
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:archive
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:restore
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: workspace:configure_workflow
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: audit:read
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
  - capability: task:create
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:edit_definition
    expandsTo:
    - task:edit_title_description
    - task:edit_dates_priority
    - task:edit_custom_fields_links
    - task:edit_estimate
    alsoRequires:
    - task:read
    doesNotImply:
    - task:assign
  - capability: task:edit_title_description
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:edit_dates_priority
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:edit_custom_fields_links
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:edit_estimate
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:update_status
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:assign
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:manage_subtasks
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:move
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:comment
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:watch
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:archive
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:restore
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:request_signoff
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: task:approve_signoff
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: saved_view:manage_shared
    requires:
    - task:read
  - capability: audit:export
    requires:
    - audit:read
  - capability: workspace:manage_custom_fields
    requires:
    - workspace:read_metadata
    - task:read
  invalidSet: Return 422 CAPABILITY_PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED with safe missing prerequisite capability codes; 
    reject the complete role change.
  assignment:
    oneRolePerMembership: true
    roleGrantCeiling: The assigned role's full capability set must be a subset of the acting user's current 
      workspace-role capabilities and delegable allowlist. Applying a role never permits the actor to delegate
      powers they do not possess.
    ownerPromotion: Built-in OWNER cannot be assigned through addWorkspaceMember or updateWorkspaceMember. Use
      only the dedicated owner-transfer endpoint.
    coordinatorInvite: coordinatorCanInviteMembers is Workspace Owner-only and defaults true. If enabled, a 
      built-in COORDINATOR with workspace:invite_members can add/invite only built-in MEMBER or VIEWER. It 
      cannot assign COORDINATOR, OWNER or custom roles and cannot gain member-removal/role-definition powers 
      from this setting. If disabled, this Coordinator invitation grant is suppressed.
    ownerInvariant: A SHARED Workspace must retain at least one ACTIVE Owner. Last Owner cannot leave, be 
      demoted, suspended or removed. Multiple Owners are allowed. Ownership promotion/demotion is atomic via 
      owner-transfer.
    defaultCoordinators: Community Default Coordinators are preselected when a SHARED Workspace is created, 
      but the Owner may remove them at creation or later. Their behavior derives only from their current 
      workspace role; isDefaultCoordinator metadata alone grants no hidden capability.
    revocation: Membership removal/suspension, role reassignment or role capability removal applies to the 
      next API request and must invalidate all affected realtime subscriptions/authorization caches.
  bundles:
  - name: Workspace Governance
    capabilities:
    - workspace:read_metadata
    - workspace:update_settings
    - workspace:administer_roles
    - workspace:archive
    - workspace:restore
    - audit:read
    - audit:export
    note: Reserved Owner-only capabilities are visible but disabled for custom roles; audit access may be 
      delegated independently.
  - name: Member Management
    capabilities:
    - workspace:invite_members
    - workspace:manage_members
    - workspace:transfer_ownership
    note: Ownership transfer is Owner-only and the Coordinator invitation exception is further restricted to 
      MEMBER/VIEWER while enabled.
  - name: Workflow Configuration
    capabilities:
    - workspace:configure_workflow
  - name: Shared Views & Templates
    capabilities:
    - saved_view:manage_shared
    note: Custom template management remains deferred; this bundle does not activate Phase 2 template CRUD.
  - name: Task Execution & Collaboration
    capabilities:
    - task:read
    - task:create
    - task:edit_definition
    - task:edit_title_description
    - task:edit_dates_priority
    - task:edit_custom_fields_links
    - task:edit_estimate
    - task:update_status
    - task:assign
    - task:manage_subtasks
    - task:move
    - task:comment
    - task:watch
    - task:request_signoff
    - task:approve_signoff
    note: Sign-off capabilities remain false until the Phase 3 gate is implemented. File/attachment 
      capabilities are intentionally absent.
  - name: Task Destructive Actions
    capabilities:
    - task:archive
    - task:restore
    - task:delete_permanent
    note: task:delete_permanent is permanently non-delegable and Owner-only.
  - name: Custom Fields & Task Schema
    capabilities:
    - workspace:manage_custom_fields
    note: Workspace Owner receives this by default; Coordinator/Member/Viewer do not. An Owner may grant it to
      an eligible custom role.
  preview:
    readOnly: true
    finalCapabilities: actor_workspace_role_caps intersect preview_role_caps intersect security_floor
    mutation: All state-mutating API requests are rejected with 403 PREVIEW_MODE_READ_ONLY, including raw 
      requests bypassing UI controls.
    authority: Preview is explanatory only; it never changes membership or authorization and is not an 
      authorization token.
  auditEvents:
  - CUSTOM_ROLE_CREATED
  - CUSTOM_ROLE_UPDATED
  - CUSTOM_ROLE_DELETED
  - ROLE_ASSIGNED
  - ROLE_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION_DENIED
  errorCodes:
    403:
    - CAPABILITY_GRANT_EXCEEDS_ACTOR
    - COORDINATOR_INVITE_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED
    - INSUFFICIENT_CAPABILITY
    - PREVIEW_MODE_READ_ONLY
    409:
    - ROLE_IN_USE
    - ROLE_NAME_CONFLICT
    - LAST_OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE
    422:
    - CAPABILITY_NOT_DELEGABLE
    - CAPABILITY_PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED
    - CAPABILITY_CODE_INVALID
    - ROLE_BUILT_IN_IMMUTABLE
    - OWNER_PROMOTION_REQUIRES_TRANSFER
  securityFloors:
    communityIsolation: Non-overridable; Community Admin is scoped to one CommunityMembership and is never a 
      workspace-role capability.
    platformOperator: Separate operational plane; no silent tenant content access and never a role capability.
    personalWorkspace: Single-owner privacy and no custom role/member mutation.
    breakGlass: CR-01 audited read-only grant is independent of workspace role capabilities; it grants no 
      workspace role, membership or mutation right.
    taskAuthorization: CR-05 live server authorization, contextual grants, field-level all-or-nothing checks 
      and no-store actor-relative DTO rules remain in force.
  dependencies:
  - CR-11 retains final Shared View scope and saved-view RBAC validation.
  - CR-08 retains comment edit/delete/mention semantics.
  - CR-07 invitation lifecycle, acceptance, and membership-state transitions are specified in 
    x-membership-policy and community-workspace-membership-policy.md; CR-10 and CR-13 retain email 
    delivery/provider details.
  statusNote: These are contract/policy specifications pending joint frontend/backend/security/product review;
    no application implementation or runtime test is claimed.
  customFieldAdministration:
    capability: workspace:manage_custom_fields
    defaultRoles:
    - OWNER
    notDefaultRoles:
    - COORDINATOR
    - MEMBER
    - VIEWER
    delegation: Only an active Workspace Owner may grant this capability to a custom role, subject to the 
      existing CR-06 grant ceiling and workspace:read_metadata prerequisite.
    taskValues: This schema-management capability does not grant task-value editing. Task values remain 
      governed by task:create on creation and TaskPermissions.canEditCustomFieldsLinks on update.
x-membership-policy:
  communityMembership:
    states:
    - ACTIVE
    - SUSPENDED
    invitedState: Community invitations are separate invitation records; no CommunityMembership row exists 
      until acceptance.
    initialRole: New community members are not Community Admins. Community Admin is granted later by an 
      existing Community Admin through updateCommunityMember.
    defaultCoordinator: isDefaultCoordinator is an explicit community-scoped pool flag. It defaults false and 
      takes effect only for future Shared Workspace creation. Removing it does not mutate existing workspace 
      membership roles.
    suspension: DELETE /communities/{communityId}/members/{userId} is a soft suspension. Preserve identity and
      task/audit history; clear isCommunityAdmin and isDefaultCoordinator; suspend all workspace memberships 
      in this community; revoke pending workspace invites addressed to or created by this user.
    restore: Community Admin may reactivate CommunityMembership. WorkspaceMembership rows remain SUSPENDED and
      must be restored individually by their workspace authority after rechecking CR-06 role grant ceiling.
    lastOwnerFloor: Do not suspend a community member who is the only ACTIVE Owner of any Shared Workspace. 
      Return 409 COMMUNITY_MEMBER_IS_LAST_WORKSPACE_OWNER until ownership is transferred/recovered.
  workspaceMembership:
    states:
    - ACTIVE
    - INVITED
    - SUSPENDED
    personalWorkspace: Single active Owner only. No workspace invites, additional members, Coordinator 
      pre-inclusion or ownership transfer.
    invited: An INVITED WorkspaceMembership is a pending placeholder with roleId for grant validation and 
      role-in-use protection; it grants no workspace read, write, search, realtime or export access.
    suspended: A SUSPENDED membership retains historical identity and its roleId but has no workspace access. 
      Reactivation requires target ACTIVE CommunityMembership and CR-06 full-role grant-ceiling revalidation.
    remove: DELETE member is soft suspension. Self-removal is allowed for non-Owners; no role/data history is 
      erased.
    owner: 'Generic member PATCH/DELETE cannot demote, suspend or remove an OWNER. Use owner-transfer: promote target
      first and optionally DEMOTE or LEAVE the caller atomically. The last ACTIVE Owner invariant is checked under
      row/workspace lock.'
  invitations:
    states:
    - PENDING
    - ACCEPTED
    - EXPIRED
    - REVOKED
    token: Generate 32 cryptographically random bytes, encode base64url, store only SHA-256(token), enforce 
      unique token hash and single use. Never include plaintext token in API response, logs, audit metadata or
      database.
    expiryDays: 7
    resend: PENDING only. Rotate token (old token invalid immediately) and set expiresAt to seven days from 
      resend. Terminal invitations cannot be reopened; create a new invitation.
    acceptance: Authenticated account with verified primary email must match normalized target email or exact 
      targetUserId. Require PENDING status and server time before expiresAt. Use generic 404 for unknown, 
      mismatched, revoked, or consumed tokens; explicit 409 only for already-authenticated target after safe 
      lookup when expiry/terminal status is known.
    community: Only ACTIVE Community Admin may invite email. Recipient is not a community member until 
      accepted. New membership is ACTIVE, isCommunityAdmin=false; isDefaultCoordinator comes from invitation. 
      No implicit workspace memberships are created.
    workspace: Only an ACTIVE Community member may be invited to a Shared Workspace. Workspace invites target 
      userId only (resolved to verified account email). Invitation create adds INVITED workspace membership 
      with roleId; no access until accepted. Revalidate inviter active/current invite capability, CR-06 grant 
      ceiling and Coordinator restrictions at accept and resend; if authority no longer exists, revoke with 
      INVITATION_AUTHORITY_REVOKED. Role or membership changes to the inviter trigger revocation of any 
      pending invitations for which the inviter no longer satisfies the full authority check.
    email: Provider-agnostic durable outbox. Invitation row/token hash/outbox event are atomic. API reports 
      QUEUED; it does not promise provider delivery. Provider choice belongs to CR-13; retry/backoff and 
      notification preferences to CR-10. Resend rotates credentials.
    sweeper: A worker expires PENDING invitations at or after expiresAt at least once every five minutes. 
      Every read, resend and accept path also checks expiry synchronously, so late worker execution never 
      extends validity.
    revoke: Community Admin may revoke community invitations. Workspace inviter may revoke their own 
      invitation while still authorized; a member with workspace:manage_members or an Owner may revoke any 
      pending workspace invitation. Revoke deletes only the INVITED workspace membership placeholder; terminal
      invitation and audit evidence remain.
    duplicates: At most one PENDING invite per community+normalized email or workspace+targetUserId. Return 
      409 INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING. An already ACTIVE/SUSPENDED CommunityMembership or any existing 
      workspace membership is handled through member management, not re-invitation.
  eventsAndAudit:
    atomicity: Membership/invitation state transition, domain event/outbox, and audit record commit in one 
      transaction.
    audit:
    - COMMUNITY_INVITATION_CREATED
    - COMMUNITY_INVITATION_RESENT
    - COMMUNITY_INVITATION_ACCEPTED
    - COMMUNITY_INVITATION_REVOKED
    - COMMUNITY_INVITATION_EXPIRED
    - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_SUSPENDED
    - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_RESTORED
    - COMMUNITY_MEMBER_FLAGS_CHANGED
    - WORKSPACE_INVITATION_CREATED
    - WORKSPACE_INVITATION_RESENT
    - WORKSPACE_INVITATION_ACCEPTED
    - WORKSPACE_INVITATION_REVOKED
    - WORKSPACE_INVITATION_EXPIRED
    - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_SUSPENDED
    - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_RESTORED
    - WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ROLE_CHANGED
    - WORKSPACE_OWNERSHIP_TRANSFERRED
    privacy: Audit metadata contains invitationId, scoped actor/target IDs where available and salted email 
      hash only; never raw email or token. Invitee events are delivered only to the target user-community 
      stream; workspace stream payloads omit recipient email and token.
    revocation: API authorization is recomputed on each request. Community suspension invalidates only 
      sessions/context/caches/realtime subscriptions scoped to that community; the global account session and 
      other community access remain. Workspace suspension/role changes invalidate all subscriptions and 
      authorization caches for that workspace. Pending workspace invitations issued by an actor are revoked 
      when their membership/role loses authority for the target role.
  coordinatorPreselection:
    default: On SHARED workspace creation, coordinatorUserIds omitted means every currently ACTIVE Community 
      Default Coordinator is preselected.
    ownerOverride: The creating Workspace Owner may send a subset, including an empty array, to remove 
      preselected coordinators before creation.
    insert: Selected coordinators are inserted as ACTIVE workspace memberships with the immutable built-in 
      COORDINATOR role atomically with workspace creation.
    eligibility: Every selected ID must be an ACTIVE member of the same community with 
      isDefaultCoordinator=true at the transaction commit; creator cannot appear in coordinatorUserIds because
      they are initial OWNER.
    futureOnly: Changes to the community Default Coordinator pool affect future workspaces only; current 
      workspace role changes remain Owner-controlled.
x-comment-policy:
  scope: Comments and watchers are task-scoped and obey the current workspace membership and task:read 
    boundary. Personal Workspace privacy and all CR-01/CR-05 security floors remain in force.
  markdown:
    input: body is raw Markdown source, maximum 20000 Unicode code points. Server parses to a closed, 
      versioned AST; the client never supplies AST or HTML.
    allowedBlocks:
    - paragraph
    - heading levels 1-3
    - blockquote
    - ordered and unordered lists
    - list items
    - fenced code blocks
    allowedInline:
    - text
    - emphasis
    - strong
    - strikethrough
    - inline code
    - safe links
    - mention tokens
    - resolved task-key tokens
    html: Raw HTML, inline styles, classes, arbitrary attributes, scripts, SVG, iframes, images, embeds and 
      remote media are forbidden. Raw HTML is rendered as escaped text or discarded by the parser; it is never
      executed.
    links: Only http, https and mailto schemes are emitted as link AST nodes. Reject javascript, data, 
      vbscript, file, protocol-relative and unknown schemes. Open external links with noopener and noreferrer.
    limits: Maximum 20000 source characters and 2000 AST nodes per comment. Markdown nesting is bounded. 
      Unsupported constructs degrade to literal text.
    rendering: Persist raw Markdown plus server-generated sanitized AST. Return AST to clients. Frontend 
      renders typed AST nodes using normal React elements; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML or raw HTML rendering.
  mentions:
    syntax: The composer serializes a selected mention as @[untrusted-label](user:<uuid>). The server ignores 
      label text and resolves canonical identity from the userId.
    candidateSearch: GET task mention-candidates requires task:read, searches ACTIVE members of this workspace
      only, returns at most 20 name/avatar/userId results, never email, and excludes suspended or removed 
      users.
    validation: On create and edit, server parses every mention token and rechecks that each target has ACTIVE
      CommunityMembership and ACTIVE WorkspaceMembership with task:read on this task. Client IDs/labels are 
      not trusted. Duplicate targets are deduplicated.
    ineligible: Any stale, malformed, suspended, removed, cross-community, cross-workspace or 
      task-inaccessible mention token rejects the full write with generic 422 MENTION_NOT_ALLOWED. Do not 
      reveal whether the target account exists elsewhere.
    deletedReferences: If an author or mentioned user is later removed, suspended or erased, retain the stable
      reference for audit continuity but render the generic Former member label with no email or avatar. 
      Comment body history is never used to disclose other community membership.
    taskKeys: '#KEY tokens are resolved using CR-03 alias/current-lineage authorization. Emit a task_key AST node
      only when the current target is readable in the same workspace. Unknown or inaccessible keys remain plain
      text; never reveal a destination workspace.'
  threading:
    parent: parentCommentId must refer to a non-deleted comment on the same task and workspace.
    maxDepth: 5
    maxDepthRationale: Recommended bound to prevent unbounded recursive rendering; frontend displays threads 
      with stable nesting and a collapse affordance.
    invalidParent: Reject cross-task, deleted, unknown or inaccessible parents without disclosing their 
      existence.
  permissions:
    list: task:read and current workspace membership; returns private/no-store.
    create: task:comment plus task:read and ACTIVE workspace membership. Every mutation is reauthorized at 
      request time.
    edit: Only the comment author, while an ACTIVE workspace member with task:comment and task:read. Edit 
      replaces body/AST/mention set atomically. Version is mandatory; mismatch returns 409 
      COMMENT_VERSION_CONFLICT.
    delete: Author may soft-delete own comment. Any actor with task:archive may soft-delete any comment on a 
      readable task. No hard-delete endpoint.
    softDelete: Deleted comments return isDeleted=true, body=null, bodyAst=null, mentions=[] and deletedAt; 
      author identity remains but is anonymized when no longer an active member. A minimal COMMENT_DELETED 
      activity event remains.
    errors: Unknown or unreadable task/comment/parent returns generic 404. Readable task with missing required
      capability returns 403. Mention validation errors do not disclose account existence.
  watchers:
    autoFollow: Task Creator and each active Assignee are automatically followed. A user directly mentioned in
      an active comment is also auto-followed.
    reasons: Maintain independent follow reasons (CREATOR, ASSIGNEE, MENTION, EXPLICIT) so removing one source
      never removes another. Active relationship changes update the matching reason only.
    selfControl: task:watch changes only the caller own explicit preference; caller cannot set another userId.
      Explicit follow enables ordinary watched-task updates.
    unwatch: Unwatch suppresses ordinary/non-mention updates even where an implicit follow reason exists. 
      Direct @mention notifications continue. Re-follow explicitly restores ordinary updates.
    mentionRemoval: Editing or deleting a comment removes its MENTION follow reason only when no other active 
      comment still mentions that user; explicit, creator and assignee reasons remain. A user mute is never 
      silently cleared.
  notificationFanout:
    mention: On create, each distinct eligible mention target other than the author receives one logical 
      MENTION / Action Required intent. On edit, only newly added eligible recipients receive a new mention 
      intent; retained recipients are not pinged again. Duplicates are deduplicated.
    updates: Other task followers who have not muted ordinary updates receive one logical COMMENT_UPDATE / 
      Updates intent for a comment create or edit. Author is excluded. A user receiving a direct new mention 
      intent does not also receive a duplicate update intent for the same comment revision.
    atomicity: Comment write, mention/follow relationship changes and durable notification intents are 
      committed atomically through the outbox. Delivery is asynchronous.
    cr10Boundary: CR-08 defines recipient selection and mention/comment-update suppression. CR-10 defines 
      per-user/community channel preferences, quiet hours, email digests, retry/backoff and reminder delivery;
      CR-13 selects the deployed email provider/sender.
  realtime:
    workspaceEvents:
    - comment.created
    - comment.updated
    - comment.deleted
    - watcher.changed
    payload: Workspace events contain only taskId, commentId, comment version and event metadata. Never 
      include Markdown body, AST, mention recipient list, email, or hidden task identifiers. 
      Recipient-specific notifications travel on the user-community stream.
    privacy: All reads are private/no-store. Realtime subscriptions reauthorize against current workspace 
      membership; CR-09 finalizes transport and kick/reconnect mechanics.
  compatibility: No file attachments are supported; comment requests reject attachment IDs and unknown fields.
    Existing task:comment and task:watch capabilities remain the authorization primitives; no new role 
    capability is introduced.
x-realtime-policy:
  status: Specified for 0.3.10-draft; pending joint frontend/backend/security sign-off and runtime acceptance.
  websocket:
    url: wss://{configured-host}/api/v1/ws
    subprotocol: work-platform.v1
    transport: TLS required in production; WebSocket is a delta transport, never the source of truth.
    origin: Browser Origin must exactly match a configured allowlist; wildcard and substring matching are 
      forbidden.
    cookieAuthentication: Existing session cookie is validated during Upgrade. Cookie name and attributes 
      remain CR-13 deployment decisions.
    ticketAuthentication: Ticket-authenticated clients send AUTHENTICATE as the first frame within 5 seconds; 
      never put a ticket in a URL.
  tickets:
    endpoint: POST /communities/{communityId}/realtime-ticket
    lifetimeSeconds: 60
    singleUse: true
    entropyBitsMinimum: 256
    storage: Persist only a one-way hash; redeem atomically; do not log raw credentials.
    scope: Bound to authenticated user and path community; workspaceIds, when supplied, restrict the workspace
      rooms allowed on the connection.
    replay: Ticket issuance is excluded from X-Mutation-Id response replay; each successful issuance returns a
      new credential.
  streams:
    workspace:
      key: (communityId, workspaceId)
      sequence: workspaceSeq
      sequenceScope: One contiguous increasing sequence per workspace.
      authorization: Recheck active CommunityMembership, WorkspaceMembership and current visibility on every 
        subscription and before replay/event delivery.
    userCommunity:
      key: (authenticatedUserId, communityId)
      sequence: userNotificationSeq
      sequenceScope: Independent contiguous increasing sequence per user and community; the authenticated user
        ID is derived from session and is never client input.
      authorization: Requires active CommunityMembership; never expose another recipient's events.
    delivery: At least once. Deduplicate by eventId and apply each stream only in contiguous sequence order. 
      mutationId is optimistic-echo correlation only; it is not a substitute for eventId or sequence 
      deduplication.
    commit: Domain mutation, each affected stream sequence allocation and durable outbox record commit 
      atomically in the same database transaction. Outbox publishing is retryable and idempotent by eventId.
    schemaVersion: 1
  protocol:
    firstTicketFrame: AUTHENTICATE
    workspaceSubscribe: SUBSCRIBE_WORKSPACE
    userCommunitySubscribe: SUBSCRIBE_USER_COMMUNITY
    unsubscribe: UNSUBSCRIBE_WORKSPACE or UNSUBSCRIBE_USER_COMMUNITY
    acknowledgement: SUBSCRIPTION_ACK includes currentSeq high-water mark.
    dataFrames: Raw ws-events.schema.json envelopes only; control frames are never wrapped around domain 
      events.
    clientControlFrames:
    - AUTHENTICATE
    - SUBSCRIBE_WORKSPACE
    - SUBSCRIBE_USER_COMMUNITY
    - UNSUBSCRIBE_WORKSPACE
    - UNSUBSCRIBE_USER_COMMUNITY
    - PONG
    serverControlFrames:
    - CONNECTION_ACK
    - SUBSCRIPTION_ACK
    - UNSUBSCRIPTION_ACK
    - PING
    - ERROR
    - WORKSPACE_ACCESS_REVOKED
    - WORKSPACE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED
    - COMMUNITY_ACCESS_REVOKED
    ticketAuthentication: AUTHENTICATE is the first application frame and must arrive within 5 seconds; it 
      carries only the opaque ticket and requestId.
    cookieAuthentication: A valid existing session cookie is authenticated during Upgrade; no AUTHENTICATE 
      ticket frame is sent.
    connectionAck: CONNECTION_ACK confirms authMode (SESSION_COOKIE or TICKET); ticket mode also returns the 
      ticket-bound communityId, never the userId.
    subscriptionAck: SUBSCRIPTION_ACK echoes requestId, stream scope and currentSeq high-water mark. Register 
      the subscription and begin buffering before capturing currentSeq.
    unsubscribeAck: UNSUBSCRIPTION_ACK confirms removal of the exact caller-owned stream subscription.
    errors: ERROR uses a generic code and optional requestId; do not disclose whether an inaccessible 
      community/workspace/user exists.
  heartbeat:
    serverPingSeconds: 25
    pongDeadlineSeconds: 10
    staleConnectionSeconds: 35
    reconnectNominalMilliseconds:
    - 500
    - 1000
    - 2000
    - 4000
    reconnectMaximumMilliseconds: 15000
    reconnectStrategy: Exponential backoff with jitter; indicator appears after 5 seconds disconnected.
    connectionTimeout: Ticket-authenticated connections must send AUTHENTICATE within 5 seconds of Upgrade. A 
      ticket is never reusable for reconnect; obtain a fresh ticket for each new ticket-authenticated socket.
    disconnectIndicatorSeconds: 5
    backpressure: Use a bounded per-connection send buffer. Never silently drop an event while keeping the 
      stream healthy; close an overloaded connection and let the client reconnect/catch up from its last 
      contiguous cursor. Exact byte/event thresholds are deployment/load-test decisions under CR-16.
  catchup:
    workspaceEndpoint: GET /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/events?sinceSeq={n}
    userCommunityEndpoint: GET /communities/{communityId}/user-events?sinceSeq={n}
    sinceSeq: Exclusive cursor.
    maxEvents: 500
    retention: Retain at least the latest 500 committed events for each independent stream; no partial success
      when cursor falls outside retention.
    outOfRetention: 410 EVENT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RETENTION; client refetches canonical authorized API projections 
      before resetting cursor.
    cursorAhead: 409 EVENT_CURSOR_AHEAD.
    responseCache: private, no-store.
    cursorErrors: 409 and 410 Problem Details include latestSeq, the latest committed sequence observed when 
      the error was produced.
    outOfRetentionRecovery: After 410, refetch canonical authorized projections. Then call the same catch-up 
      endpoint from the error latestSeq; apply the complete replay before releasing buffered live frames. If 
      another 410 occurs, repeat. Never jump the cursor to an unverified client value.
    cursorAheadRecovery: On 409, use returned latestSeq as the authoritative correction point and reconcile 
      via canonical projections/catch-up before applying later frames.
    gapRecovery: Pause application for the affected stream when a sequence gap appears; catch up from the last
      contiguous sequence. Resume buffered live delivery only after contiguous reconciliation.
  revocation:
    workspaceRemovalOrSuspension: Fan out revocation across all realtime server instances; detach affected 
      sockets and send WORKSPACE_ACCESS_REVOKED where possible.
    communitySuspension: Revoke affected shared-workspace and user-community subscriptions without globally 
      logging out other communities.
    roleChange: Send WORKSPACE_AUTHORIZATION_CHANGED, invalidate permission-sensitive client caches and 
      reauthorize. If required access is no longer present, send WORKSPACE_ACCESS_REVOKED and detach before 
      further delivery.
    failClosed: The server fails closed; if current authorization or the cross-instance revocation barrier 
      cannot be established, stop delivery for the affected subscription.
    communityRemoval: Send COMMUNITY_ACCESS_REVOKED for the affected community, detach its user-community 
      stream and all affected workspace subscriptions, and preserve sessions/subscriptions in other 
      communities.
    barrier: Membership, role and visibility changes publish a durable revocation intent. Every realtime 
      instance must acknowledge the invalidation barrier before the mutation is considered safely propagated; 
      if the barrier cannot be established, fail closed for affected subscriptions.
  privacy:
    workspaceEvents: Never contain comment Markdown/AST, mention recipient lists, emails, invitation tokens or
      hidden task/workspace identifiers.
    notifications: Recipient-specific notification deltas remain on the authenticated user's user-community 
      stream.
    credentials: Never log, persist in plaintext, place in URLs, expose in events, or include in traces the 
      realtime ticket, session cookie or CSRF token.
    scope: A ticket is community-bound. A supplied workspaceIds list narrows workspace subscriptions but never
