```yaml
      grants access; every requested workspace is reauthorized. The authenticated userId is server-derived and
      never accepted in a subscription frame.
  runtimeEvidence: Contract/schema checks only; broker, socket, authorization, revocation, reconnect and load 
    tests remain production acceptance gates.
x-notification-policy:
  status: Specified for 0.3.11-draft; pending joint frontend/backend/product/security sign-off and delivery 
    runtime acceptance.
  scope:
    inbox: Per authenticated user and community; no userId input is accepted. The server derives the recipient
      from the session and checks ACTIVE CommunityMembership.
    preferences: Per user and community. A user may choose different email and quiet-hour preferences in 
      different communities.
    workspaceReminders: Deadline offsets and enablement are workspace-scoped configuration. Only workspace 
      Owners or members with workspace:update_settings may modify them. Per-recipient channel preferences 
      remain user-scoped.
    personalWorkspace: Apply CR-01 personal-workspace privacy and audited break-glass rules before generating 
      or returning any task-linked notification.
  categories:
    ACTION_REQUIRED:
    - MENTION
    - TASK_ASSIGNED
    - TASK_DUE_REMINDER
    - TASK_OVERDUE
    - GOVERNANCE_ALERT
    - BREAK_GLASS_ALERT
    UPDATES:
    - COMMENT_UPDATE
    inApp: Always persisted and enabled. Users may mark individual notifications or the full community inbox 
      read; no preference turns off the durable in-app inbox.
    email: Optional by category. ACTION_REQUIRED email mode is IMMEDIATE or OFF. UPDATES email mode is 
      IMMEDIATE, DAILY_DIGEST, WEEKLY_DIGEST or OFF.
  channelScope:
    inApp: Durable recipient-scoped inbox and user-community realtime delta; always enabled.
    email: Optional per recipient and community, subject to category mode and quiet hours.
    push: Browser/mobile push delivery is outside this CR-10 contract; do not assume it is enabled or 
      implemented.
  defaults:
    actionRequiredEmailMode: IMMEDIATE
    updatesEmailMode: OFF
    quietHoursEnabled: false
    timeZone: UTC until the client submits a valid detected/user-selected IANA time zone
    dailyDigestTimeLocal: 09:00
    weeklyDigestDayOfWeek: MONDAY
    workspaceReminders:
      enabled: true
      offsetMinutes:
      - 60
      - 1440
  eventMatrix:
    MENTION: One ACTION_REQUIRED intent for each distinct newly mentioned eligible recipient; mention always 
      outranks a general comment update for the same comment revision. Uses CR-08 mention validation and 
      watcher rules.
    TASK_ASSIGNED: ACTION_REQUIRED for each newly added active assignee. Removing an assignee cancels pending 
      assignment-specific reminder work and does not create a removal alert.
    TASK_DUE_REMINDER: ACTION_REQUIRED at each configured workspace offset before the recipient-local due-date
      boundary.
    TASK_OVERDUE: One ACTION_REQUIRED notification when an eligible task first crosses its due-date boundary 
      while its status category is not DONE or CANCELED.
    COMMENT_UPDATE: UPDATES for eligible active followers who have not muted ordinary updates; author excluded
      and CR-08 mention deduplication remains authoritative.
    GOVERNANCE_ALERT: ACTION_REQUIRED for the authorized subject/administrators as specified by the 
      originating governance policy.
    BREAK_GLASS_ALERT: Mandatory security alert governed by CR-01; not disabled, digested, or delayed by 
      ordinary preferences or quiet hours.
  reminders:
    dateSemantics: Task dueDate is a date-only value. For reminder scheduling, interpret its deadline boundary
      as 23:59:59 on that date in each recipient timeZone; offsetMinutes is applied before that boundary.
    recipients: All currently ACTIVE assignees who retain access to the task. If no ACTIVE assignee exists, 
      notify the ACTIVE task creator. Never broadcast a task reminder to all workspace members.
    eligibility: Task must have a dueDate, be unarchived, belong to an active workspace, and not have 
      statusCategory DONE or CANCELED. Recheck task state and current community/workspace membership at 
      dispatch.
    defaults: New workspace reminder settings are enabled with offsets 1440 and 60 minutes. Valid offsets are 
      unique integers from 1 through 10080; maximum five offsets.
    reconciliation: Changing dueDate, assignees, status, archive state or workspace reminder settings 
      cancels/rebuilds pending occurrences transactionally. Removed assignees and no-longer-readable tasks 
      never receive queued reminders.
    deduplication: A reminder occurrence is unique by recipient, task, dueDate and offset. An overdue 
      occurrence is unique by recipient, task and dueDate. Retries reuse the same notification and channel 
      idempotency key.
  quietHours:
    timezone: IANA time zone stored on the user/community preference record; invalid or unknown zone 
      identifiers are rejected.
    semantics: Local start/end wall-clock times; intervals may cross midnight. daysOfWeek identifies the local
      start day; an empty list means all seven days. Equal start/end is invalid. For DST gaps, advance to the 
      first valid instant; for repeated local times, execute once at the first occurrence and retain one 
      logical idempotency key.
    effect: Email delivery for ordinary notifications is deferred until quiet hours end. Durable in-app inbox 
      writes and unread counters remain immediate; clients suppress interruptive toast presentation during 
      quiet hours. Mandatory CR-01 BREAK_GLASS_ALERT bypasses quiet hours.
  digests:
    eligibility: Only UPDATES email notifications may be batched. ACTION_REQUIRED notifications are never 
      digested; mandatory security alerts bypass digest and user preferences.
    schedule: Daily or weekly at the configured local wall-clock time and timeZone. Weekly uses 
      digestDayOfWeek.
    content: Include only undelivered eligible notification summaries whose linked resource remains readable 
      at send time. Do not include comment Markdown, mention recipient lists, hidden task identifiers or 
      cross-community data.
    idempotency: A notification appears in at most one successfully accepted digest. A failed digest retry 
      reuses the same digest idempotency key.
  delivery:
    transaction: Domain mutation, recipient-scoped notification records, deduplication keys and durable outbox
      intents commit atomically. Provider delivery is asynchronous.
    inApp: Persist once and expose on the authenticated user-community stream as notification.created; 
      delivery does not depend on email provider availability.
    emailRetries: Transient provider failures retry after 1, 5, 15, 60 and 240 minutes (six total attempts 
      including the initial attempt). Honor provider Retry-After when present; use the later of scheduled 
      backoff and provider delay, capped at 6 hours. Hard bounce, invalid address and permanent 4xx failures 
      are not retried.
    terminalFailure: After retry exhaustion, mark the email attempt dead-lettered, preserve the in-app 
      notification and raise an aggregated operational alert without logging message content.
    breakGlassOverride: 'CR-01 remains authoritative: immediate email attempt and retries at +1, +5, +15, +30 and
      +60 minutes, followed by BREAK_GLASS_OWNER_ALERT_FAILED and Security Operations alerting.'
    invitations: CR-07 invitation email uses the shared durable outbox/delivery worker and reports QUEUED, 
      SENT (provider accepted) or FAILED; resend/accept/revoke semantics remain CR-07.
  deduplication:
    domainIntent: Unique by recipient, community, source event, reason and resource identity. A retried outbox
      event cannot create a second logical notification/inbox row.
    channel: Email idempotency is keyed by (notificationId, channel); retries never create another inbox row.
    comment: CR-08 controls mention-vs-comment-update recipient selection and suppression.
    reminder: Pre-due occurrence key is (recipientUserId, communityId, taskId, dueDate, offsetMinutes); 
      overdue occurrence key is (recipientUserId, communityId, taskId, dueDate).
  privacy:
    authorization: Inbox list/read operations return only the authenticated recipient current-community 
      records. Validate resource visibility again before returning resourceId or including a resource in an 
      email/digest.
    nonDisclosure: If a resource is no longer readable, omit/null its resource pointer and return a safe 
      generic notification summary; never expose another recipient, email address, ticket, hidden 
      task/workspace ID, comment body or mention target list.
    cache: All notification inbox/preferences/reminder-setting responses are private, no-store.
  retention: Notification inbox retention and deletion/purge duration remain an explicit operations/product 
    decision; do not infer it from CR-14 audit retention.
  implementationBoundary: This is a contract and policy specification. It does not prove worker scheduling, 
    queue durability, email provider configuration, delivery, monitoring or runtime deduplication.
x-saved-view-policy:
  status: Specified for 0.3.12-draft; joint frontend/backend/product/security sign-off and runtime acceptance 
    remain open.
  scopes:
    PERSONAL: Visible only to createdById. No Workspace Owner, Community Admin, Platform Operator or 
      break-glass override. Any active workspace member with task:read may create; creator only may 
      read/update/delete.
    SHARED: Visible to ACTIVE workspace members with task:read. Create/delete require 
      saved_view:manage_shared. Update requires that capability or original creator exception while still 
      ACTIVE and task:read.
    immutable:
    - scope
    - createdById
  defaults:
    newScope: PERSONAL
    viewTypeWhenNoSavedView: LIST
    boardVisibleCardBadges:
    - DUE_DATE
    - LABELS
    showEmptyColumns: true
    displayOptionsForNonBoard: {}
  draftState:
    transient:
    - url
    - filter
    - sort
    - grouping
    - subtaskMode
    - calendarMonth
    - timelineScroll
    - timelineZoom
    saveAsPersonal: Creates a new independent PERSONAL record from current draft. Never modifies source.
    updateShared: Explicit version-checked PATCH only; never autosave shared filter changes.
  querySeparation: querySpec remains CR-04 projection-independent AST; viewType and displayOptions are 
    separate. displayOptions cannot alter membership, task access, filtering, sorting or grouping. 
    CALENDAR/TIMELINE require dateWindow; TIMELINE requires dateField START_TO_DUE_SPAN. When PATCH changes 
    the effective viewType away from BOARD, the caller must send displayOptions:{} in the same request to 
    explicitly clear Board-only preferences; the server never silently drops them.
  boardDisplayOptions:
    visibleCardBadges:
    - DUE_DATE
    - LABELS
    - SUBTASK_COUNT
    - ESTIMATE
    showEmptyColumns: boolean
    defaultVisibleCardBadges:
    - DUE_DATE
    - LABELS
    defaultShowEmptyColumns: true
    otherViews: No persisted displayOptions are added for LIST, CALENDAR or TIMELINE in CR-11.
  namesAndVersions:
    normalization: Trim and Unicode NFKC normalization before write.
    maxLength: 120
    unique: PERSONAL case-insensitive within (workspaceId,createdById); SHARED case-insensitive within 
      workspaceId.
    version: Every update requires current integer version and increments atomically. Stale version returns 
      SAVED_VIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT with no write.
    delete: Active record removed from lists/search; minimal audit tombstone remains; no restore endpoint in 
      CR-11.
  copy:
    endpoint: POST /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{sourceWorkspaceId}/saved-views/{viewId}/copy
    sameCommunityOnly: true
    differentWorkspaceRequired: true
    sourcePersonal: Only source createdById may copy PERSONAL.
    sourceShared: Any active source member with task:read may copy SHARED.
    destinationPersonal: Any active destination member with task:read.
    destinationShared: Requires saved_view:manage_shared in destination.
    deepCopy:
    - querySpec
    - viewType
    - displayOptions
    newIdentity: New UUID, destination workspaceId, current actor createdById. Source untouched.
    compatibility: Revalidate every workspace-bound workspace/milestone/label/custom-field/option reference 
      and operator in destination. Fail all-or-nothing; never drop/remap references by name.
    error: SAVED_VIEW_COPY_INCOMPATIBLE returns safe JSON paths + issue codes only; no source-only identifier 
      values. Cross-community copy unsupported. A destination outside the path community is returned as 
      generic 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND to preserve anti-enumeration.
  events:
    shared:
    - saved_view.created
    - saved_view.updated
    - saved_view.deleted
    payload:
      viewId: UUID
      version: integer >= 1
      scope: SHARED only
    personal: No workspace event and no workspaceSeq allocation.
    forbiddenPayload:
    - name
    - querySpec
    - displayOptions
    - createdById
    - personal view metadata
  cache: All saved-view reads and search results are private, no-store.
  authorization: Every read/replay/query execution re-checks active membership and task:read. Saved views are 
    presets, never task access tokens.
  runtimeGates:
  - PERSONAL isolation across every role/admin/break-glass context
  - SHARED visibility for active readers
  - creator and saved_view:manage_shared operation matrix
  - scope/creator immutability
  - version race
  - case-insensitive uniqueness
  - copy destination compatibility and rollback
  - same-community restriction
  - shared-only realtime event publication and private payload validation
  - CR-04 query reauthorization after load
x-custom-field-policy:
  status: Specified for 0.3.13-draft; pending joint frontend/backend/product/security sign-off and runtime 
    acceptance.
  scope: Custom-field definitions and option sets are workspace-scoped, not workspace-scoped. All workspaces 
    and tasks in a workspace use the same active definitions. No workspace hierarchy or new container is 
    introduced.
  phase1Types:
    TEXT: NFC-normalized string, maximum 5000 Unicode characters; whitespace-only values normalize to 
      empty/null.
    NUMBER: Finite JSON number, absolute value at most 1,000,000,000,000 and at most six fractional decimal 
      places. Zero is a valid non-empty value.
    DATE: ISO 8601 date-only string YYYY-MM-DD; no time or timezone component.
    BOOLEAN: JSON boolean; false is a valid non-empty value.
    SINGLE_SELECT: Stable CustomFieldOptionDto.id UUIDv7. Labels are display-only and are never sent as task 
      values or query values.
  deferredTypes:
  - MULTI_SELECT
  - USER
  - URL
  - CURRENCY
  - FORMULA
  - LOOKUP
  - ATTACHMENT
  identity:
    definitionId: Server-generated immutable UUIDv7. It is the key used in TaskDto.customFieldValues and 
      baseFieldRevisions paths.
    fieldKey: Server-generated immutable lower snake_case key, unique within a workspace, used only by 
      ViewQuerySpec as cf.{fieldKey}. Never changes when the display name changes.
    optionId: Server-generated immutable UUIDv7, unique within its field. A rename or reorder never changes 
      optionId.
    optionLabel: Unicode NFKC-normalized, trimmed display label, unique case-insensitively among active 
      options within one field. It is not an identifier or stored task value.
    name: Unicode NFKC-normalized, trimmed display name, 1–100 characters, unique case-insensitively within a 
      workspace including archived definitions.
  definitionLifecycle:
    fieldType: Immutable after creation. To change a type, archive the old definition and create a new one; 
      never reinterpret stored JSON values in place.
    fieldKey: Immutable and never reused, including after archive.
    rename: Display name and description may change without changing definitionId, fieldKey or stored task 
      values.
    archive: DELETE on a definition is a soft archive. Keep the definition, options and task values for 
      historical rendering/audit. Archived fields cannot be added/changed on tasks or used in new query 
      filter/sort conditions.
    restore: PATCH isArchived=false reactivates the same definition and stable key; no new IDs are created.
    hardDelete: Not supported. Permanent removal would orphan task history and saved-view filters.
  optionLifecycle:
    create: Option create accepts a label; the server generates optionId and the next dense sortOrder. A 
      SINGLE_SELECT field has at most 100 options.
    rename: A label rename preserves optionId; current task values and saved-view filter values keep pointing 
      to that same option. Audit history records the previous/new label.
    reorder: Reorder supplies the complete ordered list of all currently active option IDs exactly once. 
      Server assigns dense zero-based sortOrder atomically.
    archive: PATCH isArchived=true hides an option from new selections but preserves its ID and label for 
      existing task values and historical filters.
    restore: PATCH isArchived=false reactivates the same option ID, subject to active-label uniqueness.
    selection: New task values may select active options only. An unchanged pre-existing archived option value
      may remain on a task; changing to another value must select an active option. Clearing an archived value
      is allowed unless the field is required.
    query: Archived option IDs remain valid EQ/NEQ/IN/NOT_IN filter values for an active definition so 
      historical tasks can be found. An archived field definition itself is not queryable.
  taskValueWire:
    response: 'TaskDto.customFieldValues is an object keyed by CustomFieldDefinitionDto.id UUIDv7. Each present
      value is a non-null scalar: TEXT string, NUMBER number, DATE string, BOOLEAN boolean or SINGLE_SELECT option
      UUID string. Empty values are omitted from the response.'
    create: CreateTaskRequest.customFieldValues is a map of definition ID to non-null scalar. The actor may 
      set initial values as part of task:create, including required fields.
    patch: UpdateTaskRequest.customFieldValues is a partial map keyed by definition ID. Omitted keys are 
      unchanged; null explicitly clears the one field. Other keys in the map are untouched.
    fieldRevisions: Each custom-field value has its own revision key customFieldValues.{definitionId}. Include
      the current value for each changed custom field in baseFieldRevisions. A mismatch returns 409 with that 
      exact field path; unrelated custom-field edits can merge.
    validation: The backend resolves every supplied definition ID in the path workspace and validates its 
      active state, type, option membership, required constraint and current task permissions. 
      Unknown/foreign/archived definitions fail closed; never coerce strings/numbers/booleans or accept 
      client-supplied fieldKey/SQL/JSON path.
  requiredSemantics:
    empty: Missing, null, empty string and whitespace-only TEXT are empty. NUMBER zero and BOOLEAN false are 
      not empty. A SINGLE_SELECT value is non-empty only when it references an existing option ID for the 
      field.
    create: All active required definitions must have valid values in CreateTaskRequest.customFieldValues. The
      server validates the complete required set at commit.
    enable: Changing isRequired from false to true is allowed only when every active, non-archived task in the
      workspace already has a non-empty valid value. Otherwise return 422 
      CUSTOM_FIELD_REQUIRED_BACKFILL_NEEDED with a count only, no task IDs. Backfill values first, then enable
      required.
    update: A required value cannot be cleared or made empty. Unrelated task patches do not revalidate or 
      modify omitted custom fields.
    archive: Archived required fields no longer block new task creation or task edits. Restoring a required 
      field reactivates its required constraint; the archive process never erased values.
  permissions:
    definitionRead: ACTIVE workspace membership plus task:read. No user/role may read another workspace 
      definition through an ID or fieldKey.
    definitionManage: workspace:manage_custom_fields. OWNER has it by default; COORDINATOR/MEMBER/VIEWER do 
      not. An OWNER may explicitly grant it to an eligible custom role only within the CR-06 grant ceiling, 
      and only when the role also includes workspace:read_metadata and task:read.
    taskValueCreate: task:create permits initial customFieldValues in the create request; this avoids forcing 
      a Member to create an incomplete task and then require edit permission to populate a required field.
    taskValueUpdate: TaskPermissions.canEditCustomFieldsLinks governs customFieldValues updates. A multi-field
      patch remains atomic; no partial field writes on denial.
    visibility: There is no per-custom-field read ACL in Phase 1. Any actor with task:read can read all 
      custom-field values returned on that task. Do not use custom fields for secrets or private HR/financial 
      data.
  queryAndViews:
    filterKey: Use cf.{fieldKey}; resolve the fieldKey only inside the single path workspace. Clients never 
      submit definition IDs as query field names.
    singleSelect: Filter values are stable option IDs, never labels. Configured sortOrder determines 
      SINGLE_SELECT sorting.
    archived: Archived definition keys are rejected with 422 FILTER_FIELD_INVALID. Archived option IDs may be 
      filtered on an active definition to locate historical values; they cannot be newly selected.
    myWork: Cross-workspace /my-work/query cannot apply cf.* filters or sorts because fieldKey/definitions are
      workspace-local. Use a workspace-scoped task query for custom-field filtering.
    savedViewCopy: CR-11 copy validates custom field definition IDs and option IDs against the destination 
      workspace. It never maps by display label or fieldKey and never drops an incompatible clause; 
      incompatible references fail atomically with SAVED_VIEW_COPY_INCOMPATIBLE.
  realtime:
    schemaChanged: Every definition/option schema mutation emits one custom_field.schema_changed workspace 
      event with fieldId, field version and changeType only. No labels or task values are broadcast.
    taskValuesChanged: Custom-field task value mutation emits task.custom_fields_updated with taskId, 
      taskVersion and changed field definition IDs only. Never include values or option labels; client 
      refetches the authorized task.
  limits:
    fieldNameCharacters: 100
    fieldDescriptionCharacters: 500
    singleSelectOptionLabelCharacters: 80
    singleSelectOptionsPerField: 100
    textValueCharacters: 5000
    numberAbsoluteMaximum: 1000000000000
    numberFractionalDigitsMaximum: 6
  implementationBoundary: This is a wire/policy contract. It does not prove JSONB migrations, indexes, 
    field/option CRUD handlers, task value persistence, permissions, schema cache invalidation, audit events 
    or runtime query behavior have been implemented.
  definitionScope: Workspace-scoped, shared by every task in that Workspace.
x-authentication-policy:
  contractVersion: 0.3.14-draft
  browserTransport:
    mode: opaque server-side session cookie only
    cookieName: __Host-session
    attributes:
      secure: true
      httpOnly: true
      sameSite: Lax
      path: /
      domain:
      maxAgeSeconds: 1209600
    idleTimeoutSeconds: 1209600
    absoluteTimeoutSeconds: 2592000
    rotationIntervalSeconds: 86400
    storage: Persist only a cryptographic hash of the opaque session secret; never return or expose the secret
      to JavaScript.
    bearerTokenInBrowserStorage: false
  csrf:
    algorithm: Synchronizer token; 256-bit CSPRNG token bound to authenticated session or 10-minute pre-auth 
      transaction.
    bootstrap: GET /auth/csrf; anonymous call sets __Host-auth-csrf; authenticated call returns session-bound 
      token.
    mutations: Require X-CSRF-Token and exact allowlisted Origin. Reject Origin:null, missing/untrusted 
      Origin, invalid token, and cookie-authenticated cross-origin mutations.
    exemptions: Safe GET/HEAD/OPTIONS; protocol-specific Google OIDC callback navigations are validated by 
      single-use state, nonce, PKCE and the browser-binding cookie. No state-changing application action may 
      be implemented as GET.
  originsAndCors:
    allowlist: Exact scheme + host + port entries per environment; no wildcard, suffix match, dynamic 
      reflection or null origin.
    credentials: true
    allowCredentialsHeader: 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true only for exact allowlisted origins.'
    allowedHeaders:
    - Content-Type
    - X-CSRF-Token
    - X-Mutation-Id
    - X-Request-Id
    - X-Preview-Role-Id
    sameSiteTopology: Production browser app and API must be same-site (same schemeful registrable site); keep
      API cookie host-only. Separate unrelated sites are not supported by this cookie contract.
  registrationAndEmail:
    registration: Create PENDING_VERIFICATION; return generic 202; do not establish an authenticated session 
      until address verification succeeds.
    emailVerificationTokenTtlSeconds: 1800
    emailVerificationTokenUseCount: 1
    resetTokenTtlSeconds: 900
    resetTokenUseCount: 1
    tokenStorage: Store token hashes only; tokens are opaque 256-bit random values, single-use, and must be 
      redacted from logs/traces/analytics.
    enumeration: Registration, verification resend and reset request return the same generic 202 response for 
      known/unknown/already-verified addresses.
    google: A verified Google email satisfies email verification for that Google identity.
  passwords:
    minimumLength: 12
    maximumLength: 1024
    complexityRules: false
    hashing: Argon2id with at least 19 MiB memory, 2 iterations, parallelism 1; benchmark and increase on 
      production hardware. Unique random salt per password.
    plaintextOrReversibleStorage: false
    breachedPasswordCheck: true
    passwordChange: Requires recent step-up/current credential; rotates current session and revokes all other 
      sessions.
  googleOidc:
    flow: Authorization Code + PKCE S256; server-managed verifier, state and nonce.
    stateTtlSeconds: 300
    stateSingleUse: true
    callbackUris: Exact per-environment provider registration; never wildcard.
    validation:
    - issuer
    - audience
    - signature
    - expiry
    - nonce
    - email_verified
    - subject
    returnTo: Same-origin allowlisted relative application path only.
    autoLinkByEmail: false
    browserBindingCookie:
      name: __Host-oauth-state
      attributes:
        secure: true
        httpOnly: true
        sameSite: Lax
        path: /
        domain:
        maxAgeSeconds: 300
      purpose: Binds the one-time server-side state/nonce/PKCE transaction to the browser that initiated the 
        redirect.
  identityLinking:
    stepUpWindowSeconds: 300
    sameSessionRequiredForCallback: true
    providerIdentityUnique: true
    lastVerifiedMethodCannotBeRemoved: true
    sameEmailIsNotProofOfOwnership: true
    onLinkOrUnlink: Rotate current session and revoke other sessions.
    stepUpMechanism:
      password: POST /auth/reauthenticate validates currentPassword and binds a five-minute grant to the 
        current session.
      google: GET /auth/oauth/google/reauth/start and callback perform fresh Google OIDC with 
        prompt=login/max_age=0 and require the already-linked provider subject.
      authorization: Sensitive identity operations require the unexpired grant on the same active session; 
        grants are not transferable across sessions.
  sessions:
    metadataVisibleToUser:
    - id
    - createdAt
    - lastSeenAt
    - expiresAt
    - isCurrent
    - deviceLabel
    neverExpose:
    - rawSessionToken
    - csrfTokenForOtherSession
    - fullIpAddress
    - providerTokens
    passwordReset: Revoke every prior session and issue one new session after successful token consumption.
    realtime: Revocation closes sockets and invalidates pending realtime tickets across instances.
  rateLimits:
    login: 5 failed attempts per normalized-account bucket per 15 minutes; 20 per source IP per 15 minutes; 
      progressive delay; no permanent account lockout.
    registration: 5 attempts per source IP per hour.
    verificationOrReset: 3 requests per normalized-account bucket per hour; 10 per source IP per hour; 
      account-bucket throttling retains the generic 202 response so it does not reveal whether an account 
      exists.
    googleStart: 10 attempts per source IP per 10 minutes.
    bucketPrivacy: HMAC(normalized email) rather than plaintext email; distributed counters; account-bucket 
      throttling retains the generic 202; source-IP throttles may return a generic 429 with Retry-After.
  deployment:
    tls: HTTPS only; redirect HTTP to HTTPS at trusted edge; HSTS enabled after domain readiness.
    trustedProxy: Honor forwarded headers only from explicitly trusted load balancers/proxies.
    secrets: Use provider secret manager; never commit, log, expose in client bundle, or share secrets between
      dev/stage/prod.
    requiredConfig:
    - APP_ORIGIN
    - API_ORIGIN
    - TRUSTED_BROWSER_ORIGINS
    - GOOGLE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
    - GOOGLE_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
    - GOOGLE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI
    - EMAIL_PROVIDER
    - EMAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY
    - EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
    - SESSION_TOKEN_HMAC_KEY
    - CSRF_TOKEN_HMAC_KEY
    providerSelection: Cloud hosting, email vendor, DNS, concrete origins and OAuth callback registration 
      remain explicit deployment inputs; this contract does not claim they are configured.
  logging:
    redact:
    - password
    - authorization header
    - Cookie
    - Set-Cookie
    - session token
    - csrf token
    - OAuth code
    - OAuth state
    - access token
    - refresh token
    - verification token
    - password reset token
    events: Record auth success/failure, identity link/unlink, password reset, session creation/revocation and
      verification transitions without raw secrets; do not log submitted passwords or token values.
  outOfScope: MFA/passkeys, social providers other than Google, enterprise SAML/SCIM, device trust and account
    recovery by support override require separate security review.
x-mutation-and-pagination-policy:
  status: 
    ENGINEERING_POLICY_SPECIFIED_FOR_0.3.16_DRAFT_AND_CARRIED_FORWARD_IN_0.3.17_DRAFT_PENDING_JOINT_FE_BE_SECURITY_PRODUCT_SIGN_OFF
  contractVersion: 0.3.17-draft
  pagination:
    scope: Only endpoints that declare cursor pagination use this policy; unpaginated endpoints are unchanged.
    genericCollection:
      defaultLimit: 50
      maximumLimit: 200
      minimumLimit: 1
      limitBehavior: Reject values outside 1..200 with 422 PAGINATION_LIMIT_INVALID; never silently clamp.
      responseEnvelope: Preserve each endpoint DTO; where pageInfo is defined it contains nextCursor, hasMore,
        and optional totalCount.
      ordering: Every paginated collection defines a deterministic allow-listed order and server-appended 
        unique UUIDv7 id ASC tie-breaker. Client sort expressions and offsets are not accepted.
      consistency: Keyset continuation, not a historical snapshot, unless that endpoint explicitly declares 
        snapshot semantics. Inserts/deletes or mutable sort-key changes may be observed between ordinary 
        collection pages.
    cursor:
      format: Opaque server-managed token with at least 256 bits of cryptographically secure randomness; 
        clients must treat it as an uninterpreted string.
      storage: Persist only a token digest; cursor state is server-side and protected by 
        tenant/principal/query binding.
      binding:
      - HTTP method and route/resource
      - communityId and workspaceId where applicable
      - authenticated principal
      - canonical filters/query hash
      - sort order and unique tie-breaker
      - limit
      - page scope and group key where applicable
      - snapshot ID or collection continuation state
      expirySeconds: 900
      expiryMode: FIXED_ABSOLUTE_NON_SLIDING_FROM_FIRST_PAGE
      replay: A cursor is replayable during its validity window; repeated use returns the same continuation 
        page and does not consume the cursor.
      invalidOrMismatched: Return 409 QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID without disclosing the mismatched binding.
      expired: Return 409 QUERY_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED for snapshot-bound task-query cursors/handles; ordinary 
        collection cursors return 409 CURSOR_EXPIRED.
      changedLimitOrQuery: A cursor used with a different bound query/filter/sort/limit/scope is rejected with
        409 QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID or CURSOR_INVALID for non-query collections.
      noClientOffsets: true
    taskQuerySnapshot:
      ttlSeconds: 900
      ttlMode: FIXED_ABSOLUTE_NON_SLIDING_FROM_SNAPSHOT_CREATION
      capture: Ordered task IDs, membership, bucket assignments, counts and workspace snapshotSequence are 
        captured from one consistent query snapshot.
      rowRead: Task DTO values are read at page-fetch time; membership/order/buckets/counts remain anchored to
        the first snapshot.
      realtime: Workspace events newer than snapshotSequence invalidate/refetch the active query; realtime 
        sequence/catch-up cursors remain governed separately by CR-09.
      authorization: Recheck current session, community/workspace membership, task:read, Personal Workspace 
        privacy, break-glass grant and per-row visibility on every page/re-projection. Cursor and 
        querySnapshotId are never authorization tokens.
      revokedRow: Omit an individual row no longer visible; do not backfill it from outside the original 
        snapshot. A page may therefore contain fewer rows than its requested limit.
      workspaceRevoked: Return the normal non-enumerating workspace authorization response; do not disclose 
        snapshot existence.
      projection: LIST/BOARD/CALENDAR/TIMELINE may re-workspace the same snapshot only with the identical 
        canonical querySpec; projection is excluded from the query hash as already specified by CR-04.
  idempotency:
    requiredOn: Every state-changing POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE operation. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS are exempt; GET OAuth 
      authorization/callback transitions use the CR-13 OIDC state/nonce and single-use authorization-code 
      controls, not X-Mutation-Id. Read-only POST operations and one-time credential issuance are also exempt.
    header: X-Mutation-Id
    format: UUIDv7 using the existing Uuid schema; one newly generated ID per logical mutation.
    namespace:
      authenticated: USER:{authenticatedUserId}, global across all communities, workspaces, routes and HTTP 
        methods for that account.
      preAuthentication: PREAUTH:{HMAC-server-derived digest of the active __Host-auth-csrf cookie value}; 
        never use an IP address or a client-supplied principal.
      transition: Do not carry a mutation ID from pre-authentication into an authenticated session or from one
        account to another.
    uniqueKey: (principal_scope, mutation_id)
    requestFingerprint: Canonical HTTP method + normalized route/path + canonical JSON body + content type + 
      X-Mutation-Created-At when present. Exclude CSRF tokens, cookies, Origin, X-Request-Id and other 
      per-attempt credentials. Same key with a different fingerprint returns 409 
      IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.
    retentionDays: 30
    retentionAnchor: SERVER_FIRST_RECEIVED_AT; fixed, not sliding on replay.
    record: Store scope, mutation ID, fingerprint, completion status, original HTTP status, safe response 
      body/headers and createdAt/expiresAt. Never persist or replay Set-Cookie, raw CSRF/session/auth tokens, 
      OAuth codes, password values or other credential secrets.
    replay: 'After current authentication, CSRF/origin and current scope/resource authorization succeed, a completed
      matching request returns its recorded result and X-Idempotent-Replayed: true. Recompute any context-sensitive
      authorization projection such as effectivePermissions before serialization; never return a result the actor
      can no longer access.'
    authorizationBeforeReplay: Re-evaluate current membership, visibility and effective capability before 
      returning a stored result. A now-revoked request receives the ordinary current 401/403/404 response, not
      the cached mutation body.
    inFlightDuplicate: Serialize by unique key. A concurrent duplicate with the same fingerprint waits for 
      completion; if bounded wait expires, return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After and 
      retryable=true. Different fingerprint returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH.
    atomicity: Mutation, completed idempotency result and durable domain-event/outbox intents commit in one 
      database transaction. No external side effect is sent before commit; downstream workers use provider 
      idempotency/deduplication keys.
    persistedOutcomes: Persist successful responses and deterministic terminal domain/validation/conflict 
      results. Do not persist authentication/authorization failures, rate limits, transient 5xx responses or 
      rolled-back transactions; same key may be retried after those non-completions.
    credentialIssuingOperations: Never cache/replay raw credentials or Set-Cookie. If a credential-issuing 
      operation cannot safely replay its original result, return 409 AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE and require 
      the client to restart that auth flow with a fresh X-Mutation-Id.
    replayHeader: 'X-Idempotent-Replayed: true is present on any persisted completed-result replay, including deterministic
      terminal 4xx results; omit it on first execution and non-persisted transient/authentication/authorization
      failures.'
    getOAuthCallback: OIDC state, nonce, exact callback URI and single-use authorization-code redemption 
      govern GET callback replay/CSRF protection. Never store or return an OAuth code as an idempotency 
      result.
  explicitPostExemptions:
  - operationId: queryWorkspaceTasks
    reason: Read-only canonical four-view query.
  - operationId: previewRoleCapabilities
    reason: Read-only role-permission preview.
  - operationId: previewTaskMove
    reason: Read-only task move/transfer preview.
  - operationId: queryMyWork
    reason: Read-only My Work query.
  - operationId: createRealtimeTicket
    reason: Single-use credential issuance; each attempt must mint a new ticket, and credential replay is 
      prohibited.
  offlineReplay:
    releaseScope: Selected existing-task field edits only; no offline task creation, comment creation, 
      membership/role changes, workspace lifecycle, task transfer, bulk operations or file operations.
    transport: Replay the existing PATCH /communities/{communityId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tasks/{taskId} 
      operation one mutation at a time. No POST /sync/mutations batch endpoint is added.
    allowedFields:
    - title
    - description
    - statusCategory
    - priority
    - startDate
    - dueDate
    - estimatePoints
    - customFieldValues.{definitionId}
    excludedFields:
    - itemType
    - assigneeIds
    - labelIds
    - milestoneId
    - rankPlacement
    - dependencies/links
    - archive/delete/restore
    - comments
    - workspace/community membership and permissions
    - assigneeEditableFieldGroups
    - assigneeEditableFieldGroupsAllowed
    - assigneeEditableFieldGroupsDefault
    maximumQueueAgeDays: 14
    queueAgeAnchor: Client-persisted queue createdAt. The client blocks automatic replay after 14 days and 
      requires explicit user confirmation to re-submit as a new mutation with a new X-Mutation-Id and freshly 
      fetched baseFieldRevisions.
    serverAgeGuard: X-Mutation-Created-At is sent for offline replay. The server first checks for an already 
      completed matching idempotency record (safe duplicate replay); for a first receipt it rejects a 
      timestamp older than 14 days with 410 MUTATION_EXPIRED and rejects a timestamp more than five minutes in
      the future. This client timestamp is not an authorization or conflict-resolution clock and is not 
      tamper-proof.
    replayOrder: FIFO per account/workspace queue; sequential requests; preserve order for edits to the same 
      task. Each queued entry carries its own stable X-Mutation-Id and baseFieldRevisions. Retries reuse the 
      same ID and exact request fingerprint.
    authorization: Before every replay, require the same authenticated account and re-evaluate current 
      community/workspace membership, task visibility and field-level capability. Never replay with another 
      account or after access revocation.
    revokedAccess: If access is revoked or a field is no longer authorized, do not apply the mutation; 
      quarantine the local entry in the recovery drawer. Any copy/recreate into a currently accessible 
      Personal Workspace requires explicit user action and a new mutation ID.
    conflict: Per changed field, compare current server fieldRevisions[field] with 
      request.baseFieldRevisions[field]. Equal revisions may merge even when unrelated fields changed. A 
      same-field mismatch returns 409 FIELD_REVISION_CONFLICT with conflictingFields and no partial write.
    conflictResolution: Show client and current server values. A user-confirmed resolution refreshes current 
      fieldRevisions and sends a new logical mutation with a new X-Mutation-Id; never reuse the old key with a
      modified body.
    clockRule: Server field revision counters are authoritative. Client wall-clock timestamps and 
      Last-Write-Wins are never used for conflict decisions.
  errorCodes:
    '409':
    - QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID
    - QUERY_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED
    - CURSOR_INVALID
    - CURSOR_EXPIRED
    - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
    - IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS
    - AUTH_RESULT_NOT_REPLAYABLE
    - FIELD_REVISION_CONFLICT
    '410':
    - MUTATION_EXPIRED
    '422':
    - PAGINATION_LIMIT_INVALID
  implementationBoundary: These are engineering API/persistence policies. They do not prove cursor storage, 
    database locking/transactions, idempotency cleanup, offline client storage, replay workers, authorization 
    middleware or runtime conflict handling are implemented.
x-reliability-operations-policy:
  status: ENGINEERING_OPERATIONS_POLICY_SPECIFIED_FOR_0.3.17_DRAFT; DEC-OPEN-04 TARGETS REMAIN PROVISIONAL; 
    PROVIDER AND PRODUCTION ATTAINMENT UNVERIFIED
  contractVersion: 0.3.17-draft
  targetClassification:
    availability: PROVISIONAL_STAKEHOLDER_TARGET_NOT_AN_SLA
    databaseRpo: PROVISIONAL_STAKEHOLDER_TARGET_NOT_A_GUARANTEE
    rto: PROVISIONAL_STAKEHOLDER_TARGET_NOT_A_GUARANTEE
    topology: RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT_PENDING_BACKEND_OPS_PROVIDER_AND_BUDGET_REVIEW
    backupRetention: RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT_PENDING_PROVIDER_COST_AND_SECURITY_REVIEW
  serviceTargets:
    monthlyAvailabilityPercent: 99.5
    measurement: External synthetic GET /api/v1/health/ready every 60 seconds from two independent regions. 
      Report monthly successful/total probe intervals and retain regional breakdown. A failed region is 
      surfaced as degradation; sustained inability to reach readiness is downtime. Do not present the target 
      as a contractual SLA before approval.
    thirtyDayErrorBudget: Approximately 3 hours 36 minutes at 99.5%; planning figure only.
    databaseRpoSecondsMaximumExclusive: 300
    rpoMechanism: Managed PostgreSQL continuous WAL archiving/PITR with monitored archive/replication lag, 
      plus daily encrypted logical backup as a second recovery path. The daily dump does not replace WAL/PITR.
    rtoSecondsMaximumExclusive: 3600
    rtoDefinition: From incident declaration to verified restoration of critical authenticated application 
      flows, tenant isolation and write/read health; infrastructure merely starting is not restored service.
    plannedMaintenance: Customer-visible unavailability is recorded in the SLI. Any exclusion or 
      maintenance-window policy requires explicit Ops/Product approval; do not silently remove downtime from 
      the denominator.
  initialTopology:
    frontend: Static Vite/React SPA/PWA on an edge CDN with immutable hashed assets, TLS, security headers and
      atomic previous-build rollback.
    backend: One always-on containerized modular monolith (initially one replica) serving REST and WSS; 
      transactional outbox/background worker runs in-process or as a lightweight worker using the same release
      image.
    database: Managed PostgreSQL 16/17 with connection pooling, RLS, automated snapshots and continuous WAL 
      PITR. Application and migration credentials remain separate.
    observability: Centralized structured logs, metrics, external synthetic availability checks and actionable
      alerts.
    avoidInitially:
    - Kubernetes
    - Kafka
    - microservice mesh
    - self-managed database cluster
    - separate Redis/RabbitMQ cluster without measured need
    scaleRule: Add replicas, a broker adapter, read replicas or additional regions only after measured 
      concurrency/latency/availability evidence and an approved operations change. Preserve the 
      modular-monolith and transactional-outbox boundary.
    excluded: File upload/object-storage recovery is not specified in this milestone because file 
      attachments/uploads were removed from the current approved product scope. Re-open storage DR only with a
      product scope change.
  environments:
    dev: Local development with deterministic seed-v1.json, MSW or isolated local Docker services. No 
      production credentials or tenant data.
    staging: Production-like topology with separate database, secrets, storage if later approved, and sandbox 
      email sink. Contract, migration, restore and release gates run here.
    prod: Separate credentials/database/secrets, least-privilege service identity, restricted operational 
      access and audited runbooks. No routine direct workstation access to production data.
    secretHandling: Inject DATABASE_APP_URL, DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL, session/OAuth/email/observability secrets
      through the selected platform secret manager. Never commit secrets; validate required variables at 
      startup and fail closed. Rotate credentials through documented runbooks.
    migration: 'Expand-and-contract: add nullable/backward-compatible structures first; deploy code compatible with
      N and N-1; backfill in bounded batches; add constraints/remove old structures only after prior versions are
      retired. Use a separate migration identity; avoid long blocking locks.'
  healthChecks:
    liveness: GET /health/live returns 200 {status:UP} if process/event loop responds; no DB/provider 
      dependency; failed liveness permits process restart.
    readiness: GET /health/ready runs PostgreSQL SELECT 1 with a 2-second timeout and checks outbox worker 
      heartbeat age <30 seconds; 200 only when both pass, otherwise generic 503 with Retry-After.
    privacy: Both endpoints are tenant-neutral, no-store and disclose no dependency names, hostnames, query 
      text, credentials or tenant information. Private diagnostics/metrics are not public API routes.
  loggingAndMetrics:
    structuredLogFields:
    - timestamp
    - level
    - correlationId
    - userId
    - communityId
    - workspaceId
    - operationId
    - statusCode
    - durationMs
    - errorCode
    redact:
    - Cookie
    - Authorization
    - X-CSRF-Token
    - password
    - access token
    - refresh token
    - OAuth code
    - session secret
    - raw task title/description
    - comment body
    - custom-field values
    - free-text break-glass justification
    metrics:
    - synthetic availability by region
    - HTTP request/error rates
    - latency percentiles
    - task-query p95
    - database connections/latency/WAL archive lag
    - outbox oldest pending age and backlog
    - worker heartbeat
    - WebSocket connection/reconnect/sequence-gap counts
    - backup freshness and latest restore-drill outcome
    - audit hash-chain verifier status
    performanceRecommendations:
      taskQueryP95Milliseconds: 400
      taskQueryTestWorkspaceTaskCount: 1000
      exactTaskKeyLookupP95Milliseconds: 100
      optimisticUiReflectionMilliseconds: 50
      webVitalsINPP75Milliseconds: 200
    performanceClassification: Engineering recommendations/acceptance targets, not current measurements or 
      externally guaranteed SLA.
  alerts:
  - id: READINESS_DOWN
    severity: CRITICAL
    condition: /health/ready returns non-200 for 2 consecutive minutes.
    response: Check deploy status, database reachability and outbox heartbeat; incident owner assigned.
  - id: HTTP_5XX_SPIKE
    severity: HIGH
    condition: HTTP 5xx rate exceeds 1% of requests or more than 5 errors occur in 5 minutes.
    response: Inspect correlated redacted logs and recent release; rollback or mitigate if release-related.
  - id: OUTBOX_LAG
    severity: HIGH
    condition: More than 100 unprocessed domain_events have been pending longer than 30 seconds.
    response: Inspect worker heartbeat, locks, provider throttling and dead-letter/retry state; preserve 
      durable events.
  - id: SECURITY_OR_AUDIT_INTEGRITY
    severity: IMMEDIATE
    condition: Any ADMIN_BREAK_GLASS event, audit hash-chain verification failure, or more than 50 401/403/429
      responses from one actor within 5 minutes.
    response: Notify Security; review actor/session and audit evidence; revoke sessions or contain access 
      where warranted.
  - id: BACKUP_RPO_RISK
    severity: CRITICAL
    condition: WAL archive/replication lag approaches 5 minutes, latest required backup is missing/invalid, or
      a scheduled restore drill fails.
    response: Ops investigates immediately; do not claim RPO coverage until freshness and restore verification
      recover.
  backupAndRecovery:
    primary: Managed PostgreSQL continuous WAL archiving/PITR and automated daily encrypted pg_dump 
      custom-format backup.
    secondary: Copy encrypted logical backups to an isolated backup bucket/account or equivalent provider 
      boundary; encryption key access is separate from normal app credentials.
    backupRetentionDaysRecommended: 30
    backupRetentionStatus: RECOMMENDED_DEFAULT_ONLY; validate provider cost, recovery/legal requirements and 
      security controls. This is not CR-14 audit-log retention and does not resolve it.
    verification: Before M1.3 launch and monthly thereafter, execute a clean-room restore into an isolated 
      disposable PostgreSQL environment. Restore a chosen PITR point, run integrity/foreign-key/RLS checks, 
      verify CR-14 audit hash chain, check outbox/idempotency invariants and run critical CHK-01 through 
      CHK-06 smoke tests. Record backup timestamp, restore target, measured RPO/RTO, failures and evidence.
    runbook: scripts/dr-restore-verify.sh is the recommended reproducible entry point; it must fail non-zero 
      on any verification mismatch and must never write to production during a drill.
    cutover: Preserve incident evidence and current database snapshot/WAL first. Restore to an isolated 
      target, validate, obtain Incident Commander/DB owner approval, then perform controlled cutover and 
      verify critical user flows.
    noClaims: Backup schedules, WAL archiving, encryption, retention locks and restore drills are not 
      considered operational until configured and evidenced on the selected provider.
  deploymentAndRelease:
    ciGates:
    - OpenAPI lint and deterministic frontend type generation (zero diff)
    - TypeScript/ESLint/dependency and lockfile security scans
    - Backend unit/policy/integration checks on ephemeral PostgreSQL with migrations from scratch
    - Frontend component/MSW/Playwright and axe-core accessibility checks
    - Production build, bundle budget and smoke test
    release: Build immutable, versioned frontend/backend artifacts once; promote the same artifacts 
      dev→staging→prod. Staging must pass migration, contract, health and recovery gates before promotion.
    rollback: Frontend rollback switches the CDN/static asset deployment to the previous immutable build. 
      Backend rollback redeploys the previous image only when the schema is N-1 compatible; otherwise use a 
      forward fix or the approved database restore runbook. No destructive automatic schema downgrade.
    migrationSafety: All production migrations follow expand-and-contract and have a tested 
      rollback/forward-recovery plan. Take/verify a recoverable backup before high-risk destructive 
      operations.
  incidentResponse:
    SEV1: Tenant isolation leak, total service outage, suspected account/session compromise, destructive data 
      corruption or audit-chain integrity failure.
    SEV2: Partial degradation such as realtime disconnect, notification/email delay or non-critical background
      job failure while core authenticated task operations remain available.
    roles: Assign Incident Commander, technical operator and communications owner. Maintain a timestamped 
      incident log and use redacted correlation IDs; do not put secrets or task contents in incident channels.
    SEV1Containment: 'Within 0–15 minutes where feasible: declare incident, preserve evidence, revoke affected sessions
      and sockets, disable compromised credentials/feature path, stop unsafe writes or enter maintenance mode (503
      + Retry-After), and roll back a bad application release when safe.'
    SEV1Recovery: 'Target restoration within 60 minutes: restore PostgreSQL to a verified PITR point in isolation
      if required, validate tenant/RLS and audit integrity, obtain explicit cutover approval, restore application
      traffic and run smoke tests.'
    SEV2Response: Use HTTP fallback for realtime loss; retain outbox/email work for retry; disable only 
      affected non-critical worker/feature paths and communicate degraded functionality.
    postIncident: Within 5 business days as a recommended default, publish an internal blameless post-incident
      review with timeline, impact, root/contributing causes, measured RPO/RTO, detection/response gaps and 
      tracked corrective actions. Product/ops can tune this period.
  launchGates:
  - External readiness synthetic and actionable alert path verified in staging.
  - Database WAL/PITR and encrypted backup configuration evidenced on chosen provider.
  - Clean-room restore drill completed before M1.3 and meets the provisional RPO/RTO targets.
  - Health probes, redacted structured logs, 5xx/outbox/security/backup alerts verified.
  - CI contract/type/security/backend/frontend/accessibility/build gates pass.
  - Expand-and-contract migration and previous-image rollback rehearsed.
  - SEV1/SEV2 runbooks, owners, escalation and communications paths reviewed.
  - Provider/budget selection and joint Product/Backend/Frontend/Security/Ops approval recorded.
  implementationBoundary: This is a versioned operational contract and acceptance plan. It does not prove any 
    cloud provider has been selected, backups/PITR/alerts are enabled, monitoring is running, an incident 
    drill occurred or the SLO/RPO/RTO has been met.
x-workspace-key-and-hierarchy-policy:
  keyPrefix:
    uniqueness: Community-unique across all current and historical Workspace prefix reservations; 
      case-insensitive
    sequence: Workspace-local, atomic, monotonic and never reset or reused
    rename: Workspace Owner-only; atomically re-key active tasks preserving numeric sequence and insert 
      immutable old-key aliases
    collision: 409 WORKSPACE_KEY_PREFIX_ALREADY_IN_USE; no partial prefix/key/alias changes
  subtaskDepth:
    default: 1
    minimum: 1
    maximum: 2
    meaning: Root task depth is 0; one direct subtask level is depth 1; optional nested subtask level is depth
      2
    lowering: Reject a requested lower maxSubtaskDepth atomically if any existing tree exceeds it; do not 
      silently reparent, archive or delete tasks
    error: 422 MAX_SUBTASK_DEPTH_BELOW_CURRENT_TREE
x-workspace-milestone-policy:
  status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_DEC_OPEN_08
  purpose: Optional Workspace-level planning markers linked directly to tasks; never a hierarchy/container 
    layer
  views: May be displayed in Timeline and task details; does not alter task parentage or Workspace task query 
    membership
  authorization: Workspace-scoped capability and active membership checks on every read/write
x-workspace-ownership-policy:
  status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_DEC_OPEN_15
  multipleOwners: Multiple active Workspace Owners are allowed in Shared Workspaces
  floor: At least one active Owner must remain at transaction commit; last active Owner cannot leave, be 
    suspended, be demoted or be removed without an atomic replacement promotion
  transfer: Dedicated owner-transfer operation; promote eligible active Workspace member first, then 
    optionally demote or suspend caller in the same transaction
  personal: Personal Workspace has exactly one owner and does not support Workspace owner-transfer
  recovery: Community Admin recovery only through the separately audited recovery process; no silent ownership
    takeover
x-workspace-template-policy:
  status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_DEC_OPEN_07
  catalog:
  - GENERAL_PURPOSE
  - EVENT_PLANNING
  - TEAM_OPERATIONS
  seededConfiguration:
  - workflowStatuses
  - supportedPhase1CustomFieldDefinitions
  - defaultSharedSavedViews
  excluded:
  - tasks
  - subtasks
  - assignees
  - comments
  - watchers
  - members
  - invitations
  - permissionEscalations
  application: Atomic during Workspace creation; catalog is immutable and versioned; Workspace Owner can edit 
    resulting configuration after creation
  builtIns:
  - key: GENERAL_PURPOSE
    name: General Workspace
    version: 1
    workflowStatuses:
    - key: TODO
      name: To do
      category: TODO
      position: 0
    - key: IN_PROGRESS
      name: In progress
      category: IN_PROGRESS
      position: 1
    - key: DONE
      name: Done
      category: DONE
      position: 2
    customFieldDefinitions: []
    defaultSavedViews:
    - name: All work
      viewType: LIST
      scope: SHARED
    - name: Board
      viewType: BOARD
      scope: SHARED
  - key: EVENT_PLANNING
    name: Event Planning
    version: 1
    workflowStatuses:
    - key: BACKLOG
      name: Backlog
      category: BACKLOG
      position: 0
    - key: TODO
      name: To do
      category: TODO
      position: 1
    - key: IN_PROGRESS
      name: In progress
      category: IN_PROGRESS
      position: 2
    - key: DONE
      name: Done
      category: DONE
      position: 3
    customFieldDefinitions:
    - key: event_date
      name: Event date
      fieldType: DATE
      required: false
    - key: workstream
      name: Workstream
      fieldType: SINGLE_SELECT
      required: false
      options:
      - Program
      - Logistics
      - Marketing
      - Registration
    defaultSavedViews:
    - name: Planning board
      viewType: BOARD
      scope: SHARED
    - name: Event calendar
      viewType: CALENDAR
      scope: SHARED
    - name: Timeline
      viewType: TIMELINE
      scope: SHARED
  - key: TEAM_OPERATIONS
    name: Team Operations
    version: 1
    workflowStatuses:
    - key: BACKLOG
      name: Backlog
      category: BACKLOG
      position: 0
    - key: TODO
      name: Planned
      category: TODO
      position: 1
    - key: IN_PROGRESS
      name: In progress
      category: IN_PROGRESS
      position: 2
    - key: DONE
      name: Done
      category: DONE
      position: 3
    customFieldDefinitions:
    - key: service_area
      name: Service area
      fieldType: SINGLE_SELECT
      required: false
      options:
      - Facilities
      - Communications
      - Technical
      - Community
    - key: review_date
      name: Review date
      fieldType: DATE
      required: false
    defaultSavedViews:
    - name: Operations list
      viewType: LIST
      scope: SHARED
    - name: Operations board
      viewType: BOARD
      scope: SHARED
    - name: Review calendar
      viewType: CALENDAR
      scope: SHARED
x-workspace-trash-policy:
  status: OWNER_CONFIRMED_DEC_OPEN_11
  recoverableWindowDays: 30
  restore: Workspace Owner or authorized member with task:restore may restore an archived task/tree before 
    recovery eligibility expires, subject to current membership and task visibility
  purge: Explicit user-initiated operation by an active Workspace Owner with task:delete_permanent; purge 
    entire archived task subtree atomically; require typed confirmation and audit evidence
  eligibility: Purge endpoint is specified but remains disabled until DEC-OPEN-03 retention/legal-hold policy 
    is approved; a task is not automatically purged when 30 days elapse
  automaticPurge: DISABLED
  aliases: Retain immutable key aliases and minimal content-free lineage/tombstone needed for authorized 410 
    behavior and non-disclosure
```

## Appendix B — Realtime event envelope JSON Schema (unchanged for 0.3.20-draft)

**Reason unchanged:** approved decisions add no new realtime envelope types; existing Workspace events carry configuration changes.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://schemas.work-platform.invalid/ws-events.schema.json",
  "title": "Work Management Realtime Event Envelopes",
  "description": "Workspace-scoped server-to-client domain delta envelopes plus recipient-only community notification events. Intermediate-container lifecycle events are not part of the product because Workspaces are the primary work container. Control frames are defined separately in ws-protocol.schema.json.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/workspaceStreamEvent"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/userCommunityStreamEvent"
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "uuid": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
    },
    "workspaceStreamEvent": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "schemaVersion",
        "stream",
        "communityId",
        "workspaceId",
        "workspaceSeq",
        "eventId",
        "eventType",
        "occurredAt",
        "actorId",
        "entityId",
        "mutationId",
        "payload"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "schemaVersion": {
          "const": 1
        },
        "stream": {
          "const": "workspace"
        },
        "communityId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "workspaceId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "workspaceSeq": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "eventId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "eventType": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "workspace.restored",
            "task.created",
            "task.updated",
            "task.archived",
            "task.restored",
            "task.moved",
            "task.linked",
            "task.unlinked",
            "comment.created",
            "comment.updated",
            "comment.deleted",
            "watcher.changed",
            "workspace.created",
            "workspace.updated",
            "workspace.archived",
            "workspace.settings_updated",
            "saved_view.created",
            "saved_view.updated",
            "saved_view.deleted",
            "member.added",
            "member.updated",
            "member.removed",
            "milestone.created",
            "milestone.updated",
            "milestone.deleted",
            "task.bulk_updated",
            "member.invitation_created",
            "member.invitation_revoked",
            "member.invitation_expired",
            "custom_field.schema_changed",
            "task.custom_fields_updated"
          ]
        },
        "occurredAt": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "actorId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "mutationId": {
          "description": "Originating X-Mutation-Id; null for system work without a client-originated mutation.",
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "entityId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "payload": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": true,
          "description": "Permission-filtered event delta. Custom-field schema/value events contain only identifiers, version and changeType; never field values or option labels.",
          "properties": {
            "transferId": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
            },
            "side": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "SOURCE",
                "TARGET"
              ]
            },
            "movedTaskCount": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "rootTaskId": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "task.moved"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "required": [
                  "transferId",
                  "side",
                  "movedTaskCount",
                  "rootTaskId"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "properties": {
                  "transferId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "side": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "SOURCE",
                      "TARGET"
                    ]
                  },
                  "movedTaskCount": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  },
                  "rootTaskId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "enum": [
                  "saved_view.created",
                  "saved_view.updated",
                  "saved_view.deleted"
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "viewId",
                  "version",
                  "scope"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "viewId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "version": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  },
                  "scope": {
                    "const": "SHARED"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "custom_field.schema_changed"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "fieldId",
                  "version",
                  "changeType"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "fieldId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "version": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  },
                  "changeType": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "FIELD_CREATED",
                      "FIELD_UPDATED",
                      "FIELD_ARCHIVED",
                      "FIELD_RESTORED",
                      "OPTION_CREATED",
                      "OPTION_UPDATED",
                      "OPTION_ARCHIVED",
                      "OPTION_RESTORED",
                      "OPTIONS_REORDERED"
                    ]
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "task.custom_fields_updated"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "taskId",
                  "taskVersion",
                  "fieldDefinitionIds"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "taskId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "taskVersion": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  },
                  "fieldDefinitionIds": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 1,
                    "maxItems": 100,
                    "uniqueItems": true,
                    "items": {
                      "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "userCommunityStreamEvent": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "schemaVersion",
        "stream",
        "communityId",
        "userNotificationSeq",
        "eventId",
        "eventType",
        "occurredAt",
        "payload"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "schemaVersion": {
          "const": 1
        },
        "stream": {
          "const": "user-community"
        },
        "communityId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "userNotificationSeq": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "eventId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "eventType": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "notification.created",
            "notification.read",
            "notification.read_all",
            "membership.changed",
            "workspace.invitation.created",
            "workspace.invitation.revoked",
            "security.break_glass_invoked",
            "community.invitation.created",
            "community.invitation.revoked",
            "community.invitation.expired",
            "workspace.invitation.accepted",
            "workspace.invitation.expired",
            "community.invitation.accepted"
          ]
        },
        "occurredAt": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "payload": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": true,
          "description": "Recipient-only payload. notification.created/read/read_all use the closed CR-10 payload shapes; no userId, email, comment body, mention target list or inaccessible resource identifier is included."
        }
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "notification.created"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "notificationId",
                  "category",
                  "reason",
                  "unreadCount"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "notificationId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "category": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/NotificationCategory"
                  },
                  "reason": {
                    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/NotificationReason"
                  },
                  "unreadCount": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "notification.read"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "notificationId",
                  "unreadCount"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "notificationId": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
                  },
                  "unreadCount": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "eventType": {
                "const": "notification.read_all"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "eventType"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "payload": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "unreadCount"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "unreadCount": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 0
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Appendix C — Realtime control protocol JSON Schema (unchanged source snapshot)

~~~~json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://schemas.work-platform.invalid/ws-protocol.schema.json",
  "title": "Work Management Realtime Control Protocol",
  "description": "Client/server control frames for subprotocol work-platform.v1. Domain deltas are raw envelopes defined in ws-events.schema.json.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/clientControlFrame"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/serverControlFrame"
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "uuid": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uuid",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-7[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
    },
    "clientControlFrame": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/authenticate"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/subscribeWorkspace"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/subscribeUserCommunity"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/unsubscribeWorkspace"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/unsubscribeUserCommunity"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/pong"
        }
      ]
    },
    "serverControlFrame": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/connectionAck"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/workspaceSubscriptionAck"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/userCommunitySubscriptionAck"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/workspaceUnsubscriptionAck"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/userCommunityUnsubscriptionAck"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ping"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/error"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/workspaceAccessRevoked"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/workspaceAuthorizationChanged"
        },
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/communityAccessRevoked"
        }
      ]
    },
    "authenticate": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "type",
        "requestId",
        "ticket"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "AUTHENTICATE"
        },
        "requestId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$"
        },
        "ticket": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 43,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
        }
      },
      "description": "First application frame for ticket-authenticated sockets; must be sent within five seconds of Upgrade."
    },
    "subscribeWorkspace": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "type",
        "requestId",
        "communityId",
        "workspaceId",
        "sinceSeq"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "SUBSCRIBE_WORKSPACE"
        },
        "requestId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$"
        },
        "communityId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "workspaceId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "sinceSeq": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "description": "Requests a workspace stream. sinceSeq is the last contiguous workspaceSeq already applied by this client."
    },
    "subscribeUserCommunity": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "type",
        "requestId",
        "communityId",
        "sinceSeq"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "SUBSCRIBE_USER_COMMUNITY"
        },
        "requestId": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$"
        },
        "communityId": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/uuid"
        },
        "sinceSeq": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "description": "Requests the authenticated user’s private event stream for one community; userId is never client-supplied."
    },
    "unsubscribeWorkspace": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
~~~~
